🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Sonia Gandhi’s agonising moments over an alliance with the DMK

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 03:23:49 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The alliance ahead of the 2004 parliamentary elections was born out of political necessity, Congress leader Sonia Gandhi explains in her memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The alliance between the Congress and the DMK has been marked by several twists and turns. The two parties first came together in 1971 and again in 1980, before joining hands as part of the nationwide United Progressive Alliance (UPA) forged in 2004. The alliance ahead of the 2004 parliamentary elections, however, was born out of political necessity, as Congress leader Sonia Gandhi explains in her memoir, Belonging : A Journey of Love . She was initially wary of an alliance with the DMK, as the assassination of her husband and former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi by the LTTE continued to weigh heavily on her mind. In her memoir, she recounts the agonising dilemma she faced before reconciling herself to the political necessity of joining hands with the DMK to defeat the BJP. “For me the most challenging personal assignment was to bring into the alliance the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK), whose leader M. Karunanidhi was said to be unhappy with the Vajpayee government. It was the right moment to make contact, since of all the forces needed to come together to challenge the BJP, the DMK was the most important party in the south. I could sense that some of my colleagues from Tamil Nadu were keen on an alliance but didn’t know how to broach the subject to me. The DMK cadre had been at the time of the 1991 election vocal supporters of the LTTE, the terrorist group that had killed Rajiv; some in the party had openly threatened Rajiv,” she writes. She also recalls the Congress’s decision to withdraw support to the government of Prime Minister I.K. Gujral in November 1997 following the submission of the Jain Commission’s interim report, which inquired into Rajiv Gandhi’s assassination and criticised the DMK for its alleged support to the LTTE.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / Tamil Nadu InFocus / state politics / politics / arts, culture and entertainment

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The alliance ahead of the 2004 parliamentary elections was born out of political necessity, Congress leader Sonia Gandhi explains in her memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The alliance between the Congress and the DMK has been marked by several twists and turns. The two parties first came together in 1971 and again in 1980, before joining hands as part of the nationwide United Progressive Alliance (UPA) forged in 2004. The alliance ahead of the 2004 parliamentary elections, however, was born out of political necessity, as Congress leader Sonia Gandhi explains in her memoir, Belonging : A Journey of Love . She was initially wary of an alliance with the DMK, as the assassination of her husband and former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi by the LTTE continued to weigh heavily on her mind. In her memoir, she recounts the agonising dilemma she faced before reconciling herself to the political necessity of joining hands with the DMK to defeat the BJP. “For me the most challenging personal assignment was to bring into the alliance the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK), whose leader M. Karunanidhi was said to be unhappy with the Vajpayee government. It was the right moment to make contact, since of all the forces needed to come together to challenge the BJP, the DMK was the most important party in the south. I could sense that some of my colleagues from Tamil Nadu were keen on an alliance but didn’t know how to broach the subject to me. The DMK cadre had been at the time of the 1991 election vocal supporters of the LTTE, the terrorist group that had killed Rajiv; some in the party had openly threatened Rajiv,” she writes. She also recalls the Congress’s decision to withdraw support to the government of Prime Minister I.K. Gujral in November 1997 following the submission of the Jain Commission’s interim report, which inquired into Rajiv Gandhi’s assassination and criticised the DMK for its alleged support to the LTTE.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / Tamil Nadu InFocus / state politics / politics / arts, culture and entertainment

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 At least two Indians among 11 injured in Houthi attack in Saudi capital

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 07:22:41 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence said a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District came under what it described as a "terrorist attack" by Houthi militia

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two Indians and three Nepalese nationals were among 11 people injured on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) when Yemen's Houthi militia targeted a tower in the financial district of Saudi Arabia's capital, authorities said. Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence said 11 people were injured after the tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District came under what it described as a "terrorist attack" by Houthi militia. Those injured included two Saudi citizens, two Indian nationals, three Nepalese and four Egyptians, it said. It added that competent authorities immediately responded to the incident, implemented all approved procedures and measures for handling such situations, and took the necessary measures to protect lives and property. The Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia also confirmed that two Indian nationals sustained injuries in the attack. In a post on X, it said further details are being ascertained and all possible assistance will be extended to the injured persons and their families. Earlier, Saudi-led Coalition Spokesperson Maj Gen Turki Al Malki said a tower had been targeted in the financial district and that competent authorities were responding at the site. Meanwhile, the Indian embassy also asked Indian nationals residing in the Gulf country to abide by local rules and regulations.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Houthis have in the past claimed responsibility for attacks on Riyadh.

articles.title: IRISET takes Kavach training to campuses, signs MoUs with 26 engineering colleges
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: With the rollout of the indigenous train protection system ‘Kavach’ gaining pace, the Indian Railways Institute of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET) is taking its training efforts beyond the Railways, partnering 26 engineering colleges to build a wider pool of skilled professionals.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Of the 26 institutions that signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with IRISET, eight have introduced open elective courses on Kavach, the indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system. Addressing the institute’s annual day celebrations on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), Director General Piush Kumar Gupta said Kavach remains IRISET’s primary training focus. A two-week, design-oriented course has emerged as one of its most sought-after programmes among signalling and telecommunications professionals. So far, 187 officers and 1,031 supervisors have undergone training in these courses. 🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 IRISET takes Kavach training to campuses, signs MoUs with 26 engineering colleges

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 07:04:28 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: With the rollout of the indigenous train protection system ‘Kavach’ gaining pace, the Indian Railways Institute of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET) is taking its training efforts beyond the Railways, partnering 26 engineering colleges to build a wider pool of skilled professionals.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Of the 26 institutions that signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with IRISET, eight have introduced open elective courses on Kavach, the indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system. Addressing the institute’s annual day celebrations on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), Director General Piush Kumar Gupta said Kavach remains IRISET’s primary training focus. A two-week, design-oriented course has emerged as one of its most sought-after programmes among signalling and telecommunications professionals. So far, 187 officers and 1,031 supervisors have undergone training in these courses. A one-week crash course conducted last year trained 542 Signal and Telecommunications (S&T) officers to support the rapid rollout of Kavach across the railway network. The institute also conducted 14 customised courses on fitting Kavach equipment in locomotives for officers and supervisors from electric loco sheds and production units, benefiting 315 participants. In addition, 56 specialised programmes on signalling and Kavach were organised for 3,150 Chief Loco Inspectors (CLIs). IRISET also uploaded 18 online courses covering Kavach, signalling, telecommunications and information technology, with a combined duration of over 30 hours, on the iGOT Karmayogi portal. These courses have benefited more than 46,000 employees. To meet emerging technological requirements, the institute introduced five new courses covering cloud computing, big data analytics, data science, AI applications and cyber security. Established in 1957, IRISET conducted 261 training programmes for over 7,000 participants, recording a 50% increase in trainee-days over the previous year. It also trained 343 apprentices, including 175 signal engineers, 115 telecom engineers and 53 design engineers. Another 291 apprentices and 53 executives of the Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Ltd (DFCCIL) are currently undergoing training.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Its 20-part webinar series attracted over 3,200 railway and industry personnel. Besides mandatory courses on electronic interlocking, automatic block signalling, VoIP-based exchanges and LTE, the institute conducted practical and appreciation courses for 110 Indian Railway Management Service (IRMS) Traffic probationers and 60 B.Tech students of Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya. Faculty development programmes on AI and data science were also organised.

✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Technological' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.title: Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was removed deliberately to facilitate his killing: Rahul
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Priyanka Gandhi Vadra recalls an incident of slapping a classmate in school after he spoke ill of her uncle Sanjay Gandhi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was “removed” deliberately to facilitate his assassination, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has claimed in a video conversation with his mother, Sonia Gandhi, and sister, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, while discussing Ms. Gandhi’s memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love . “My position on it is very clear: Papa’s security was removed so that he got killed. Papa’s security removal was not just an accident, it was done on purpose. So that he got killed and the atmosphere was created for him to get killed,” Mr. Gandhi said in the video released on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The V.P. Singh government withdrew Rajiv Gandhi’s Special Protection Group cover in February 1990, after he ceased to be Prime Minister, transferring responsibility for his security outside Delhi to the respective State governments. He was assassinated by a Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam suicide bomber at Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu on May 21, 1991, when the State was under President’s Rule. The assassination continued to have political repercussions, with the Congress withdrawing support from the I.K. Gujral-led United Front government on November 28, 1997, after it rejected the party’s demand to drop DMK Ministers following the Justice M.C. Jain Commission’s interim report on the DMK’s alleged links with the LTTE. The three Gandhi family members revisited different chapters of their lives in the conversation, including the period following the Emergency and the defeat of Indira Gandhi in the 1977 general election. The proposal didn't go according to plan and neither did my seventh birthday. The decision in 2004 gave some of us relief but others joy. There was an intention behind withdrawing Papa's security. And even after 500+ pages there are some things Ma has left out of her book. Priyanka and I sat down with our mother to talk through all of it. Going back to those memories brought back the joy, the laughter and even the pain we felt at the time. Ma's journey of Belonging has been full of enormous love and terrible tragedy, and she has met all of it with dignity and courage. Ms. Vadra recalled slapping a boy at school after he taunted her over the arrest of her uncle, Sanjay Gandhi, following the Emergency. “After the Emergency, when dadi [Indira Gandhi] lost the election, we moved to a different house. I remember there was a lot of tension,” she said. Recalling her first day at school after Indira Gandhi lost her election, she said a boy told her, “ Tera chacha jail mein hai, chor hai tera chacha [Your uncle is in jail; your uncle is a thief]. So, I slapped him; then the boy went crying to the teacher and I got a scolding.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The siblings also recalled how differently they responded to their school environment. While Ms. Vadra described herself as someone who followed rules and was a school prefect, Mr. Gandhi said he was more rebellious and questioned authority.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was removed deliberately to facilitate his killing: Rahul

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 07:01:36 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Priyanka Gandhi Vadra recalls an incident of slapping a classmate in school after he spoke ill of her uncle Sanjay Gandhi

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was “removed” deliberately to facilitate his assassination, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has claimed in a video conversation with his mother, Sonia Gandhi, and sister, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, while discussing Ms. Gandhi’s memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love . “My position on it is very clear: Papa’s security was removed so that he got killed. Papa’s security removal was not just an accident, it was done on purpose. So that he got killed and the atmosphere was created for him to get killed,” Mr. Gandhi said in the video released on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). The V.P. Singh government withdrew Rajiv Gandhi’s Special Protection Group cover in February 1990, after he ceased to be Prime Minister, transferring responsibility for his security outside Delhi to the respective State governments. He was assassinated by a Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam suicide bomber at Sriperumbudur in Tamil Nadu on May 21, 1991, when the State was under President’s Rule. The assassination continued to have political repercussions, with the Congress withdrawing support from the I.K. Gujral-led United Front government on November 28, 1997, after it rejected the party’s demand to drop DMK Ministers following the Justice M.C. Jain Commission’s interim report on the DMK’s alleged links with the LTTE. The three Gandhi family members revisited different chapters of their lives in the conversation, including the period following the Emergency and the defeat of Indira Gandhi in the 1977 general election. The proposal didn't go according to plan and neither did my seventh birthday. The decision in 2004 gave some of us relief but others joy. There was an intention behind withdrawing Papa's security. And even after 500+ pages there are some things Ma has left out of her book. Priyanka and I sat down with our mother to talk through all of it. Going back to those memories brought back the joy, the laughter and even the pain we felt at the time. Ma's journey of Belonging has been full of enormous love and terrible tragedy, and she has met all of it with dignity and courage. Ms. Vadra recalled slapping a boy at school after he taunted her over the arrest of her uncle, Sanjay Gandhi, following the Emergency. “After the Emergency, when dadi [Indira Gandhi] lost the election, we moved to a different house. I remember there was a lot of tension,” she said. Recalling her first day at school after Indira Gandhi lost her election, she said a boy told her, “ Tera chacha jail mein hai, chor hai tera chacha [Your uncle is in jail; your uncle is a thief]. So, I slapped him; then the boy went crying to the teacher and I got a scolding.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The siblings also recalled how differently they responded to their school environment. While Ms. Vadra described herself as someone who followed rules and was a school prefect, Mr. Gandhi said he was more rebellious and questioned authority.

पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Assassination (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Assassination' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Conversation (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Conversation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was removed deliberately to facilitate his killing: Rahul", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Priyanka Gandhi Vadra recalls an incident of slapping a classmate in school after he spoke ill of her uncle Sanjay Gandhi.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was removed delibe' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was removed del' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was removed del' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Priyanka Gandhi Vadra recalls an incident of slapping a classmate in school after he spoke ill of her uncle Sanjay Gandhi." (Hinglish Arth: प्रियंका गांधी वाड्रा ने स्कूल में अपने चाचा संजय गांधी के बारे में बुरा बोलने पर एक सहपाठी को थप्पड़ मारने की घटना को याद किया)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Rajiv Gandhi’s security cover was removed deliberately to facilitate his killing: Rahul"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Gandhi said he was more rebellious and questioned authority.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Gandhi said he was more rebellious and questioned authority." (Hinglish Arth: गांधी ने कहा कि वह अधिक विद्रोही थे और प्राधिकार पर सवाल उठाते थे।)

📰 Tirunelveli POCSO Court magistrate suspended over misconduct allegations

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 06:28:13 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sources in the Tirunelveli Bar Association said Suresh Kumar had categorically rejected the allegations of misconduct levelled against him

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Judicial Magistrate of the Special Court for POCSO (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences) Cases in Tirunelveli, Suresh Kumar, has been placed under suspension over allegations of misconduct. Sources in Tirunelveli District Court said Mr. Suresh Kumar was facing allegations of misconduct when he was serving at the Mettupalayam Court in 2016. Following an inquiry conducted by the Madras High Court into these allegations, the suspension order was served on Mr. Suresh Kumar on Monday (November 23, 2026) night. Consequently, he did not attend court on Tuesday (November 24), the sources said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sources in the Tirunelveli Bar Association said Mr. Suresh Kumar had categorically rejected the allegations of misconduct levelled against him. “He strongly denied the charges made against him,” a senior office-bearer of the Tirunelveli Bar Association said.

articles.title: Trump administration set to unveil new tariffs after probe on excess factory capacity: sources
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose ‌new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Trump administration is poised ​to imminently release the findings of a probe aimed at countering alleged excess industrial capacity in 16 ⁠major U.S. trading partners, three people with knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), with new import duties on a wide range of goods expected. The results of the investigation are expected as soon as Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon, these people said. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose ‌new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term. The duties would partly replace tariffs struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court in February. The administration’s tariffs have in part ‌contributed to higher prices on consumer goods in the United States, and a Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll following November’s midterm elections ‌showed ⁠62% of respondents would support efforts to repeal the tariffs. It is unclear what tariff rates ⁠would be proposed. One of the people said that the duties would be specifically tailored to each country, with goods from Mexico and Norway unlikely to see any immediate levies. USTR has been investigating most of the US’s largest trading partners under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 over what it called ​evidence of excess industrial capacity. The White House is ‌expected to honor capped tariff rates that were included in finalized US trade deals with partner countries, this person said. These include duty caps of 15% on goods from the EU, Japan and South Korea and 19% for Malaysia. The U.S. also is expected to honor the 20% cap on Trump’s second-term tariffs on goods from China, as long as a ‌trade truce due to expire on January 10 is extended. If it expires, the Chinese excess capacity rate would ​rise to a higher level. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the White House did not respond to Reuters queries about the pending announcement. Ryan Majerus, a former senior Commerce Department trade official, said he ⁠expects a lengthy report that could include differentiated tariff remedies for each of the 16 trading partners.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Majerus, a partner with King & Spalding, said the administration could propose high tariff rates of 15% to 25% on imports from countries deemed to have excess capacity in various sectors. ‌Those levies would stack on top of existing tariffs of 10% or 12.5% imposed under a separate investigation into lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Trump administration set to unveil new tariffs after probe on excess factory capacity: sources

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 07:14:51 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose ‌new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Trump administration is poised ​to imminently release the findings of a probe aimed at countering alleged excess industrial capacity in 16 ⁠major U.S. trading partners, three people with knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), with new import duties on a wide range of goods expected. The results of the investigation are expected as soon as Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon, these people said. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose ‌new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term. The duties would partly replace tariffs struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court in February. The administration’s tariffs have in part ‌contributed to higher prices on consumer goods in the United States, and a Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll following November’s midterm elections ‌showed ⁠62% of respondents would support efforts to repeal the tariffs. It is unclear what tariff rates ⁠would be proposed. One of the people said that the duties would be specifically tailored to each country, with goods from Mexico and Norway unlikely to see any immediate levies. USTR has been investigating most of the US’s largest trading partners under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 over what it called ​evidence of excess industrial capacity. The White House is ‌expected to honor capped tariff rates that were included in finalized US trade deals with partner countries, this person said. These include duty caps of 15% on goods from the EU, Japan and South Korea and 19% for Malaysia. The U.S. also is expected to honor the 20% cap on Trump’s second-term tariffs on goods from China, as long as a ‌trade truce due to expire on January 10 is extended. If it expires, the Chinese excess capacity rate would ​rise to a higher level. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the White House did not respond to Reuters queries about the pending announcement. Ryan Majerus, a former senior Commerce Department trade official, said he ⁠expects a lengthy report that could include differentiated tariff remedies for each of the 16 trading partners.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Majerus, a partner with King & Spalding, said the administration could propose high tariff rates of 15% to 25% on imports from countries deemed to have excess capacity in various sectors. ‌Those levies would stack on top of existing tariffs of 10% or 12.5% imposed under a separate investigation into lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Representative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose ‌new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose ‌new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Trump administration is poised ​to imminently release the findings of a probe aimed at countering alleged excess industrial capacity in 16 ⁠major U.S. trading partners, three people with knowledge of the matter said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), with new import duties on a wide range of goods expected. The results of the investigation are expected as soon as Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon, these people said. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office is expected to propose ‌new duties that would stack on top of previous tariffs already imposed during President Donald Trump’s second term. The duties would partly replace tariffs struck down by the U.S. Supreme Court in February. The administration’s tariffs have in part ‌contributed to higher prices on consumer goods in the United States, and a Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll following November’s midterm elections ‌showed ⁠62% of respondents would support efforts to repeal the tariffs. It is unclear what tariff rates ⁠would be proposed. One of the people said that the duties would be specifically tailored to each country, with goods from Mexico and Norway unlikely to see any immediate levies. USTR has been investigating most of the US’s largest trading partners under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974 over what it called ​evidence of excess industrial capacity. The White House is ‌expected to honor capped tariff rates that were included in finalized US trade deals with partner countries, this person said. These include duty caps of 15% on goods from the EU, Japan and South Korea and 19% for Malaysia. The U.S. also is expected to honor the 20% cap on Trump’s second-term tariffs on goods from China, as long as a ‌trade truce due to expire on January 10 is extended. If it expires, the Chinese excess capacity rate would ​rise to a higher level. The U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the White House did not respond to Reuters queries about the pending announcement. Ryan Majerus, a former senior Commerce Department trade official, said he ⁠expects a lengthy report that could include differentiated tariff remedies for each of the 16 trading partners.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Majerus, a partner with King & Spalding, said the administration could propose high tariff rates of 15% to 25% on imports from countries deemed to have excess capacity in various sectors. ‌Those levies would stack on top of existing tariffs of 10% or 12.5% imposed under a separate investigation into lax enforcement of anti-forced labor laws.

articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy as comeback rally fades
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Jensen Huang told staff it was "not acceptable" that he had broken a code of conduct he had helped write, and dismissed suggestions that he was back because U.S. President Donald Trump had pressured the board

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Jensen Huang apologised to Nvidia staff and said he was in therapy on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as a stock rally triggered by his shock return as CEO faltered amid persistent doubts over the probes he faces and the fate of the AI investment boom. "I made some terrible mistakes," Mr. Huang told an hourlong all-hands meeting at the company's Santa Clara, California, headquarters, The New York Times reported after reviewing a livestream of the event. He told staff it was "not acceptable" that he had broken a code of conduct he had helped write, and dismissed suggestions that he was back because U.S. President Donald Trump had pressured the board. But Mr. Trump told CNBC on Monday (November 23, 2026) that he had been in contact with directors about Mr. Huang's return. "I spoke to them, let me put it that way," he said. "And I convinced them." After vaulting more than 30% on Monday (November 23, 2026), Nvidia shares were down about six percent at close on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). "The optimism faded quickly" for Nvidia, wrote Fawad Razaqzada of Forex.com, with "questions over corporate governance and board oversight still lingering." So far Monday's surge was a "one day wonder...We are not seeing an upside follow through today at all," said Ken Mahoney, president and CEO of Mahoney Asset Management. Mr. Huang resigned on November 12 over extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, a departure that sent shares in Nvidia and companies closely linked to the AI buildout tumbling. Mr. Trump was reportedly talked into backing the return of the Taiwan-born CEO after top tech investors told him the U.S. economy and Wall Street depended on it.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia said Monday (November 23, 2026) that it had reinstated Mr. Huang as chief executive after receiving information from the US government that he did not pose a national security risk.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy as comeback rally fades

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:08:43 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Jensen Huang told staff it was "not acceptable" that he had broken a code of conduct he had helped write, and dismissed suggestions that he was back because U.S. President Donald Trump had pressured the board

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Jensen Huang apologised to Nvidia staff and said he was in therapy on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as a stock rally triggered by his shock return as CEO faltered amid persistent doubts over the probes he faces and the fate of the AI investment boom. "I made some terrible mistakes," Mr. Huang told an hourlong all-hands meeting at the company's Santa Clara, California, headquarters, The New York Times reported after reviewing a livestream of the event. He told staff it was "not acceptable" that he had broken a code of conduct he had helped write, and dismissed suggestions that he was back because U.S. President Donald Trump had pressured the board. But Mr. Trump told CNBC on Monday (November 23, 2026) that he had been in contact with directors about Mr. Huang's return. "I spoke to them, let me put it that way," he said. "And I convinced them." After vaulting more than 30% on Monday (November 23, 2026), Nvidia shares were down about six percent at close on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). "The optimism faded quickly" for Nvidia, wrote Fawad Razaqzada of Forex.com, with "questions over corporate governance and board oversight still lingering." So far Monday's surge was a "one day wonder...We are not seeing an upside follow through today at all," said Ken Mahoney, president and CEO of Mahoney Asset Management. Mr. Huang resigned on November 12 over extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, a departure that sent shares in Nvidia and companies closely linked to the AI buildout tumbling. Mr. Trump was reportedly talked into backing the return of the Taiwan-born CEO after top tech investors told him the U.S. economy and Wall Street depended on it.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia said Monday (November 23, 2026) that it had reinstated Mr. Huang as chief executive after receiving information from the US government that he did not pose a national security risk.

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Extramarital' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Information' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Investment (Adjective)
निवेश — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Investment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Governance (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Governance' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy as comeback rally fades", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Jensen Huang told staff it was "not acceptable" that he had broken a code of conduct he had helped write, and dismissed suggestions that he was back...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy as c' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy a' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy a' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Jensen Huang told staff it was "not acceptable" that he had broken a code of conduct he had helped write, and dismissed suggestions that he was back..." (Hinglish Arth: जेन्सेन हुआंग ने कर्मचारियों से कहा कि यह "स्वीकार्य नहीं" है कि उन्होंने उस आचार संहिता को तोड़ दिया है जिसे लिखने में उन्होंने मदद की थी, और उन सुझावों को खारिज कर दिया कि वह वापस आ गए थे क्योंकि यू.एस.)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he is in therapy as comeback rally fades"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Huang as chief executive after receiving information from the US government that he did not pose a national security risk.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Huang as chief executive after receiving information from the US government that he did not pose a national security risk." (Hinglish Arth: अमेरिकी सरकार से जानकारी मिलने के बाद हुआंग को मुख्य कार्यकारी नियुक्त किया गया कि उन्होंने राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा को खतरा पैदा नहीं किया है।)

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China’s ​Shenzhou-24 space flight launched successfully on ‌Wednesday (November 25, 2026) morning, with its three-man crew ​including a Pakistani ⁠national , who will be the first foreign astronaut to board the Tiangong space ‌station. Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China . Zeeshan Ali, a 40-year-old pilot who will become the first Pakistani in ​orbit, will ‌work as a payload specialist and is set to stay at the station for 5 to ‌10 days, conducting experiments. He ​is accompanied by Chinese commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer ⁠Wu Yi. China is promoting Tiangong as a hub for international cooperation ‌while the NASA-led International Space Station faces possible retirement by 2030. To prepare for the flight, Ali trained for seven months in Beijing, during which he ‌underwent intensive Chinese-language classes, learning Chinese songs ​and reading Chinese poetry. He also practised calligraphy and played ⁠table tennis.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “I’m not flying for myself. ⁠I carry the name of Pakistan on my shoulder,” ‌Ali told reporters on Tuesday (November 24, 2026).

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 China’s Shenzhou-24 space flight takes off with Pakistani national as first foreign astronaut

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 06:47:05 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China’s ​Shenzhou-24 space flight launched successfully on ‌Wednesday (November 25, 2026) morning, with its three-man crew ​including a Pakistani ⁠national , who will be the first foreign astronaut to board the Tiangong space ‌station. Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China . Zeeshan Ali, a 40-year-old pilot who will become the first Pakistani in ​orbit, will ‌work as a payload specialist and is set to stay at the station for 5 to ‌10 days, conducting experiments. He ​is accompanied by Chinese commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer ⁠Wu Yi. China is promoting Tiangong as a hub for international cooperation ‌while the NASA-led International Space Station faces possible retirement by 2030. To prepare for the flight, Ali trained for seven months in Beijing, during which he ‌underwent intensive Chinese-language classes, learning Chinese songs ​and reading Chinese poetry. He also practised calligraphy and played ⁠table tennis.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “I’m not flying for myself. ⁠I carry the name of Pakistan on my shoulder,” ‌Ali told reporters on Tuesday (November 24, 2026).

गहन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intensive' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: Microsoft declares ‘Code Red’ after historic outage, internal memos show
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The November 12-13 outage ​hit governments from Australia and Japan to the United States, delayed trading firms ⁠and disrupted airline communications, fueling broader concerns about the vulnerability of critical digital infrastructure

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microsoft has declared a “Code Red” drive to ​overhaul how it prevents and responds to major service failures after a 24-hour outage exposed shortcomings in its engineering ‌systems and crisis response, according to internal memos reviewed by Reuters. The November 12-13 outage ​hit governments from Australia and Japan to the United States, delayed trading firms ⁠and disrupted airline communications, fueling broader concerns about the vulnerability of critical digital infrastructure. Microsoft said the incident was not related to cyber activity or AI agents. Microsoft blamed the outage on an undetected Windows scalability defect introduced in July. CEO ‌Satya Nadella publicly apologized for the disruption. The Code Red signified the most severe and urgent alert to address weaknesses in Microsoft’s engineering and operational practices after the outage disrupted ‌Exchange Online, its cloud-based email service, as well as Outlook, Teams, its Copilot AI assistant and ‌other ⁠Microsoft 365 products. It was the most customer-impacting incident in the history of Exchange Online, ⁠M365 Core President Jason Henderson said in a memo to staff on Friday. Never before had so many customers been without email for so long, he said. “Code Red means that this is the highest priority work for our team,” Henderson added. Job cuts, retirement plan, voluntary exits: What’s going on at Microsoft? Microsoft says services fully restored after hourslong global outage Microsoft outage hits businesses worldwide; India feels impact

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Amanda ​Silver, Microsoft’s corporate vice president overseeing M365 ‌Core and Work IQ, the company’s workplace intelligence platform for AI agents, said in a separate memo on Monday that engineers had to work through a “fog of war” as the outage unfolded.

📰 Microsoft declares ‘Code Red’ after historic outage, internal memos show

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The November 12-13 outage ​hit governments from Australia and Japan to the United States, delayed trading firms ⁠and disrupted airline communications, fueling broader concerns about the vulnerability of critical digital infrastructure

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Microsoft has declared a “Code Red” drive to ​overhaul how it prevents and responds to major service failures after a 24-hour outage exposed shortcomings in its engineering ‌systems and crisis response, according to internal memos reviewed by Reuters. The November 12-13 outage ​hit governments from Australia and Japan to the United States, delayed trading firms ⁠and disrupted airline communications, fueling broader concerns about the vulnerability of critical digital infrastructure. Microsoft said the incident was not related to cyber activity or AI agents. Microsoft blamed the outage on an undetected Windows scalability defect introduced in July. CEO ‌Satya Nadella publicly apologized for the disruption. The Code Red signified the most severe and urgent alert to address weaknesses in Microsoft’s engineering and operational practices after the outage disrupted ‌Exchange Online, its cloud-based email service, as well as Outlook, Teams, its Copilot AI assistant and ‌other ⁠Microsoft 365 products. It was the most customer-impacting incident in the history of Exchange Online, ⁠M365 Core President Jason Henderson said in a memo to staff on Friday. Never before had so many customers been without email for so long, he said. “Code Red means that this is the highest priority work for our team,” Henderson added. 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Amanda ​Silver, Microsoft’s corporate vice president overseeing M365 ‌Core and Work IQ, the company’s workplace intelligence platform for AI agents, said in a separate memo on Monday that engineers had to work through a “fog of war” as the outage unfolded.

articles.title: Kerala HC declines to interfere with State govt’s reconstitution of Waqf Board
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Court says State Waqf Board was already functional

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Kerala High Court on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) declined to interfere with the Keralam government’s decision to reconstitute the State Waqf Board, saying that it was already functional. A Bench of justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji was hearing appeals by K S Hamza and C K Usman Haji, the former chairperson and member of the earlier board that was disbanded barely eight months into its five-year term, against a single judge order declining to stay the reconstitution of the board. The single judge, on October 17, had refused to stay the reconstitution of the board but said that it would be subject to the outcome of the petitions challenging the same. The judge had also tagged the petitions by Hamza and Haji with the earlier PILs – challenging the validity of the previous and now disbanded board – which were pending before a Bench headed by Chief Justice Soumen Sen. However, the Bench headed by the Chief Justice on October 19 dismissed the PILs as the board had been reconstituted.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Tuesday, the Bench of justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji directed the Registry that the earlier petitions of Hamza and Haji be listed before the appropriate Bench.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Kerala HC declines to interfere with State govt’s reconstitution of Waqf Board

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 09:29:14 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Court says State Waqf Board was already functional

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Kerala High Court on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) declined to interfere with the Keralam government’s decision to reconstitute the State Waqf Board, saying that it was already functional. A Bench of justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji was hearing appeals by K S Hamza and C K Usman Haji, the former chairperson and member of the earlier board that was disbanded barely eight months into its five-year term, against a single judge order declining to stay the reconstitution of the board. The single judge, on October 17, had refused to stay the reconstitution of the board but said that it would be subject to the outcome of the petitions challenging the same. The judge had also tagged the petitions by Hamza and Haji with the earlier PILs – challenging the validity of the previous and now disbanded board – which were pending before a Bench headed by Chief Justice Soumen Sen. However, the Bench headed by the Chief Justice on October 19 dismissed the PILs as the board had been reconstituted.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: On Tuesday, the Bench of justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji directed the Registry that the earlier petitions of Hamza and Haji be listed before the appropriate Bench.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Reconstitution (Noun)
पुनर्गठन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Reconstitution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Functional (Adjective)
कार्यात्मक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Functional' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Validity (Noun)
वैधता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Validity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Previous (Adjective)
पहले का — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Previous' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kerala HC declines to interfere with State govt’s reconstitution of Waqf Board", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Court says State Waqf Board was already functional.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kerala HC declines to interfere with State govt’' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kerala HC declines to interfere with State go' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kerala HC declines to interfere with State go' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Court says State Waqf Board was already functional." (Hinglish Arth: कोर्ट का कहना है कि राज्य वक्फ बोर्ड पहले से ही कार्यरत था)

B. On Tuesday, the Bench of justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji directed the Registry that the earlier petitions of Hamza and Haji be listed...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. (Hinglish Arth: मंगलवार को जस्टिस देवन रामचंद्रन और बसंत बालाजी की बेंच ने रजिस्ट्री को निर्देश दिया कि हमजा और हाजी की पिछली याचिकाओं को उचित बेंच के समक्ष सूचीबद्ध किया जाए।)

articles.title: Thirupparankundram 'deepathoon' row LIVE: Temple says Karthigai Deepam lit at Thiruparankundram hill 'as per age-old tradition'
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Arulmighu Subramanian Swamy Temple administration stated that it had followed 'age-old traditions and Agama rules' by lighting the maha deepam at the traditional Uchipillayar deepa mandapam. Meanwhile, police detained protesters outside the Thirupparankundram temple

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mannargudi Sendalangara Jeeyar has criticised the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister after the Karthigai Deepam was not lit at the disputed Deepathoon pillar despite the Supreme Court’s interim order. He accused the CM of misleading devotees and alleged that political considerations had driven the handling of the issue. The Karthigai Deepam flame continues to burn at Uchi Pillaiyar Deepa Mandapam near the Subramaniya Swami Temple in Madurai, instead of the disputed Deepathoon pillar atop Thiruparankundram hill. Karthigai Deepam lit at the traditional Thirupparankundram spot as SC-case compliance unfolds amid protests over Deepathoon controversy. Slamming the TVK Government for stopping him from proceeding to Madurai for lighting of Karthigai Deepam atop Tirupparankundram Hill, Hindu Munnani State president Kadeshwara Subramaniam said in Tiruppur on Tuesday that the regime will collapse due to an uprising of people. Read more The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) passed a John Doe order restraining “the members of the general public” (i.e., anyone) from calling for violating the November 20 Supreme Court order allowing the lighting of the lamp, as a “limited one-time arrangement”, on the newly-identified ‘ deepathoon’ (stone pillar) on Thirupparankundram hillock in Madurai for karthigai deepam. It also recorded the Madurai Collector’s assurance that steps were being taken to comply with the Supreme Court’s directions. HC passes John Doe order restraining anyone from calling for violation of deepathoon order Madurai High Court restrains public calls to violate Supreme Court order on Karthigai Deepam deepathoon lighting. Madurai High Court restrains public calls to violate Supreme Court order on Karthigai Deepam deepathoon lighting. Police personnel deployed for security at the Thirupparankundram foothills detained several protesters who gathered to stage a demonstration outside the Sri Subramaniaswamy Temple. The demonstrators, mostly affiliated with the BJP and other Hindu outfits, resisted arrest and attempted to damage public property, prompting police to forcefully detain and remove them from the site.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Thousands of officers stationed across the area under the supervision of Madurai Commissioner of Police S. Rajendiran managed to round up protesters scattered throughout the vicinity.

articles.title: Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? | Explained
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Why has FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? What made the water sample unsafe? What are the health risks of bromate and PAHs? How is packaged drinking water regulated in India? What safety checks must bottled water manufacturers follow? What risks do plastic bottles pose to consumers?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: On November 22, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), the country’s apex food-safety regulator, sanctioned prosecution against packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International Pvt. Ltd. after a sample of its water was found to be non-compliant with prescribed safety standards, with the regulator declaring it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The public-health stakes are significant. In 2023, bottled water was the principal source of drinking water for 15% of urban and 6% of rural households, as per Data For India. For consumers buying it at railway stations, airports, highway eateries and neighbourhood shops, a sealed bottle is often taken as an assurance of safety. Yet, the data submitted in Parliament in February 2025 revealed that 333 of 1,300 enforcement samples of packaged drinking water tested in 2023-24 failed to meet prescribed standards. Similarly, in 2022-23, 650 of 1,776 samples had been found non-compliant. According to the FSSAI, a sample of packaged drinking water (other than mineral water) collected from Bisleri’s premises was found to be non-compliant with the prescribed limits for “bromate” and was declared unsafe under the 2006 Act. Following an appeal by the food business operator (FBO), the sample was referred to a Referral Food Laboratory for further examination, which also declared the sample unsafe, citing the detection of “polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons” (PAHs). In its response, Bisleri has maintained that its water is safe for consumption, saying the matter concerned a batch manufactured at its Goa facility in September 2025, one of 143 manufacturing plants in its network. In a statement issued on November 23, the company said the FSSAI had collected six samples from its Goa facility on September 30, 2025. While five samples met the prescribed standards, the sixth recorded a “bromate” level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre. Further, Bisleri said it appealed on November 22, 2025, following which the sample was sent to a referral laboratory for retesting. The laboratory, as claimed, found the bromate level within the prescribed limit but separately detected PAHs. Citing the divergent test findings, the company reportedly arranged an independent examination of the same sample at an FSSAI-approved laboratory, which, according to Bisleri, also found the bromate level within limits. The company said it submitted these results to FSSAI’s Western Regional Office on February 2, 2026, but received no further communication and understood that the matter had been closed. Water is essential for digestion, blood circulation, temperature regulation and kidney function, but its safety cannot be judged by its appearance, taste, odour or sealed packaging alone. Contamination may be microbiological, causing illnesses such as diarrhoea, cholera and typhoid, or chemical, with some substances posing risks through prolonged exposure. In India, packaged water broadly falls into two categories: (1) “packaged drinking water”, which may be sourced from surface water, groundwater or seawater and treated through processes such as filtration, decantation, reverse osmosis (RO) and disinfection; and (2) “natural mineral water”, drawn from protected underground sources and characterised by a relatively stable mineral composition. Both must meet prescribed chemical and microbiological safety standards.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Hindu Explains / Text and Context / drinking water / water

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — भारत में पैकेज्ड पेयजल को कैसे नियंत्रित किया जाता है?।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एफएसएसएआई के अनुसार, बिसलेरी के परिसर से एकत्र किए गए पैकेज्ड ड्रिंकिंग वॉटर (मिनरल वॉटर के अलावा) का एक नमूना "ब्रोमेट" की निर्धारित सीमा के अनुरूप नहीं पाया गया और 2006 अधिनियम के तहत इसे असुरक्षित घोषित कर दिया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Following an appeal by the food business operator (FBO), the sample was referred to a Referral Food Laboratory for further examination, which also declared the sample unsafe, citing the detection of “polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons” (PAHs).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — खाद्य व्यवसाय संचालक (एफबीओ) की अपील के बाद, नमूने को आगे की जांच के लिए रेफरल खाद्य प्रयोगशाला में भेजा गया, जिसने "पॉलीन्यूक्लियर एरोमैटिक हाइड्रोकार्बन" (पीएएच) का पता लगाने का हवाला देते हुए नमूने को असुरक्षित घोषित कर दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: In its response, Bisleri has maintained that its water is safe for consumption, saying the matter concerned a batch manufactured at its Goa facility in September 2025, one of 143 manufacturing plants in its network.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अपने जवाब में, बिसलेरी ने कहा है कि उसका पानी उपभोग के लिए सुरक्षित है, यह कहते हुए कि मामला सितंबर 2025 में उसकी गोवा सुविधा में निर्मित एक बैच से संबंधित है, जो उसके नेटवर्क में 143 विनिर्माण संयंत्रों में से एक है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In a statement issued on November 23, the company said the FSSAI had collected six samples from its Goa facility on September 30, 2025.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — 23 नवंबर को जारी एक बयान में, कंपनी ने कहा कि एफएसएसएआई ने 30 सितंबर, 2025 को अपनी गोवा सुविधा से छह नमूने एकत्र किए थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: While five samples met the prescribed standards, the sixth recorded a “bromate” level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जहां पांच नमूने निर्धारित मानकों पर खरे उतरे, वहीं छठे में 10 माइक्रोग्राम प्रति लीटर की निर्धारित सीमा के मुकाबले 12 माइक्रोग्राम प्रति लीटर का "ब्रोमेट" स्तर दर्ज किया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Further, Bisleri said it appealed on November 22, 2025, following which the sample was sent to a referral laboratory for retesting.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसके अलावा, बिसलेरी ने कहा कि उसने 22 नवंबर, 2025 को अपील की, जिसके बाद नमूना को पुन: परीक्षण के लिए एक रेफरल प्रयोगशाला में भेजा गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The laboratory, as claimed, found the bromate level within the prescribed limit but separately detected PAHs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — जैसा कि दावा किया गया है, प्रयोगशाला ने ब्रोमेट का स्तर निर्धारित सीमा के भीतर पाया लेकिन पीएएच का अलग से पता लगाया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Citing the divergent test findings, the company reportedly arranged an independent examination of the same sample at an FSSAI-approved laboratory, which, according to Bisleri, also found the bromate level within limits.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अलग-अलग परीक्षण निष्कर्षों का हवाला देते हुए, कंपनी ने कथित तौर पर एफएसएसएआई-अनुमोदित प्रयोगशाला में उसी नमूने की एक स्वतंत्र जांच की व्यवस्था की, जिसमें बिसलेरी के अनुसार, ब्रोमेट का स्तर भी सीमा के भीतर पाया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The company said it submitted these results to FSSAI’s Western Regional Office on February 2, 2026, but received no further communication and understood that the matter had been closed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कंपनी ने कहा कि उसने ये नतीजे 2 फरवरी, 2026 को FSSAI के पश्चिमी क्षेत्रीय कार्यालय को सौंप दिए, लेकिन आगे कोई संचार नहीं मिला और समझ गया कि मामला बंद कर दिया गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Communication' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Communication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Water is essential for digestion, blood circulation, temperature regulation and kidney function, but its safety cannot be judged by its appearance, taste, odour or sealed packaging alone.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पानी पाचन, रक्त परिसंचरण, तापमान विनियमन और गुर्दे के कार्य के लिए आवश्यक है, लेकिन इसकी सुरक्षा का आकलन केवल इसकी उपस्थिति, स्वाद, गंध या सीलबंद पैकेजिंग से नहीं किया जा सकता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Contamination may be microbiological, causing illnesses such as diarrhoea, cholera and typhoid, or chemical, with some substances posing risks through prolonged exposure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — संदूषण सूक्ष्मजीवविज्ञानी हो सकता है, जिससे दस्त, हैजा और टाइफाइड जैसी बीमारियाँ हो सकती हैं, या रासायनिक, कुछ पदार्थ लंबे समय तक संपर्क में रहने से जोखिम पैदा कर सकते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Microbiological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जीवाणुतत्व-संबंधी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Microbiological' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: In India, packaged water broadly falls into two categories: (1) “packaged drinking water”, which may be sourced from surface water, groundwater or seawater and treated through processes such as filtration, decantation, reverse osmosis (RO) and disinfection; and (2) “natural mineral water”, drawn from protected underground sources and characterised by a relatively stable mineral composition.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — भारत में, पैकेज्ड पानी मोटे तौर पर दो श्रेणियों में आता है: (1) "पैकेज्ड पीने का पानी", जो सतही जल, भूजल या समुद्री जल से प्राप्त किया जा सकता है और निस्पंदन, निस्तारण, रिवर्स ऑस्मोसिस (आरओ) और कीटाणुशोधन जैसी प्रक्रियाओं के माध्यम से इलाज किया जा सकता है; और (2) "प्राकृतिक खनिज जल", संरक्षित भूमिगत स्रोतों से प्राप्त होता है और इसकी विशेषता अपेक्षाकृत स्थिर खनिज संरचना होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Both must meet prescribed chemical and microbiological safety standards.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दोनों को निर्धारित रासायनिक और सूक्ष्मजीवविज्ञानी सुरक्षा मानकों को पूरा करना होगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Microbiological' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जीवाणुतत्व-संबंधी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Microbiological' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #27 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? | Explained

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:03:35 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Why has FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? What made the water sample unsafe? What are the health risks of bromate and PAHs? How is packaged drinking water regulated in India? What safety checks must bottled water manufacturers follow? What risks do plastic bottles pose to consumers?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: On November 22, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), the country’s apex food-safety regulator, sanctioned prosecution against packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International Pvt. Ltd. after a sample of its water was found to be non-compliant with prescribed safety standards, with the regulator declaring it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The public-health stakes are significant. In 2023, bottled water was the principal source of drinking water for 15% of urban and 6% of rural households, as per Data For India. For consumers buying it at railway stations, airports, highway eateries and neighbourhood shops, a sealed bottle is often taken as an assurance of safety. Yet, the data submitted in Parliament in February 2025 revealed that 333 of 1,300 enforcement samples of packaged drinking water tested in 2023-24 failed to meet prescribed standards. Similarly, in 2022-23, 650 of 1,776 samples had been found non-compliant. According to the FSSAI, a sample of packaged drinking water (other than mineral water) collected from Bisleri’s premises was found to be non-compliant with the prescribed limits for “bromate” and was declared unsafe under the 2006 Act. Following an appeal by the food business operator (FBO), the sample was referred to a Referral Food Laboratory for further examination, which also declared the sample unsafe, citing the detection of “polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons” (PAHs). In its response, Bisleri has maintained that its water is safe for consumption, saying the matter concerned a batch manufactured at its Goa facility in September 2025, one of 143 manufacturing plants in its network. In a statement issued on November 23, the company said the FSSAI had collected six samples from its Goa facility on September 30, 2025. While five samples met the prescribed standards, the sixth recorded a “bromate” level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre. Further, Bisleri said it appealed on November 22, 2025, following which the sample was sent to a referral laboratory for retesting. The laboratory, as claimed, found the bromate level within the prescribed limit but separately detected PAHs. Citing the divergent test findings, the company reportedly arranged an independent examination of the same sample at an FSSAI-approved laboratory, which, according to Bisleri, also found the bromate level within limits. The company said it submitted these results to FSSAI’s Western Regional Office on February 2, 2026, but received no further communication and understood that the matter had been closed. Water is essential for digestion, blood circulation, temperature regulation and kidney function, but its safety cannot be judged by its appearance, taste, odour or sealed packaging alone. Contamination may be microbiological, causing illnesses such as diarrhoea, cholera and typhoid, or chemical, with some substances posing risks through prolonged exposure. In India, packaged water broadly falls into two categories: (1) “packaged drinking water”, which may be sourced from surface water, groundwater or seawater and treated through processes such as filtration, decantation, reverse osmosis (RO) and disinfection; and (2) “natural mineral water”, drawn from protected underground sources and characterised by a relatively stable mineral composition. Both must meet prescribed chemical and microbiological safety standards.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Hindu Explains / Text and Context / drinking water / water

सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।

जीवाणुतत्व-संबंधी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Microbiological' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Communication (Noun)
संचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Communication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

A. Why has FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri?.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution agai' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution agai' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Why has FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri?." (Hinglish Arth: FSSAI ने बिसलेरी के खिलाफ अभियोजन की मंजूरी क्यों दी है?)

A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The Hindu Explains / Text and Context / drinking water / water.

D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The Hindu Explains / Text and Context / drinking water / water." (Hinglish Arth: द हिंदू स्पष्टीकरण / पाठ और संदर्भ / पीने का पानी / पानी)

articles.title: No power can harm India as long as it reveres Sikh Gurus, says U.P. CM Adityanath
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The sacrifice, penance, martyrdom, and spiritual consciousness of the Sikh Gurus are invaluable treasures of India’s national unity, social harmony, and cultural pride

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) said that no power in the world will be able to harm India as long as it continues to hold Sikh Gurus in reverence and respect. “The sacrifice, penance, martyrdom, and spiritual consciousness of the Sikh Gurus are invaluable treasures of India’s national unity, social harmony, and cultural pride,” Mr. Adityanath said, addressing a program organised on the occasion of the 557th Prakash Parv of Sahib Shri Guru Nanak Dev Ji in Lucknow . “Through ‘Ek Onkar’, Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj gave the message of uniting all humanity. His teachings remain as relevant today as they were then. We must not confine these teachings to events and celebrations alone, but imbibe them in our lives and continuously familiarize the younger generation with them as well,” he added. 🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 No power can harm India as long as it reveres Sikh Gurus, says U.P. CM Adityanath

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 08:20:22 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The sacrifice, penance, martyrdom, and spiritual consciousness of the Sikh Gurus are invaluable treasures of India’s national unity, social harmony, and cultural pride

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) said that no power in the world will be able to harm India as long as it continues to hold Sikh Gurus in reverence and respect. “The sacrifice, penance, martyrdom, and spiritual consciousness of the Sikh Gurus are invaluable treasures of India’s national unity, social harmony, and cultural pride,” Mr. Adityanath said, addressing a program organised on the occasion of the 557th Prakash Parv of Sahib Shri Guru Nanak Dev Ji in Lucknow . “Through ‘Ek Onkar’, Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj gave the message of uniting all humanity. His teachings remain as relevant today as they were then. We must not confine these teachings to events and celebrations alone, but imbibe them in our lives and continuously familiarize the younger generation with them as well,” he added. Referring to the spiritual and religious significance of Kartik Purnima, the U.P. Chief Minister said, “Today is an extremely sacred day for entire state. Since 4 am, I have been receiving updates on the number of devotees and arrangements at various religious sites across the state. At Shukratal in Muzaffarnagar, lakhs of devotees are taking a holy dip in the Ganga. At Garhmukteshwar in Hapur, approximately 15 lakh devotees took a holy dip on Tuesday. Meanhwhile, more than 15 lakh devotees took a dip of faith in the Ganga at Tigri in Amroha. A large number of devotees also arrived in Prayagraj and Farrukhabad, while lakhs of them visited the Ganga in Ayodhya and Kashi,”. Referring to the journeys undertaken by Guru Nanak Dev Ji and social conditions prevailing during his time, Mr. Adityanath said, “When he conveyed the message of unity to humanity, society was grappling with numerous social evils and divisions. Society was fragmented in the name of caste, untouchability and discrimination. At the same time, he said foreign invasions and external attacks posed challenges. During such difficult times, Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj united all humanity through the mantra of ‘Ek Onkar’. His clear message was that God is one and we are all His children. Therefore, every human being deserves equal respect. This mantra, given by him, became a great force for uniting society at that time, and it remains relevant even today. Despite limited means and resources, Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj traveled to various places and spread the message of humanity, equality and spiritual consciousness among the masses,”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Explaining the three principal teachings of Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj, ‘Naam Japo, Kirat Karo, Vand Chhako’, the U.P. CM added, “Remembering God, performing kirtan and embracing the spirit of togetherness generate positive feelings within human beings. This dispels ignorance and awakens the strength of unity in society,”..
