articles.title: Global climate talks must shut door on fossil fuel ‘clout’
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation. It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public. The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement. UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations. Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though. Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback. The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse. But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process. A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed. The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses. The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters. The fossil fuel industry’s record of muddying the waters is well documented. A 2017 study by Geoffrey Supran and Naomi Oreskes compared 187 ExxonMobil communications between 1977 and 2014, including internal documents, scientific publications and paid newspaper advertorials. It found that as the company’s communications became more public, they increasingly expressed doubt about climate science. The researchers concluded that ExxonMobil had contributed to climate science while promoting doubt about it in its advertorials. An industry team discussed a 1998 draft of the Global Climate Science Communications Plan at the American Petroleum Institute’s headquarters. The plan’s stated goal was to persuade a majority of the American public that significant uncertainties remained in climate science and to raise questions among policymakers. This history matters because companies with large investments in oil, gas and coal have a financial stake in how quickly those fuels are phased down, which technologies receive support and how the costs of the transition are distributed. That does not mean every company representative at a climate summit is there to obstruct progress, or that attendance proves influence over a decision. It, however, does mean commercial interests need to be visible and the process needs rules to prevent undue influence. The scale of corporate participation in Antalya brings the issue into sharper focus. An analysis by a coalition of non-profits identified 103 major polluter groups with delegations at the summit, including fossil fuel businesses, financiers and companies from other high-emitting sectors. It also identified 30 banks whose fossil fuel financing between 2021 and 2025 amounted to more than $2.2 trillion. These are the coalition’s classifications, not official UN figures. They do not establish that the companies or banks influenced the negotiations. But they show the scale of commercial interests present at a conference whose purpose is to limit global warming.

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation. It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public. The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement. UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations. Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though. Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback. The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse. But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process. A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed. The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses. The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters. The fossil fuel industry’s record of muddying the waters is well documented. A 2017 study by Geoffrey Supran and Naomi Oreskes compared 187 ExxonMobil communications between 1977 and 2014, including internal documents, scientific publications and paid newspaper advertorials. It found that as the company’s communications became more public, they increasingly expressed doubt about climate science. The researchers concluded that ExxonMobil had contributed to climate science while promoting doubt about it in its advertorials. An industry team discussed a 1998 draft of the Global Climate Science Communications Plan at the American Petroleum Institute’s headquarters. The plan’s stated goal was to persuade a majority of the American public that significant uncertainties remained in climate science and to raise questions among policymakers. This history matters because companies with large investments in oil, gas and coal have a financial stake in how quickly those fuels are phased down, which technologies receive support and how the costs of the transition are distributed. That does not mean every company representative at a climate summit is there to obstruct progress, or that attendance proves influence over a decision. It, however, does mean commercial interests need to be visible and the process needs rules to prevent undue influence. The scale of corporate participation in Antalya brings the issue into sharper focus. An analysis by a coalition of non-profits identified 103 major polluter groups with delegations at the summit, including fossil fuel businesses, financiers and companies from other high-emitting sectors. It also identified 30 banks whose fossil fuel financing between 2021 and 2025 amounted to more than $2.2 trillion. These are the coalition’s classifications, not official UN figures. They do not establish that the companies or banks influenced the negotiations. But they show the scale of commercial interests present at a conference whose purpose is to limit global warming.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Lien Vandamme of the Center for International Environmental Law says the problem goes beyond the number of corporate participants. Although the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) has introduced limited disclosure requirements, she argues that it still lacks a policy to curb corporate influence. “There is currently no policy to curb corporate influence within the UNFCCC process, and this is a fundamental problem,” she says. Once companies gain access, she argues, it becomes extremely difficult to monitor how they use it to influence negotiations.

articles.title: China to launch Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on April 24
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Shenzhou-20 spaceflight will carry three astronauts namely Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui and Wang Jie

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China has set the launch for its Shenzhou-20 mission that will carry three astronauts to the Chinese space station for Thursday (April 24, 2025) at 5.17 p.m. local time (IST 2:47 p.m.), state media said on Wednesday (April 23, 2025). The main purpose of the mission is to complete the in-orbit rotation with the Shenzhou-19 crew which is scheduled to return to the Dongfeng landing site on April 29, officials said at a press conference broadcast on CCTV . The Shenzhou-20 spaceflight will carry astronauts Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui and Wang Jie, CCTV said. They will conduct space science and application experiments, install a space debris protection device as well as extravehicular payload and equipment, and perform recovery tasks.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The mission will also bring with it zebrafish, planarians and streptomyces as research objects to carry out three life science experiments at the space station.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 China to launch Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on April 24

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:49:16 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Shenzhou-20 spaceflight will carry three astronauts namely Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui and Wang Jie

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China has set the launch for its Shenzhou-20 mission that will carry three astronauts to the Chinese space station for Thursday (April 24, 2025) at 5.17 p.m. local time (IST 2:47 p.m.), state media said on Wednesday (April 23, 2025). The main purpose of the mission is to complete the in-orbit rotation with the Shenzhou-19 crew which is scheduled to return to the Dongfeng landing site on April 29, officials said at a press conference broadcast on CCTV . The Shenzhou-20 spaceflight will carry astronauts Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui and Wang Jie, CCTV said. They will conduct space science and application experiments, install a space debris protection device as well as extravehicular payload and equipment, and perform recovery tasks.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The mission will also bring with it zebrafish, planarians and streptomyces as research objects to carry out three life science experiments at the space station.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Application (Noun)
आवेदन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Application' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Conference (Noun)

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Protection (Noun)
सुरक्षा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Protection' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Equipment (Adjective)
उपकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Equipment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "China to launch Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on April 24", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Shenzhou-20 spaceflight will carry three astronauts namely Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui and Wang Jie.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'China to launch Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on April' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'China to launch Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on Ap' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'China to launch Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on Ap' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Shenzhou-20 spaceflight will carry three astronauts namely Chen Dong, Chen Zhongrui and Wang Jie." (Hinglish Arth: शेनझोउ-20 अंतरिक्ष उड़ान तीन अंतरिक्ष यात्रियों चेन डोंग, चेन झोंग्रुई और वांग जी को लेकर जाएगी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "China to launch Shenzhou-20 spaceflight on April 24"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The mission will also bring with it zebrafish, planarians and streptomyces as research objects to carry out three life science experiments at the..." (Hinglish Arth: मिशन अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन पर तीन जीवन विज्ञान प्रयोगों को अंजाम देने के लिए अनुसंधान वस्तुओं के रूप में जेब्राफिश, प्लैनेरियन और स्ट्रेप्टोमाइसेस भी लाएगा।)

articles.title: Crews search for six aboard a small plane that crashed into the Gulf of Mexico, Coast Guard says
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Responders found three life jackets, a life raft and the plane's cabin floating on the water, but they had not located the four adults and two boys, ages eight and 10, who were on board

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Rescue crews were searching for six people, including two children, after a small plane went down on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) afternoon off the coast of Mississippi, authorities said. The plane, a Cessna 210, went down in the Gulf of Mexico between Pascagoula, Mississippi, and Horn Island, which is part of the Gulf Islands National Seashore. Responders found three life jackets, a life raft and the plane's cabin floating on the water, but they had not located the four adults and two boys, ages eight and 10, who were on board, said Coast Guard spokesperson Juan Ros. The Cessna was en route from New Orleans to Fort Meyers, Florida, according to the flight tracking website FlightAware. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), which will investigate the crash, said on Tuesday (November 23) they were aware of it.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier this month, a Learjet 60 business jet nosedived into the ground in south Florida , killing all nine people on board. The terrifying crash was captured on video recorded by people inside their cars.

articles.title: Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India. “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits. We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P. Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG. ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise? | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026 The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr. Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues. “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward. We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held. I would say that EPG is in the past. We are not looking backward,” said Mr. Misri in response to a question. He described the EPG report as “not relevant”. Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process. “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr. Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05. The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers. “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi. The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof. Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first. “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr. Lama. The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli in February 2016. The visit of Mr. Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal. During the time of its existence, a part of the Institute of Defence Studies and Analyses (IDSA) in Delhi served as the secretariat for the EPG. The then Director General of the IDSA Jayant Prasad was also part of the EPG.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Incidentally, officials who are currently playing key roles in India-Nepal relations were also involved in the EPG process. Former members recounted that the newly appointed Indian ambassador to Nepal Sudhakar Dalela was the Joint Secretary (North) in the Ministry of External Affairs and was part of the EPG process during 2016-18. That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.

hinglishTracks.en: Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पूर्व नेपाली राजदूत और नेपाली पक्ष में ईपीजी के समन्वयक भेक बहादुर थापा ने ईपीजी रिपोर्ट को द्विपक्षीय परामर्श प्रक्रिया के लिए एक कदम आगे बताया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “यह एकतरफा दस्तावेज़ नहीं था, यह नई दिल्ली और काठमांडू द्वारा नियुक्त विशेषज्ञों के बीच द्विपक्षीय परामर्श के माध्यम से बनाया गया दस्तावेज़ था,” श्री ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “यह अजीब है कि रिपोर्ट यहां दिल्ली में लॉन्च नहीं की जा सकी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof.

hinglishTracks.en: Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लामा ने सूचित करते हुए कहा कि उनसे गलती हुई क्योंकि काठमांडू भी पहले रिपोर्ट का अनावरण कर सकता था।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — श्री ने कहा, "हमारी सिफारिशें अब काठमांडू में अन्य हितधारकों तक पहुंच सकती हैं और मुझे नहीं लगता कि यह कोई सकारात्मक बात है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और पूर्व नेपाली प्रधान मंत्री के.पी. के बीच प्रतिनिधिमंडल स्तर की वार्ता के दौरान बनी सहमति के अनुसार ईपीजी को संस्थागत बनाया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — श्रीमान का दौरा।

hinglishTracks.en: Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — ओली ने नेपाल-भारत सीमा पर महीनों तक चली नाकाबंदी की पृष्ठभूमि में यह कदम उठाया था, जिसके बारे में काठमांडू का कहना था कि यह भारत द्वारा लगाया गया था, लेकिन भारत ने नाकाबंदी लगाने के लिए नेपाल के मधेसी आंदोलनकारियों को दोषी ठहराया, जिससे नेपाल में रसोई गैस जैसी आवश्यक वस्तुओं के प्रवाह में बाधा उत्पन्न हुई।।

hinglishTracks.en: During the time of its existence, a part of the Institute of Defence Studies and Analyses (IDSA) in Delhi served as the secretariat for the EPG.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — अपने अस्तित्व के दौरान, दिल्ली में रक्षा अध्ययन और विश्लेषण संस्थान (आईडीएसए) का एक हिस्सा ईपीजी के लिए सचिवालय के रूप में कार्य करता था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: The then Director General of the IDSA Jayant Prasad was also part of the EPG.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — आईडीएसए के तत्कालीन महानिदेशक जयंत प्रसाद भी ईपीजी का हिस्सा थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Incidentally, officials who are currently playing key roles in India-Nepal relations were also involved in the EPG process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — संयोग से, जो अधिकारी वर्तमान में भारत-नेपाल संबंधों में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभा रहे हैं, वे भी ईपीजी प्रक्रिया में शामिल थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: Former members recounted that the newly appointed Indian ambassador to Nepal Sudhakar Dalela was the Joint Secretary (North) in the Ministry of External Affairs and was part of the EPG process during 2016-18.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पूर्व सदस्यों ने बताया कि नेपाल में नव नियुक्त भारतीय राजदूत सुधाकर दलेला विदेश मंत्रालय में संयुक्त सचिव (उत्तर) थे और 2016-18 के दौरान ईपीजी प्रक्रिया का हिस्सा थे।।

hinglishTracks.en: That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसके अलावा, भारत में नए नेपाली राजदूत निश्चल नाथ पांडे भी काठमांडू में ईपीजी प्रक्रिया का हिस्सा थे।।

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:21:02 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India. “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits. We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P. Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG. ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise? | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026 The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr. Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues. “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward. We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held. I would say that EPG is in the past. We are not looking backward,” said Mr. Misri in response to a question. He described the EPG report as “not relevant”. Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process. “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr. Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05. The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers. “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi. The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof. Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first. “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr. Lama. The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli in February 2016. The visit of Mr. Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal. During the time of its existence, a part of the Institute of Defence Studies and Analyses (IDSA) in Delhi served as the secretariat for the EPG. • 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India. “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits. We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P. Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG. ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise? | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026 The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr. Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues. “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward. We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held. I would say that EPG is in the past. We are not looking backward,” said Mr. Misri in response to a question. He described the EPG report as “not relevant”. Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process. “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr. Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05. The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers. “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi. The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof. Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first. “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr. Lama. The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli in February 2016. The visit of Mr. Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal. articles.title: Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: After the 9/11 attacks, Mr. Giuliani ‌became one of the most popular figures in U.S. politics. He launched a Republican presidential ‌bid ⁠in 2007, and even after it failed, he remained a prominent conservative ⁠messenger

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: President Donald Trump ‌on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) awarded the Medal of Freedom, the country’s highest civilian honor, to ​Rudy Giuliani, the former New York Mayor who became a national figure after ⁠the September 11, 2001, attacks and later helped Trump try to overturn his 2020 election defeat. Mr. Trump announced he would honour Mr. Giuliani, 82, in September 2025 shortly after the former Mayor was badly injured in a ‌car accident. Mr. Trump at the time called him “the greatest Mayor in the history of New York City, and an equally great American Patriot.” After the 9/11 attacks, Mr. Giuliani ‌became one of the most popular figures in U.S. politics. He launched a Republican presidential ‌bid ⁠in 2007, and even after it failed, he remained a prominent conservative ⁠messenger. In a statement, White House spokeswoman Olivia Wales called Mr. Giuliani “a dedicated public servant whose decisive leadership has left a lasting impact on New York City and our nation.” Mr. Trump awarded the medal in a private Oval Office ceremony. Mr. Giuliani ​in a statement said he was “honored ‌and humbled” by the medal, and credited advice from President Ronald Reagan, under whom he served as Associate Attorney General and a U.S. Attorney, for guiding his public service. “I share the credit with all the men and women who worked with me, disagreed with me, ‌and loved me — particularly those who lost their lives in the causes we ​undertook together,” Mr. Giuliani said. His son, former Trump administration official Andrew Giuliani, told reporters outside the White House that the ceremony was a “special” gathering in which Mr. Trump ⁠and Mr. Giuliani reminisced about their long friendship. Their alliance deepened after Mr. Trump lost the 2020 election. Mr. Giuliani advanced falsehoods about the result and the integrity of the voting process. He held a press conference ‌at a Philadelphia landscaping business, where he made claims that were widely rebutted, then another at the headquarters of the Republican National Committee where hair dye dribbled down his face.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: His false claims came with legal consequences. He was barred from practising law in New York, where he once served as the U.S. Attorney in the state’s southern district, and Washington, and faced criminal charges in Georgia and Arizona for attempting to subvert the 2020 election results.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:12:37 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: After the 9/11 attacks, Mr. Giuliani ‌became one of the most popular figures in U.S. politics. He launched a Republican presidential ‌bid ⁠in 2007, and even after it failed, he remained a prominent conservative ⁠messenger

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: President Donald Trump ‌on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) awarded the Medal of Freedom, the country’s highest civilian honor, to ​Rudy Giuliani, the former New York Mayor who became a national figure after ⁠the September 11, 2001, attacks and later helped Trump try to overturn his 2020 election defeat. Mr. Trump announced he would honour Mr. Giuliani, 82, in September 2025 shortly after the former Mayor was badly injured in a ‌car accident. Mr. Trump at the time called him “the greatest Mayor in the history of New York City, and an equally great American Patriot.” After the 9/11 attacks, Mr. Giuliani ‌became one of the most popular figures in U.S. politics. He launched a Republican presidential ‌bid ⁠in 2007, and even after it failed, he remained a prominent conservative ⁠messenger. In a statement, White House spokeswoman Olivia Wales called Mr. Giuliani “a dedicated public servant whose decisive leadership has left a lasting impact on New York City and our nation.” Mr. Trump awarded the medal in a private Oval Office ceremony. Mr. Giuliani ​in a statement said he was “honored ‌and humbled” by the medal, and credited advice from President Ronald Reagan, under whom he served as Associate Attorney General and a U.S. Attorney, for guiding his public service. “I share the credit with all the men and women who worked with me, disagreed with me, ‌and loved me — particularly those who lost their lives in the causes we ​undertook together,” Mr. Giuliani said. His son, former Trump administration official Andrew Giuliani, told reporters outside the White House that the ceremony was a “special” gathering in which Mr. Trump ⁠and Mr. Giuliani reminisced about their long friendship. Their alliance deepened after Mr. Trump lost the 2020 election. Mr. Giuliani advanced falsehoods about the result and the integrity of the voting process. He held a press conference ‌at a Philadelphia landscaping business, where he made claims that were widely rebutted, then another at the headquarters of the Republican National Committee where hair dye dribbled down his face.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: His false claims came with legal consequences. He was barred from practising law in New York, where he once served as the U.S. Attorney in the state’s southern district, and Washington, and faced criminal charges in Georgia and Arizona for attempting to subvert the 2020 election results.

articles.title: U.S. lawmakers raise alarm at FAA decision to deploy aviation AI tool nationally
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of two dozen U.S. House Democrats ​on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision ‌to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic ​controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a ⁠major system failure. The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence. The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote. The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue. “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said. “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.” The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.” The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment. The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — दो दर्जन यू.एस. का एक समूह।

hinglishTracks.en: House Democrats ​on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision ‌to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic ​controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a ⁠major system failure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हाउस डेमोक्रेट्स ने मंगलवार को एक प्रमुख सिस्टम विफलता से कुछ दिन पहले, 10 नवंबर को देश भर में हवाई यातायात नियंत्रकों की सहायता के लिए एक नया एआई उपकरण तैनात करने के संघीय विमानन प्रशासन के फैसले पर गंभीर चिंता जताई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Administration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एफएए ने सितंबर में वाशिंगटन क्षेत्र में एक नए सॉफ्टवेयर-आधारित एआई टूल सिस्टम का उपयोग शुरू किया, जो एयर स्पेस इंटेलिजेंस को $875 मिलियन, 12-वर्षीय अनुबंध देने के बाद उड़ानों को प्रबंधित करने के तरीके में सुधार करने के लिए पूर्वानुमानित विश्लेषण का उपयोग करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हाउस ट्रांसपोर्टेशन कमेटी के रैंकिंग सदस्य, वाशिंगटन के प्रतिनिधि रिक लार्सन के नेतृत्व में डेमोक्रेट्स ने "बड़े पैमाने पर अप्रयुक्त सिस्टम के अचानक विस्तार" की आलोचना की और एफएए से 30 नवंबर तक सवालों की एक श्रृंखला का जवाब देने को कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Representative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रतिनिधि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Representative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — कानून निर्माताओं ने लिखा, "हमें अभी तक कोई ठोस जानकारी नहीं मिली है जो यह साबित करती हो कि देश भर में विस्तार से पहले सिस्टम को ठीक से मान्य किया गया था।"।

hinglishTracks.en: The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सिस्टम, जिसे एयरस्पेस, रूट्स और ट्रैजेक्टरीज या स्मार्ट का रणनीतिक प्रबंधन कहा जाता है, यातायात प्रवाह की भविष्यवाणी करने और संभावित संघर्षों की पहचान करने के लिए एयरलाइन शेड्यूल, मौसम, हवाई अड्डे की क्षमता, हवाई क्षेत्र की स्थितियों और परिचालन बाधाओं का विश्लेषण करने के लिए डेटा का उपयोग करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — पत्र में 13 नवंबर को लगभग पांच घंटे के राष्ट्रव्यापी ग्राउंड स्टॉप का हवाला दिया गया, जिसके कारण एफएए टेलीकॉम मुद्दे के कारण अनुमानित 1.5 मिलियन यात्रियों के लिए उड़ानें रद्द कर दी गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पत्र में कहा गया, "संघीय सरकार विश्वास के संकट से जूझ रही है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “विमानन प्रणाली में अमेरिकियों का विश्वास हिल गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एफएए ने जिस अस्पष्टता और असंगतता के साथ स्मार्ट रोलआउट को संभाला है, उससे उस भरोसे को और भी कम करने का खतरा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कानूनविद यह जानना चाहते हैं कि स्मार्ट संचालन को मान्य करने के लिए एफएए द्वारा उपयोग किए गए डेटा और "स्मार्ट को प्रभावित करने वाले मुद्दों या आउटेज की स्थिति में विश्वसनीय एटीसी संचालन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए" क्या अतिरेक मौजूद हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सांसदों ने उन रिपोर्टों का भी हवाला दिया कि एफएए ने उन कर्मचारियों के खिलाफ जवाबी कार्रवाई की हो सकती है जिन्होंने स्मार्ट की तेजी से तैनाती के बारे में सुरक्षा चिंताएं जताई थीं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एफएए ने टिप्पणी से इनकार कर दिया और कहा कि वह सीधे सांसदों को जवाब देगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अमेरिकी परिवहन सचिव सीन डफी ने इस उपकरण को अनिवार्य रूप से "गूंगा एआई" कहा है और इस बात पर जोर दिया है कि सॉफ्टवेयर नहीं, बल्कि नियंत्रक प्रभारी बने रहेंगे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Transportation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: परिवहन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Transportation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 U.S. lawmakers raise alarm at FAA decision to deploy aviation AI tool nationally

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:26:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S. Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of two dozen U.S. House Democrats ​on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision ‌to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic ​controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a ⁠major system failure. The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence. The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote. The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue. “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said. “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.” The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.” The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment. The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.

जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly

• 1. Core Context & Background: U.S. Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system”
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A group of two dozen U.S. House Democrats ​on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision ‌to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic ​controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a ⁠major system failure. The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve ‌how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence. The Democrats, led ‌by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of ‌the ⁠House Transportation Committee, criticised the “sudden expansion of a largely untested ⁠system” and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. “We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated ​before its nationwide expansion,” ‌the lawmakers wrote. The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyse airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic ‌flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur. The letter cited ​the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated ⁠1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue. “The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence,” the letter said. “Americans’ faith ‌in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust.” The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to “ensure reliable ATC operations in the ‌event of issues or outages impacting SMART.” The lawmakers also cited reports that the ​FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment. The FAA declined comment and ⁠said it would respond directly to the lawmakers.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy ⁠has called the tool essentially “dumb AI” and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Levent Alpöge of Anthropic has announced that he and the company’s AI model Claude have found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, which concerns the distribution of prime numbers. Mathematicians have spent more than 160 years trying to prove it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mathematician Levent Alpöge of the U.S. artificial intelligence (AI) company Anthropic announced on Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics, with the help of the company’s AI model Claude. The hypothesis, named for German mathematician Georg Bernhard Riemann who first proposed it in 1859, concerns the distribution of prime numbers, which are the building blocks of all whole numbers. Mathematicians have spent more than 160 years trying to prove it, en route developing new techniques that have benefited fields such as algebraic geometry, probability theory, quantum physics, and the study of dynamical systems. The Riemann hypothesis is also one of the seven problems for which the Clay Mathematics Institute has offered a $1-million bounty for a solution. In his announcement, released late on November 20 (IST), Mr. Alpöge released more than 1.7 crore lines of computer code with what he claimed was the complete proof of the hypothesis. Mr. Alpöge also said he has proved a stronger result called the generalised Riemann hypothesis. However, he did not produce a traditional paper on his work and also acknowledged he does not yet fully understand every argument Claude used to produce the result.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: That said, a few independent mathematicians, including Andrew Sutherland of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, have confirmed that the code Mr. Alpöge published with the result passes several rigorous checks, and two separate proof-checking systems have also accepted the result.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #26 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 AI cracks math’s most famous problem. Have mathematicians lost a guiding light?

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:25:30 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Levent Alpöge of Anthropic has announced that he and the company’s AI model Claude have found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, which concerns the distribution of prime numbers. Mathematicians have spent more than 160 years trying to prove it

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Mathematician Levent Alpöge of the U.S. artificial intelligence (AI) company Anthropic announced on Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics, with the help of the company’s AI model Claude. The hypothesis, named for German mathematician Georg Bernhard Riemann who first proposed it in 1859, concerns the distribution of prime numbers, which are the building blocks of all whole numbers. Mathematicians have spent more than 160 years trying to prove it, en route developing new techniques that have benefited fields such as algebraic geometry, probability theory, quantum physics, and the study of dynamical systems. The Riemann hypothesis is also one of the seven problems for which the Clay Mathematics Institute has offered a $1-million bounty for a solution. In his announcement, released late on November 20 (IST), Mr. Alpöge released more than 1.7 crore lines of computer code with what he claimed was the complete proof of the hypothesis. Mr. Alpöge also said he has proved a stronger result called the generalised Riemann hypothesis. However, he did not produce a traditional paper on his work and also acknowledged he does not yet fully understand every argument Claude used to produce the result.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: That said, a few independent mathematicians, including Andrew Sutherland of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, have confirmed that the code Mr. Alpöge published with the result passes several rigorous checks, and two separate proof-checking systems have also accepted the result.

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Announcement (Adjective)
घोषणा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Announcement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

articles.title: GSK India launches multiple myeloma drug
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The launch marks introduction of GSK’s third precision oncology therapy in India.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: British drugmaker GSK’s subsidiary GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals (GSK India), as part of a strategy to sharpen focus on cancer therapies, on Tuesday announced the launch of monoclonal antibody-drug conjugate BLENREP (belantamab mafodotin) as a combination therapy for those with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The launch marks introduction of GSK’s third precision oncology therapy in India. “Last year, we began our oncology journey in the country with Jemperli and Zejula in solid tumours. With the launch of BLENREP, we are expanding into haemato-oncology...” GSK India managing director Bhushan Akshikar said in a release. BLENREP has been approved by CDSCO as a combination therapy for adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior line of therapy, the company said. Beyond haematological and gynaecological cancers, GSK said it is focusing on lung and gastrointestinal cancers, and other solid tumours. It is currently conducting 15 oncology clinical trials, including studies evaluating dostarlimab in head and neck cancer and colon cancer, the company said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: business (general) / pharmaceutical / medicine / cancer

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 GSK India launches multiple myeloma drug

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 10:03:00 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The launch marks introduction of GSK’s third precision oncology therapy in India.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: British drugmaker GSK’s subsidiary GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals (GSK India), as part of a strategy to sharpen focus on cancer therapies, on Tuesday announced the launch of monoclonal antibody-drug conjugate BLENREP (belantamab mafodotin) as a combination therapy for those with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The launch marks introduction of GSK’s third precision oncology therapy in India. “Last year, we began our oncology journey in the country with Jemperli and Zejula in solid tumours. With the launch of BLENREP, we are expanding into haemato-oncology...” GSK India managing director Bhushan Akshikar said in a release. BLENREP has been approved by CDSCO as a combination therapy for adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who have received at least one prior line of therapy, the company said. Beyond haematological and gynaecological cancers, GSK said it is focusing on lung and gastrointestinal cancers, and other solid tumours. It is currently conducting 15 oncology clinical trials, including studies evaluating dostarlimab in head and neck cancer and colon cancer, the company said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: business (general) / pharmaceutical / medicine / cancer

articles.title: Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches across States on Constitution Day, Kharge to join programme in Lucknow
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The marches will begin at statues of Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, followed by a reading of the Preamble and an oath to protect the Constitution

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress will hold Samvidhan Raksha Marches across the country on Thursday (November 26, 2026) to mark Constitution Day, stepping up its campaign against alleged electoral roll manipulation and the Election Commission of India’s (ECI) failure to protect the right to vote. In a statement on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), AICC general secretary (organisation) K.C. Venugopal said all Pradesh Congress Committees (PCCs) would organise the marches, with party president Mallikarjun Kharge participating in the Lucknow event. Mr. Venugopal cited the allegations of “vote chori” raised by Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi, including fake and duplicate entries in Mahadevapura, attempts to delete genuine voters in Aland and irregularities in Haryana. He accused the ECI of failing to order an impartial inquiry. He also alleged that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls had put millions of voters at risk, claiming that deletions across its three phases were believed to exceed 13 crore. The marches will begin at statues of Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, followed by a reading of the Preamble and an oath to protect the Constitution. The party will also run its ‘Vote Rakshak’ campaign, with workers visiting polling booths to identify deleted voters and help them reclaim their voting rights. No permission sought for November 26 anti-SIR march, says Delhi police Mr. Venugopal appealed to citizens, including students, youth, farmers, workers and members of marginalised communities, to join the marches. “The Constitution gave every Indian the vote. The Indian National Congress is duty-bound and committed to defend it,” he said. The party’ communications chief Jairam Ramesh also recalled the speech delivered by B.R. Ambedkar in the Constituent Assembly on November 25, 1949, a day before the draft Constitution was adopted.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Quoting Ambedkar’s warning that “Bhakti in religion may be a road to salvation of the soul. But in politics, Bhakti or hero-worship is a sure road to degradation and to eventual dictatorship”, Mr. Ramesh said, “This magnificent speech is for the ages. It is ever relevant”.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches across States on Constitution Day, Kharge to join programme in Lucknow

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:26:35 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The marches will begin at statues of Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, followed by a reading of the Preamble and an oath to protect the Constitution

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress will hold Samvidhan Raksha Marches across the country on Thursday (November 26, 2026) to mark Constitution Day, stepping up its campaign against alleged electoral roll manipulation and the Election Commission of India’s (ECI) failure to protect the right to vote. In a statement on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), AICC general secretary (organisation) K.C. Venugopal said all Pradesh Congress Committees (PCCs) would organise the marches, with party president Mallikarjun Kharge participating in the Lucknow event. Mr. Venugopal cited the allegations of “vote chori” raised by Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi, including fake and duplicate entries in Mahadevapura, attempts to delete genuine voters in Aland and irregularities in Haryana. He accused the ECI of failing to order an impartial inquiry. He also alleged that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls had put millions of voters at risk, claiming that deletions across its three phases were believed to exceed 13 crore. The marches will begin at statues of Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, followed by a reading of the Preamble and an oath to protect the Constitution. The party will also run its ‘Vote Rakshak’ campaign, with workers visiting polling booths to identify deleted voters and help them reclaim their voting rights. No permission sought for November 26 anti-SIR march, says Delhi police Mr. Venugopal appealed to citizens, including students, youth, farmers, workers and members of marginalised communities, to join the marches. “The Constitution gave every Indian the vote. The Indian National Congress is duty-bound and committed to defend it,” he said. The party’ communications chief Jairam Ramesh also recalled the speech delivered by B.R. Ambedkar in the Constituent Assembly on November 25, 1949, a day before the draft Constitution was adopted.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Quoting Ambedkar’s warning that “Bhakti in religion may be a road to salvation of the soul. But in politics, Bhakti or hero-worship is a sure road to degradation and to eventual dictatorship”, Mr. Ramesh said, “This magnificent speech is for the ages. It is ever relevant”.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Permissibility (Noun)
कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।
✓ Syn: Admissibility, Legality, Allowance  |  ✖ Ant: Prohibition, Ban, Illegality
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Manipulation (Noun)
चालाकी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Manipulation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Organisation (Noun)
संगठन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Organisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches across States on Constitution Day, Kharge to join programme in Lucknow", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The marches will begin at statues of Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, followed by a reading of the Preamble and an oath to protect the Constitution.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches acro' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches a' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches a' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The marches will begin at statues of Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, followed by a reading of the Preamble and an oath to protect the Constitution." (Hinglish Arth: मार्च अंबेडकर या महात्मा गांधी की प्रतिमाओं से शुरू होगा, इसके बाद प्रस्तावना पढ़ी जाएगी और संविधान की रक्षा की शपथ ली जाएगी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Congress to hold ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches across States on Constitution Day, Kharge to join programme in Lucknow"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Ramesh said, “This magnificent speech is for the ages.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Ramesh said, “This magnificent speech is for the ages." (Hinglish Arth: रमेश ने कहा, ''यह शानदार भाषण युगों-युगों के लिए है।)

articles.title: Where is the accountability: Kharge slams Modi govt on anaemia report
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Modi government's emphasis on "mild" anaemia cannot obscure the fact that nearly 30% of women of reproductive age suffer from moderate or severe anaemia, the Congress chief said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress on Wednesday (November 24, 2026) attacked the Centre over a report on malnutrition and anaemia in the country and asked where is the accountability after 12 years of the Modi government. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge asked how can India realise its demographic dividend when millions of its women and children continue to suffer from malnutrition. "The Modi Govt's own ICMR-SAMPADA report reveals that 55.9% of women of reproductive age are anaemic. Nearly two-thirds of adolescent girls and boys are deficient in Vitamin B12. 42% of children aged 1-4 years are anaemic. In Gujarat, 66% of women of reproductive age and 57% of young children are anaemic," Mr. Kharge said on X. The Modi government's emphasis on "mild" anaemia cannot obscure the fact that nearly 30% of women of reproductive age suffer from moderate or severe anaemia, the Congress chief said. The latest NFHS-6 also reveals that nearly one-third of children are underweight and one in five suffers from acute malnutrition, Mr. Kharge said. "Consider the Government's own financial records. Over Rs 1.13 lakh Cr released under Saksham Anganwadi, POSHAN 2.0 and predecessor schemes in six financial years. Over Rs 2,500 crore gap between funds released and utilised under POSHAN 2.0 in just four years. Nearly 44% of funds released under the original POSHAN Abhiyaan remained unutilised," he pointed out. Mr. Kharge further said the share of Women and Child Development in the Union Budget has nearly halved — from 0.96% in 2015-16 to 0.50% in 2025-26. “After 12 years of the Modi government, multiple nutrition schemes, fortified rice and iron supplementation programmes, where is the accountability?" Kharge said. The Congress on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) cited an official report that showed Gujarat faring poorly in terms of anaemia prevalence in 2023-25, and asked whether Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda would survive the release of this "damning report".

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Congress general secretary in-charge of communications, Jairam Ramesh, had pointed out that the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has just put out a report titled "Anaemia and Micronutrient Deficiencies Across the Life Course in India".

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Where is the accountability: Kharge slams Modi govt on anaemia report

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:24:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Modi government's emphasis on "mild" anaemia cannot obscure the fact that nearly 30% of women of reproductive age suffer from moderate or severe anaemia, the Congress chief said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Congress on Wednesday (November 24, 2026) attacked the Centre over a report on malnutrition and anaemia in the country and asked where is the accountability after 12 years of the Modi government. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge asked how can India realise its demographic dividend when millions of its women and children continue to suffer from malnutrition. "The Modi Govt's own ICMR-SAMPADA report reveals that 55.9% of women of reproductive age are anaemic. Nearly two-thirds of adolescent girls and boys are deficient in Vitamin B12. 42% of children aged 1-4 years are anaemic. In Gujarat, 66% of women of reproductive age and 57% of young children are anaemic," Mr. Kharge said on X. The Modi government's emphasis on "mild" anaemia cannot obscure the fact that nearly 30% of women of reproductive age suffer from moderate or severe anaemia, the Congress chief said. The latest NFHS-6 also reveals that nearly one-third of children are underweight and one in five suffers from acute malnutrition, Mr. Kharge said. "Consider the Government's own financial records. Over Rs 1.13 lakh Cr released under Saksham Anganwadi, POSHAN 2.0 and predecessor schemes in six financial years. articles.title: Wakf Board chairman Hafiz Syed Muhammad Ali Al-Hussaini unveils KBN Gold Cup trophies
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The cricket and hockey trophies of the Khaja Bandanawaz Gold Cup 2026 sports tournament, organised by the KBN House of Sports under the Khaja Education Society, were formally unveiled on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) by Hafiz Syed Muhammad Ali Al-Hussaini, Sajjada Nashin of Dargah Hazrat Khaja Bandanawaz (RA), chairman of the Karnataka State Board of Auqaf, Vice-Chancellor of Khaja Bandanawaz University and president of the Khaja Education Society.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Addressing the players, Mr. Al-Hussaini said that victory and defeat were two sides of the same coin in sports and should be accepted with equal grace. He wished all the participating teams success in the tournament. The chief guest at the toss ceremony, Mr. Shivaranjan Satyampet, editor of Pramatha Vani and vice-president of the Kalaburagi District Working Journalists’ Association, appreciated the educational and sporting opportunities being provided by the Khaja Education Society in the region. The KBN Gold Cup 2026 sports tournament, being held from November 3 to December 4, features football, cricket and hockey competitions. The football tournament has already concluded, while the cricket tournament is currently under way. The trophy unveiling ceremony was held on the 10th day of the cricket tournament in the presence of several dignitaries, including Khaja Education Society general secretary Prof. A.M. Pathan, KBN University Pro-Vice-Chancellor Prof. Syed Ashfaq Ahmed, Registrar Mir Vilayat Ali, society secretary Benny Kuriakose, M. Jeelani and Sohail Munshi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Following the ceremony, the players of Al-Barkat School and Just Cricket Academy, who were to face each other in the 10th-day match, were introduced to the dignitaries. The national anthem was then rendered, following which Mr. Satyampet formally inaugurated the match by conducting the toss.
