🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Wakf Board chairman Hafiz Syed Muhammad Ali Al-Hussaini unveils KBN Gold Cup trophies

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:22:50 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The cricket and hockey trophies of the Khaja Bandanawaz Gold Cup 2026 sports tournament, organised by the KBN House of Sports under the Khaja Education Society, were formally unveiled on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) by Hafiz Syed Muhammad Ali Al-Hussaini, Sajjada Nashin of Dargah Hazrat Khaja Bandanawaz (RA), chairman of the Karnataka State Board of Auqaf, Vice-Chancellor of Khaja Bandanawaz University and president of the Khaja Education Society.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Addressing the players, Mr. Al-Hussaini said that victory and defeat were two sides of the same coin in sports and should be accepted with equal grace. He wished all the participating teams success in the tournament. The chief guest at the toss ceremony, Mr. Shivaranjan Satyampet, editor of Pramatha Vani and vice-president of the Kalaburagi District Working Journalists’ Association, appreciated the educational and sporting opportunities being provided by the Khaja Education Society in the region. The KBN Gold Cup 2026 sports tournament, being held from November 3 to December 4, features football, cricket and hockey competitions. The football tournament has already concluded, while the cricket tournament is currently under way. The trophy unveiling ceremony was held on the 10th day of the cricket tournament in the presence of several dignitaries, including Khaja Education Society general secretary Prof. A.M. Pathan, KBN University Pro-Vice-Chancellor Prof. Syed Ashfaq Ahmed, Registrar Mir Vilayat Ali, society secretary Benny Kuriakose, M. Jeelani and Sohail Munshi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Following the ceremony, the players of Al-Barkat School and Just Cricket Academy, who were to face each other in the 10th-day match, were introduced to the dignitaries. The national anthem was then rendered, following which Mr. Satyampet formally inaugurated the match by conducting the toss.

articles.title: Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded in few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: People who stepped out of homes in Hyderabad on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) have observed the sky to be cloudy. The change in weather conditions was observed a day after Telangana districts stretching from eastern to southern part received heavy to light rain.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: But the city did not receive rain until noon on Wednesday at least. Very light rain was recorded in a few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy and Nalgonda. According to Telangana Development Planning Society’s weather observations till 11 a.m., 3.8 mm rain was recorded in Kamkole of Sangareddy and Gunegal of Rangareddy. India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre has forecast a generally cloudy sky turning partly cloudy towards evening or night. It has issued an update at 12.33 p.m. predicting light rain or thundershowers as likely at isolated places in the southern part of Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) during the next one to two hours. India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre issued an update at 12.33 p.m. predicting light rain or thundershowers as likely at isolated places in the southern part of Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) during the next one to two hours. | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: There was no change in the temperatures recorded. The lowest of 15.6°C was recorded in Kumaram Bheem Asifabad, followed by 16.0°C in Adilabad and 16.4°C in Wanaparthy. While the lowest temperature of 20.1°C was recorded in Rangareddy, it was 20.4°C in Medchal Malkajgiri and 22.5°C in Hyderabad.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded in few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:17:56 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: People who stepped out of homes in Hyderabad on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) have observed the sky to be cloudy. The change in weather conditions was observed a day after Telangana districts stretching from eastern to southern part received heavy to light rain.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: But the city did not receive rain until noon on Wednesday at least. Very light rain was recorded in a few parts of Rangareddy, Sangareddy and Nalgonda. According to Telangana Development Planning Society’s weather observations till 11 a.m., 3.8 mm rain was recorded in Kamkole of Sangareddy and Gunegal of Rangareddy. India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre has forecast a generally cloudy sky turning partly cloudy towards evening or night. It has issued an update at 12.33 p.m. predicting light rain or thundershowers as likely at isolated places in the southern part of Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) during the next one to two hours. India Meteorological Department-Hyderabad Centre issued an update at 12.33 p.m. predicting light rain or thundershowers as likely at isolated places in the southern part of Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) during the next one to two hours. | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: There was no change in the temperatures recorded. The lowest of 15.6°C was recorded in Kumaram Bheem Asifabad, followed by 16.0°C in Adilabad and 16.4°C in Wanaparthy. While the lowest temperature of 20.1°C was recorded in Rangareddy, it was 20.4°C in Medchal Malkajgiri and 22.5°C in Hyderabad.

Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Meteorological (Adjective)
मौसम विज्ञान और वायुमंडलीय परिवर्तनों से संबंधित (Connected with weather forecasting and atmospheric shifts).
✓ Syn: Atmospheric, Climatic, Weather-related  |  ✖ Ant: Geological, Subterranean, Terrestrial
Development (Adjective)
विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Corporation (Noun)
निगम — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Corporation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

A. People who stepped out of homes in Hyderabad on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) have observed the sky to be cloudy.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded in' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Cloudy Wednesday for Hyderabad; rain recorded' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: NDA-SAD reunion: Why the Akali Dal severed ties with BJP 6 years ago
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Six years after parting ways over differences on the three farm laws, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its oldest ally, the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), have reunited ahead of the Punjab Assembly elections in 2027. Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the development as an effort to place Punjab and the welfare of its people above all else. The SAD and the BJP had been allies since the late 1990s. However, amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020. Subsequently, on November 19, 2021, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the repeal of the three farm laws. The SAD exited the NDA in 2020, with party MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal also resigning from the Union Council of Ministers in protest against the legislation, which sought to overhaul agricultural marketing and triggered months-long demonstrations at Delhi’s borders. Responding to questions about the party’s current stand on the farm laws, Union Home Minister Amit Shah said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) there was little relevance in revisiting the issue since the legislation had already been withdrawn. The laws under contention were the Farmers’ Produce Trade and Commerce (Promotion and Facilitation) Act, 2020; the Farmers (Empowerment and Protection) Agreement on Price Assurance and Farm Services Act, 2020; and the Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, 2020. Together, they sought to remove restrictions on the stocking, contracting and purchase of agricultural commodities. Amid protests from Opposition parties and farmers, particularly in Punjab, both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill without discussion on the opening day of the Winter Session in December 2021. Subsequently, the Law Ministry notified the Farm Laws Repeal Act, 2021, nullifying the three farm laws enacted by Parliament in 2020. The move came after President Ram Nath Kovind gave his assent to the Bill, completing the process of repealing the contentious legislation. The Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) have criticised the renewed alliance , alleging that the two parties have put political convenience above Punjab’s interests. Former Punjab Congress president Amarinder Singh Raja Warring accused SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal and former Union Minister Harsimrat Kaur Badal of presenting a misleading picture by publicly distancing themselves from the BJP while backing it on important issues in Parliament. Mr. Warring contended that, despite their formal split in 2020 over the farm laws, the two parties had remained politically aligned and had now come together again after losing electoral ground in Punjab. Describing the alliance as a “thaggjod” (an alliance of deceivers), Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann urged voters not to place their trust in the two parties again. He alleged that the previous SAD-BJP government, which was in office from 2007 to 2017, failed to curb the drug menace and did not act decisively on incidents of sacrilege reported in 2015.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: ALSO WATCH Watch: Punjab elections 2027: Can the Akali Dal regain lost ground with the BJP? | Above the Fold | Nov 24, 2026

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: Amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020.

(Hinglish Arth: केंद्र के कृषि कानूनों के खिलाफ व्यापक विरोध के बीच, शिअद ने 2020 में राष्ट्रीय जनतांत्रिक गठबंधन (एनडीए) से नाता तोड़ लिया।)

Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "ALSO WATCH Watch: Punjab elections 2027: Can the Akali Dal regain lost ground with the BJP?." (Hinglish Arth: यह भी देखें देखें: पंजाब चुनाव 2027: क्या अकाली दल भाजपा के साथ खोई हुई जमीन वापस पा सकता है?)

hinglishTracks.en: Amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — केंद्र के कृषि कानूनों के खिलाफ व्यापक विरोध के बीच, शिअद ने 2020 में राष्ट्रीय जनतांत्रिक गठबंधन (एनडीए) से नाता तोड़ लिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Six years after parting ways over differences on the three farm laws, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its oldest ally, the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), have reunited ahead of the Punjab Assembly elections in 2027.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — तीन कृषि कानूनों पर मतभेदों के कारण अलग होने के छह साल बाद, भारतीय जनता पार्टी (भाजपा) और उसके सबसे पुराने सहयोगी, शिरोमणि अकाली दल (एसएडी) 2027 में पंजाब विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले फिर से एकजुट हो गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the development as an effort to place Punjab and the welfare of its people above all else.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने विकास को पंजाब और उसके लोगों के कल्याण को अन्य सभी से ऊपर रखने का प्रयास बताया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Development' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The SAD and the BJP had been allies since the late 1990s.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — शिअद और भाजपा 1990 के दशक से सहयोगी रहे हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हालाँकि, केंद्र के कृषि कानूनों के खिलाफ व्यापक विरोध के बीच, SAD ने 2020 में राष्ट्रीय जनतांत्रिक गठबंधन (NDA) से नाता तोड़ लिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Subsequently, on November 19, 2021, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the repeal of the three farm laws.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसके बाद, 19 नवंबर, 2021 को प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने तीन कृषि कानूनों को रद्द करने की घोषणा की।।

hinglishTracks.en: The SAD exited the NDA in 2020, with party MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal also resigning from the Union Council of Ministers in protest against the legislation, which sought to overhaul agricultural marketing and triggered months-long demonstrations at Delhi’s borders.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — शिरोमणि अकाली दल 2020 में एनडीए से बाहर हो गया, पार्टी सांसद हरसिमरत कौर बादल ने भी उस कानून के विरोध में केंद्रीय मंत्रिपरिषद से इस्तीफा दे दिया, जिसमें कृषि विपणन में सुधार की मांग की गई थी और दिल्ली की सीमाओं पर महीनों तक प्रदर्शन शुरू हुआ था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Agricultural' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: कृषि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agricultural' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Responding to questions about the party’s current stand on the farm laws, Union Home Minister Amit Shah said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) there was little relevance in revisiting the issue since the legislation had already been withdrawn.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — कृषि कानूनों पर पार्टी के मौजूदा रुख के बारे में सवालों का जवाब देते हुए, केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने मंगलवार (24 नवंबर, 2026) को कहा कि इस मुद्दे पर फिर से विचार करने की कोई प्रासंगिकता नहीं है क्योंकि कानून पहले ही वापस ले लिया गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Legislation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विधान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Legislation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The laws under contention were the Farmers’ Produce Trade and Commerce (Promotion and Facilitation) Act, 2020; the Farmers (Empowerment and Protection) Agreement on Price Assurance and Farm Services Act, 2020; and the Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, 2020.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — विवाद के तहत कानून किसान उपज व्यापार और वाणिज्य (संवर्धन और सुविधा) अधिनियम, 2020 थे; मूल्य आश्वासन और कृषि सेवा अधिनियम, 2020 पर किसान (सशक्तीकरण और संरक्षण) समझौता; और आवश्यक वस्तु (संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2020।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Facilitation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सुविधा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Facilitation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Together, they sought to remove restrictions on the stocking, contracting and purchase of agricultural commodities.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — साथ में, उन्होंने कृषि वस्तुओं के भंडारण, अनुबंध और खरीद पर प्रतिबंध हटाने की मांग की।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Agricultural' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: कृषि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agricultural' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Amid protests from Opposition parties and farmers, particularly in Punjab, both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill without discussion on the opening day of the Winter Session in December 2021.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — विपक्षी दलों और किसानों, विशेषकर पंजाब के विरोध के बीच, लोकसभा और राज्यसभा दोनों ने दिसंबर 2021 में शीतकालीन सत्र के शुरुआती दिन बिना चर्चा के कृषि कानून निरस्तीकरण विधेयक पारित कर दिया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Subsequently, the Law Ministry notified the Farm Laws Repeal Act, 2021, nullifying the three farm laws enacted by Parliament in 2020.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — इसके बाद, कानून मंत्रालय ने 2020 में संसद द्वारा अधिनियमित तीन कृषि कानूनों को रद्द करते हुए कृषि कानून निरसन अधिनियम, 2021 को अधिसूचित किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: The move came after President Ram Nath Kovind gave his assent to the Bill, completing the process of repealing the contentious legislation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह कदम राष्ट्रपति राम नाथ कोविंद द्वारा विधेयक पर अपनी सहमति देने के बाद आया, जिससे विवादास्पद कानून को निरस्त करने की प्रक्रिया पूरी हो गई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Legislation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विधान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Legislation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) have criticised the renewed alliance , alleging that the two parties have put political convenience above Punjab’s interests.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — कांग्रेस और आम आदमी पार्टी (आप) ने नए सिरे से बने गठबंधन की आलोचना की है और आरोप लगाया है कि दोनों पार्टियों ने राजनीतिक सुविधा को पंजाब के हितों से ऊपर रखा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Former Punjab Congress president Amarinder Singh Raja Warring accused SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal and former Union Minister Harsimrat Kaur Badal of presenting a misleading picture by publicly distancing themselves from the BJP while backing it on important issues in Parliament.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — पंजाब कांग्रेस के पूर्व अध्यक्ष अमरिंदर सिंह राजा वारिंग ने शिअद अध्यक्ष सुखबीर सिंह बादल और पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री हरसिमरत कौर बादल पर संसद में महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दों पर भाजपा का समर्थन करते हुए सार्वजनिक रूप से खुद को दूर करके भ्रामक तस्वीर पेश करने का आरोप लगाया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Warring contended that, despite their formal split in 2020 over the farm laws, the two parties had remained politically aligned and had now come together again after losing electoral ground in Punjab.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वारिंग ने तर्क दिया कि, कृषि कानूनों पर 2020 में औपचारिक विभाजन के बावजूद, दोनों दल राजनीतिक रूप से गठबंधन में बने रहे और अब पंजाब में चुनावी मैदान खोने के बाद फिर से एक साथ आ गए हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Describing the alliance as a “thaggjod” (an alliance of deceivers), Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann urged voters not to place their trust in the two parties again.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान ने गठबंधन को "ठगजोड़" (धोखेबाजों का गठबंधन) बताते हुए मतदाताओं से दोनों पार्टियों पर दोबारा भरोसा नहीं करने का आग्रह किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: He alleged that the previous SAD-BJP government, which was in office from 2007 to 2017, failed to curb the drug menace and did not act decisively on incidents of sacrilege reported in 2015.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि पिछली अकाली-भाजपा सरकार, जो 2007 से 2017 तक सत्ता में थी, नशीली दवाओं के खतरे को रोकने में विफल रही और 2015 में रिपोर्ट की गई बेअदबी की घटनाओं पर निर्णायक कार्रवाई नहीं की।।

hinglishTracks.en: ALSO WATCH Watch: Punjab elections 2027: Can the Akali Dal regain lost ground with the BJP?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यह भी देखें देखें: पंजाब चुनाव 2027: क्या अकाली दल भाजपा के साथ खोई हुई जमीन वापस पा सकता है?।

hinglishTracks.en: | Above the Fold | Nov 24, 2026

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 NDA-SAD reunion: Why the Akali Dal severed ties with BJP 6 years ago

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:15:46 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Six years after parting ways over differences on the three farm laws, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its oldest ally, the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD), have reunited ahead of the Punjab Assembly elections in 2027. Prime Minister Narendra Modi described the development as an effort to place Punjab and the welfare of its people above all else. The SAD and the BJP had been allies since the late 1990s. However, amid widespread protests against the Centre’s farm laws, the SAD severed ties with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) in 2020. Subsequently, on November 19, 2021, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the repeal of the three farm laws. The SAD exited the NDA in 2020, with party MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal also resigning from the Union Council of Ministers in protest against the legislation, which sought to overhaul agricultural marketing and triggered months-long demonstrations at Delhi’s borders. Responding to questions about the party’s current stand on the farm laws, Union Home Minister Amit Shah said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) there was little relevance in revisiting the issue since the legislation had already been withdrawn. The laws under contention were the Farmers’ Produce Trade and Commerce (Promotion and Facilitation) Act, 2020; the Farmers (Empowerment and Protection) Agreement on Price Assurance and Farm Services Act, 2020; and the Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, 2020. Together, they sought to remove restrictions on the stocking, contracting and purchase of agricultural commodities. Amid protests from Opposition parties and farmers, particularly in Punjab, both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill without discussion on the opening day of the Winter Session in December 2021. Subsequently, the Law Ministry notified the Farm Laws Repeal Act, 2021, nullifying the three farm laws enacted by Parliament in 2020. The move came after President Ram Nath Kovind gave his assent to the Bill, completing the process of repealing the contentious legislation. The Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) have criticised the renewed alliance , alleging that the two parties have put political convenience above Punjab’s interests. Former Punjab Congress president Amarinder Singh Raja Warring accused SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal and former Union Minister Harsimrat Kaur Badal of presenting a misleading picture by publicly distancing themselves from the BJP while backing it on important issues in Parliament. Mr. Warring contended that, despite their formal split in 2020 over the farm laws, the two parties had remained politically aligned and had now come together again after losing electoral ground in Punjab. Describing the alliance as a “thaggjod” (an alliance of deceivers), Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann urged voters not to place their trust in the two parties again. He alleged that the previous SAD-BJP government, which was in office from 2007 to 2017, failed to curb the drug menace and did not act decisively on incidents of sacrilege reported in 2015.

articles.title: SC issues notice to Delhi Police on pleas by Sharjeel Imam, Umar Khalid seeking bail in UAPA case
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: In their pleas before the top court, the activists have sought bail, contending that the prosecution has failed to examine protected witnesses and the one-year embargo imposed by the Supreme Court is nearing its expiry

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) issued notice on the bail pleas of activists Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in connection with the 2020 Delhi riots. A three-judge Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said it would consider their pleas for interim bail after hearing the Delhi Police. In their pleas before the top court, the activists have sought bail, contending that the prosecution has failed to examine protected witnesses and the one-year embargo imposed by the Supreme Court is nearing its expiry. The petition by Mr. Imam contended that the chargesheet was filed on September 25, 2020, in which 18 accused face trial and the prosecution has cited more than 900 witnesses, including 47 protected witnesses. Mr. Khalid, in his plea, also cited the failure to examine protected witnesses and said the expiry of the one-year embargo would mean that his continued incarceration would violate Article 21 of the Constitution. Mr. Imam submitted that despite spending six years and nine months as undertrial, the prosecution has failed to examine even a single witness. The Delhi High Court on September 30 refused to grant bail to Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam in a case under UAPA on the “larger conspiracy” behind the February 2020 northeast Delhi riots. Observing that it was bound by “judicial discipline”, the high court said it could not modify the Supreme Court’s January 5 order, which had asked the two accused to seek bail either after the examination of protected witnesses or the expiry of one year, whichever was earlier. Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam challenged the trial court’s July 4 decision rejecting their bail pleas for the third time since their arrest. The trial court had rejected the bail applications, saying it had “no option but to follow” the Supreme Court’s January 5 order and, therefore, could neither entertain the plea nor grant any relief.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam have been booked under UAPA on allegations of being among the masterminds of the February 2020 riots that left 53 people dead and more than 700 injured.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 SC issues notice to Delhi Police on pleas by Sharjeel Imam, Umar Khalid seeking bail in UAPA case

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:14:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: In their pleas before the top court, the activists have sought bail, contending that the prosecution has failed to examine protected witnesses and the one-year embargo imposed by the Supreme Court is nearing its expiry

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) issued notice on the bail pleas of activists Umar Khalid and Sharjeel Imam in connection with the 2020 Delhi riots. A three-judge Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said it would consider their pleas for interim bail after hearing the Delhi Police. In their pleas before the top court, the activists have sought bail, contending that the prosecution has failed to examine protected witnesses and the one-year embargo imposed by the Supreme Court is nearing its expiry. The petition by Mr. Imam contended that the chargesheet was filed on September 25, 2020, in which 18 accused face trial and the prosecution has cited more than 900 witnesses, including 47 protected witnesses. Mr. Khalid, in his plea, also cited the failure to examine protected witnesses and said the expiry of the one-year embargo would mean that his continued incarceration would violate Article 21 of the Constitution. Mr. Imam submitted that despite spending six years and nine months as undertrial, the prosecution has failed to examine even a single witness. The Delhi High Court on September 30 refused to grant bail to Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam in a case under UAPA on the “larger conspiracy” behind the February 2020 northeast Delhi riots. Observing that it was bound by “judicial discipline”, the high court said it could not modify the Supreme Court’s January 5 order, which had asked the two accused to seek bail either after the examination of protected witnesses or the expiry of one year, whichever was earlier. Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam challenged the trial court’s July 4 decision rejecting their bail pleas for the third time since their arrest. The trial court had rejected the bail applications, saying it had “no option but to follow” the Supreme Court’s January 5 order and, therefore, could neither entertain the plea nor grant any relief.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam have been booked under UAPA on allegations of being among the masterminds of the February 2020 riots that left 53 people dead and more than 700 injured.

संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।

क़ैद कर देना — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Incarceration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Prosecution (Noun)
अभियोग पक्ष — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Prosecution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Examination (Noun)
परीक्षा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Examination' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

D. The author contends that 'SC issues notice to Delhi Police on pleas by ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Why is the Mine Ban Treaty facing a crisis? Why are more civilians falling victim to landmines? Are countries turning away from the landmine ban?

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The story so far: Landmines and explosive remnants of war (ERW, meaning unexploded or abandoned ordnance) killed or injured more people in 2025 than in any year since 2020, according to the 28th annual Landmine Monitor report, which was released on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) by the International Campaign to Ban Landmines (ICBL). Its findings come as the Mine Ban Treaty, which bans antipersonnel mines, has seen its first-ever withdrawals.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The treaty came into force on March 1, 1999, after a campaign that won the ICBL the Nobel Peace Prize in 1997. Countries that join must stop the use, stockpiling, production, and transfer of antipersonnel mines. They must destroy their stockpiles within four years and clear mines in areas they control within 10 years. A total of 162 countries are now bound by the treaty, while 35 remain outside it.

articles.title: India-Nepal joint military exercise begins in Rupandehi
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The exercise, involving battalion-level soldiers from the two countries, will run till December 8

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A joint military training exercise between Nepal and India, focusing on disaster management, forest welfare and humanitarian assistance, commenced on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). The 20th edition of the training exercise, “Abhyas Suryakiran”, began at Nepal Army Battle School in Saljhandi, Rupandehi district, according to a press release issued by the Nepal Army. The exercise, involving battalion-level soldiers from the two countries, will run till December 8. During the exercise, the military personnel of the two countries will exchange theoretical and practical aspects as well as special experiences relating to disaster management, forest warfare and humanitarian assistance, according to the Nepal Army. The 19th edition of the joint military exercise was held in Uttarakhand’s Pithoragarh last year.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Nepal Army believes such types of military exercises will further deepen friendly military relations between the two countries and also enhance professional skills and understanding between the soldiers of the two countries, the press release said.

articles.title: China launches crewed spaceship carrying first Pakistani astronaut to its space station
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Using a Long March-2F rocket, the spacecraft took ‌off at 8:18 a.m. (0018 GMT) ‌from ⁠the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre ⁠in northwest China

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) launched its Shenzhou-24 crewed spaceship carrying three astronauts , including Pakistan’s Muhammad Zeeshan Ali , the first foreign national to participate in the country’s crewed space programme. The spaceship, atop a Long March-2F carrier rocket, blasted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China, with officials declaring the launch successful minutes later. The crew comprises mission commander and spacecraft pilot Tang Hongbo, flight engineer Wu Yi and Ali, who will become the first foreign astronaut to visit China’s orbiting Tiangong space station. Mr. Ali will return to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft after spending about a week in orbit, while Chinese astronauts typically stay at the station for about six months. The spacecraft is expected to dock with the Tiangong space station in a few hours. China built its own space station after it was reportedly excluded from the International Space Station (ISS) over concerns about the involvement of its military, the People’s Liberation Army (PLA), in its space programme. China is currently the only country operating its own space station, which became operational in 2022. Tiangong is relatively small compared to the football pitch-sized ISS, where astronauts from several countries have conducted more than 3,000 experiments since its launch in 1998. NASA plans to retire the ISS in early 2031, using a dedicated deorbit vehicle being developed by SpaceX to guide it into a controlled re-entry over the South Pacific, according to reports.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Shenzhou-24 mission’s main objectives include completing an in-orbit crew rotation with the Shenzhou-23 crew, maintaining routine station operations, conducting scientific research and carrying out maintenance, public outreach and payload tests, Chinese officials said.

articles.title: At least two Indians among 11 injured in Houthi attack in Riyadh; New Delhi condemns strike
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence said a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District came under what it described as a "terrorist attack" by Houthi militia

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two Indians were among those injured in an attack on a financial district in Riyadh that triggered strong condemnation from New Delhi. India also denounced continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “Two Indians are among those injured in the attack on Riyadh financial district. The embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to the injured and their families,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said. The attack was carried out on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Local authorities said the injured included two Saudi citizens, three Nepalese and four Egyptian nationals. The MEA said India strongly condemns the attack in Riyadh as well as the continued strikes targeting civilian, economic and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. “These attacks seriously endanger civilian lives, violate the sovereignty of Saudi Arabia, and undermine regional security and stability. We call for immediate cessation of such attacks,” it said in a statement. India also reiterated its firm solidarity with the people and government of Saudi Arabia and reaffirmed its unwavering support to the Kingdom in safeguarding its sovereignty and territorial integrity. “We earnestly hope that peace and normalcy will return to the region at the earliest,” the MEA said. There has been a sudden escalation in tensions in West Asia, especially after the Houthis carried out several strikes on Saudi Arabia. The West Asia conflict began in February following attacks on Iran by the U.S. and Israel. New Delhi has consistently called for finding a solution to the conflict through dialogue and diplomacy.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: India has been specifically voicing serious concern over the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia’s civilian infrastructure and economic assets, cautioning that such strikes undermine regional stability and threaten freedom of navigation through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

The embassy of India in Riyadh is providing all possible assistance to the injured and their families,” the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said. There has been a sudden escalation in tensions in West Asia, especially after the Houthis carried out several strikes on Saudi Arabia. fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A cattle virus at home and a plague scare abroad make the same argument this World One Health Day: life is epidemiologically indivisible, and the institutions that govern and study it must learn to be so too

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In the second of his Major Rock Edicts, cut into stone in the third century BCE, Ashoka records that he has provided medical care of two kinds, for people and for animals, and has had healing herbs planted wherever they were lacking. Twenty-three centuries before the phrase existed, an Indian State treated the health of humans, animals and the land as a single charge of government. Rudolf Virchow, who introduced the word ‘zoonosis’, restated the idea for the age of the microscope: between animal and human medicine there is no dividing line, nor should there be. Modern governance, however, forgot what Ashoka and Virchow knew. It allotted people to one ministry, livestock to another and forests to a third, and pathogens, which recognise no such allocation of business, have exploited the gaps ever since. One Health, which the world marks on November 3, is the effort to recover that lost unity with the tools of the 21st century by bringing human, animal and environmental health into a common framework for research, surveillance and prevention. The Indian philosophy of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam , which regards the world as one family, resonates with this understanding of interconnected life. This year the case makes itself. Lumpy skin disease (LSD) has returned to India. The September forecast from ICAR-National Institute of Veterinary Epidemiology and Disease Informatics’ early-warning system placed 219 districts across 28 states and Union Territories at risk, and Rajasthan had recorded more than 10,400 cases in 10 eastern districts by mid-September. In Siberia, a young technician at Irkutsk’s anti-plague institute died in early October, of what Russian authorities called pneumonia of unknown cause, amid reports of pneumonic plague. Nearly 200 people were placed under observation. Whatever the final diagnosis, Yersinia pestis , the organism of the Black Death, has never left us. It persists in rodents and their fleas, from the marmots of the Central Asian steppe to the prairie dogs of New Mexico and the rats of Madagascar.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Neither story respects a departmental boundary. LSD does not infect people, but it drains milk cans, household incomes and children’s nutrition. Plague is at once a problem of wildlife ecology, laboratory biosafety, clinical medicine and public trust.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health and the statecraft of prevention

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:13:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A cattle virus at home and a plague scare abroad make the same argument this World One Health Day: life is epidemiologically indivisible, and the institutions that govern and study it must learn to be so too

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In the second of his Major Rock Edicts, cut into stone in the third century BCE, Ashoka records that he has provided medical care of two kinds, for people and for animals, and has had healing herbs planted wherever they were lacking. Twenty-three centuries before the phrase existed, an Indian State treated the health of humans, animals and the land as a single charge of government. Rudolf Virchow, who introduced the word ‘zoonosis’, restated the idea for the age of the microscope: between animal and human medicine there is no dividing line, nor should there be. Modern governance, however, forgot what Ashoka and Virchow knew. It allotted people to one ministry, livestock to another and forests to a third, and pathogens, which recognise no such allocation of business, have exploited the gaps ever since. One Health, which the world marks on November 3, is the effort to recover that lost unity with the tools of the 21st century by bringing human, animal and environmental health into a common framework for research, surveillance and prevention. The Indian philosophy of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam , which regards the world as one family, resonates with this understanding of interconnected life. This year the case makes itself. Lumpy skin disease (LSD) has returned to India. The September forecast from ICAR-National Institute of Veterinary Epidemiology and Disease Informatics’ early-warning system placed 219 districts across 28 states and Union Territories at risk, and Rajasthan had recorded more than 10,400 cases in 10 eastern districts by mid-September. In Siberia, a young technician at Irkutsk’s anti-plague institute died in early October, of what Russian authorities called pneumonia of unknown cause, amid reports of pneumonic plague. Nearly 200 people were placed under observation. Whatever the final diagnosis, Yersinia pestis , the organism of the Black Death, has never left us. It persists in rodents and their fleas, from the marmots of the Central Asian steppe to the prairie dogs of New Mexico and the rats of Madagascar.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Neither story respects a departmental boundary. LSD does not infect people, but it drains milk cans, household incomes and children’s nutrition. Plague is at once a problem of wildlife ecology, laboratory biosafety, clinical medicine and public trust.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Surveillance (Noun)
निगरानी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Surveillance' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Departmental (Adjective)
विभागीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Departmental' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health and the statecraft of prevention", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A cattle virus at home and a plague scare abroad make the same argument this World One Health Day: life is epidemiologically indivisible, and the...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health and' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A cattle virus at home and a plague scare abroad make the same argument this World One Health Day: life is epidemiologically indivisible, and the..." (Hinglish Arth: घर में मवेशियों का वायरस और विदेश में प्लेग का डर इस विश्व स्वास्थ्य दिवस पर एक ही तर्क देते हैं: जीवन महामारी विज्ञान की दृष्टि से अविभाज्य है, और जो संस्थान इसे नियंत्रित और अध्ययन करते हैं, उन्हें भी ऐसा ही सीखना चाहिए।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "The cow, the flea and the genome: One Health and the statecraft of prevention"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Plague is at once a problem of wildlife ecology, laboratory biosafety, clinical medicine and public trust.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Plague is at once a problem of wildlife ecology, laboratory biosafety, clinical medicine and public trust." (Hinglish Arth: प्लेग एक साथ वन्यजीव पारिस्थितिकी, प्रयोगशाला जैव सुरक्षा, नैदानिक ​​चिकित्सा और सार्वजनिक विश्वास की समस्या है।)

articles.title: Workers in high-risk jobs to receive shots against rabies in Tamil Nadu
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Sanitation workers, dog catchers, animal handlers and others involved in veterinary activities to be vaccinated; govt. sanctions ₹2.22 crore for drive

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Over a lakh persons belonging to high-risk occupational groups, including animal handlers and dog catchers of local bodies, in all 38 districts will receive Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) against rabies under the Tamil Nadu State Action Plan for Dog-Mediated Rabies Elimination (SAPRE) - Vision 2030. The State government has given the administrative sanction for implementation of the initiative at a cost of ₹2.22 crore, which will be met from the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu, an order issued recently said. In just four months of 2026, Tamil Nadu records 2.63 lakh dog bites, 17 deaths Gaps in anti-rabies treatment persist in Chennai’s health centres The Directorate of Public Health (DPH) and Preventive Medicine noted that certain occupational groups are routinely exposed to dogs and other animals in the course of their duties. Provision of PrEP to such identified high-risk personnel will provide an additional layer of protection and strengthen the State’s rabies elimination strategy. The programme aims to provide PrEP to identified personnel of occupational groups having sustained risk of exposure to dogs and other potentially rabid animals. The main categories include sanitation workers, animal handlers and dog catchers of local bodies and eligible personnel of the Animal Husbandry Department involved in animal handling, dog catching, veterinary and para-veterinary activities. As per the National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis, eligibility will be determined based on occupational exposure risk and the nature of duties performed. Based on the presently available department data, the preliminary beneficiary estimation was 1,29,009 - 1,21,844 local body sanitation workers, 3,324 local body animal handlers/dog catchers and 3,841 personnel attached to the Animal Husbandry department, the directorate said. The initiative will be implemented through designated government health facilities, including Primary Health Centres (PHC), Urban PHCs, government hospitals, and medical college hospitals. Identification of beneficiaries and mobilisation will be carried out by the respective local bodies and Animal Husbandry Department.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: health / communicable diseases / viral diseases / public health/community medicine / Tamil Nadu

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Workers in high-risk jobs to receive shots against rabies in Tamil Nadu

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:07:08 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sanitation workers, dog catchers, animal handlers and others involved in veterinary activities to be vaccinated; govt. sanctions ₹2.22 crore for drive

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Over a lakh persons belonging to high-risk occupational groups, including animal handlers and dog catchers of local bodies, in all 38 districts will receive Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) against rabies under the Tamil Nadu State Action Plan for Dog-Mediated Rabies Elimination (SAPRE) - Vision 2030. The State government has given the administrative sanction for implementation of the initiative at a cost of ₹2.22 crore, which will be met from the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu, an order issued recently said. In just four months of 2026, Tamil Nadu records 2.63 lakh dog bites, 17 deaths Gaps in anti-rabies treatment persist in Chennai’s health centres The Directorate of Public Health (DPH) and Preventive Medicine noted that certain occupational groups are routinely exposed to dogs and other animals in the course of their duties. Provision of PrEP to such identified high-risk personnel will provide an additional layer of protection and strengthen the State’s rabies elimination strategy. The programme aims to provide PrEP to identified personnel of occupational groups having sustained risk of exposure to dogs and other potentially rabid animals. The main categories include sanitation workers, animal handlers and dog catchers of local bodies and eligible personnel of the Animal Husbandry Department involved in animal handling, dog catching, veterinary and para-veterinary activities. As per the National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis, eligibility will be determined based on occupational exposure risk and the nature of duties performed. Based on the presently available department data, the preliminary beneficiary estimation was 1,29,009 - 1,21,844 local body sanitation workers, 3,324 local body animal handlers/dog catchers and 3,841 personnel attached to the Animal Husbandry department, the directorate said. The initiative will be implemented through designated government health facilities, including Primary Health Centres (PHC), Urban PHCs, government hospitals, and medical college hospitals. Identification of beneficiaries and mobilisation will be carried out by the respective local bodies and Animal Husbandry Department.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: health / communicable diseases / viral diseases / public health/community medicine / Tamil Nadu

क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।

Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Administrative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administrative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Identification (Noun)
पहचान — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Identification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Workers in high-risk jobs to receive shots against rabies in Tamil Nadu", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

articles.title: When public duty meets medical privacy
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A legislator undergoing prolonged treatment may retain the ability to perform official responsibilities. Functional capacity, rather than diagnosis alone, is therefore central to the legal question of what the public has the right to know

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sonia Gandhi, in her recently published memoir, recalls being advised surgery for suspected breast cancer in 2010. Since she is a prominent public figure, she wonders, in her book, whether she was entitled to even a modicum of privacy with regard to her health. Her account assumes renewed significance following a recent petition before the Madras High Court that inquired about the health of Kolathur MLA V.S. Babu (now deceased). These episodes expose a fundamental legal tension between the privacy politicians may want about their health, and the accountability they owe their constituents in a democracy. Does the public’s right to information justify waiving or limiting an office-holder’s medical confidentiality? How should a democracy reconcile these competing interests? Medical information is among the most sensitive forms of personal information. A diagnosis may reveal not merely someone’s present condition but also their reproductive history, genetic predispositions, psychiatric illness or future health risks. Disclosure can invite discrimination, political exploitation and public speculation. In Justice K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017), the Supreme Court recognised privacy as a fundamental right under Article 21. Holding public office does not automatically extinguish this protection. A politician receiving treatment need not publish laboratory reports. Nor does a disability establish an inability to govern. State intrusion needs lawful justification, not curiosity. The Constitution does not prescribe a general medical-fitness requirement for occupying high public office. Article 58 sets eligibility conditions for the President but requires no medical-fitness certificate. Article 65(2) allows the Vice-President to perform presidential functions when the President cannot do so through absence, illness or another cause. The Constitution recognises presidential illness but does not specify a detailed procedure or medical authority to determine contested incapacity. This distinction between eligibility to assume office and capacity to continue functioning deserves closer scrutiny.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For legislators, Articles 102 and 191 prescribe disqualification when a person is of ‘unsound mind’ and stands so declared by a competent court (not by a medical board). Section 16(1)(b) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, similarly provides for disqualification from electoral registration (by court not medical board). For Supreme Court judges, Article 124(4) permits removal on proof of incapacity, while the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968, provides a procedure that may involve a Medical Board. Article 317(3)(c), governing Public Service Commission members, permits removal for unfitness arising from ‘infirmity of mind or body’.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sonia Gandhi, in her recently published memoir, recalls being advised surgery for suspected breast cancer in 2010. Since she is a prominent public figure, she wonders, in her book, whether she was entitled to even a modicum of privacy with regard to her health. Her account assumes renewed significance following a recent petition before the Madras High Court that inquired about the health of Kolathur MLA V.S. Babu (now deceased). These episodes expose a fundamental legal tension between the privacy politicians may want about their health, and the accountability they owe their constituents in a democracy. Does the public’s right to information justify waiving or limiting an office-holder’s medical confidentiality? How should a democracy reconcile these competing interests? Medical information is among the most sensitive forms of personal information. A diagnosis may reveal not merely someone’s present condition but also their reproductive history, genetic predispositions, psychiatric illness or future health risks. Disclosure can invite discrimination, political exploitation and public speculation. In Justice K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017), the Supreme Court recognised privacy as a fundamental right under Article 21. Holding public office does not automatically extinguish this protection. A politician receiving treatment need not publish laboratory reports. Nor does a disability establish an inability to govern. State intrusion needs lawful justification, not curiosity. The Constitution does not prescribe a general medical-fitness requirement for occupying high public office. Article 58 sets eligibility conditions for the President but requires no medical-fitness certificate. Article 65(2) allows the Vice-President to perform presidential functions when the President cannot do so through absence, illness or another cause. The Constitution recognises presidential illness but does not specify a detailed procedure or medical authority to determine contested incapacity. This distinction between eligibility to assume office and capacity to continue functioning deserves closer scrutiny.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For legislators, Articles 102 and 191 prescribe disqualification when a person is of ‘unsound mind’ and stands so declared by a competent court (not by a medical board). Section 16(1)(b) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, similarly provides for disqualification from electoral registration (by court not medical board). For Supreme Court judges, Article 124(4) permits removal on proof of incapacity, while the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968, provides a procedure that may involve a Medical Board. Article 317(3)(c), governing Public Service Commission members, permits removal for unfitness arising from ‘infirmity of mind or body’.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीशों के लिए, अनुच्छेद 124(4) अक्षमता के प्रमाण पर हटाने की अनुमति देता है, जबकि न्यायाधीश (जांच) अधिनियम, 1968, एक प्रक्रिया प्रदान करता है जिसमें एक मेडिकल बोर्ड शामिल हो सकता है।।

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #30 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 When public duty meets medical privacy

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 01:47:36 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A legislator undergoing prolonged treatment may retain the ability to perform official responsibilities. Functional capacity, rather than diagnosis alone, is therefore central to the legal question of what the public has the right to know

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Sonia Gandhi, in her recently published memoir, recalls being advised surgery for suspected breast cancer in 2010. Since she is a prominent public figure, she wonders, in her book, whether she was entitled to even a modicum of privacy with regard to her health. Her account assumes renewed significance following a recent petition before the Madras High Court that inquired about the health of Kolathur MLA V.S. Babu (now deceased). These episodes expose a fundamental legal tension between the privacy politicians may want about their health, and the accountability they owe their constituents in a democracy. Does the public’s right to information justify waiving or limiting an office-holder’s medical confidentiality? How should a democracy reconcile these competing interests? Medical information is among the most sensitive forms of personal information. A diagnosis may reveal not merely someone’s present condition but also their reproductive history, genetic predispositions, psychiatric illness or future health risks. Disclosure can invite discrimination, political exploitation and public speculation. In Justice K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017), the Supreme Court recognised privacy as a fundamental right under Article 21. Holding public office does not automatically extinguish this protection. A politician receiving treatment need not publish laboratory reports. Nor does a disability establish an inability to govern. State intrusion needs lawful justification, not curiosity. The Constitution does not prescribe a general medical-fitness requirement for occupying high public office. Article 58 sets eligibility conditions for the President but requires no medical-fitness certificate. Article 65(2) allows the Vice-President to perform presidential functions when the President cannot do so through absence, illness or another cause. The Constitution recognises presidential illness but does not specify a detailed procedure or medical authority to determine contested incapacity. This distinction between eligibility to assume office and capacity to continue functioning deserves closer scrutiny.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For legislators, Articles 102 and 191 prescribe disqualification when a person is of ‘unsound mind’ and stands so declared by a competent court (not by a medical board). Section 16(1)(b) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, similarly provides for disqualification from electoral registration (by court not medical board). For Supreme Court judges, Article 124(4) permits removal on proof of incapacity, while the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968, provides a procedure that may involve a Medical Board. Article 317(3)(c), governing Public Service Commission members, permits removal for unfitness arising from ‘infirmity of mind or body’.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Disqualification (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Disqualification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Confidentiality (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Confidentiality' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "When public duty meets medical privacy", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A legislator undergoing prolonged treatment may retain the ability to perform official responsibilities.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'When public duty meets medical privacy' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'When public duty meets medical privacy' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'When public duty meets medical privacy' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A legislator undergoing prolonged treatment may retain the ability to perform official responsibilities." (Hinglish Arth: लंबे समय तक उपचार से गुजरने वाला विधायक आधिकारिक जिम्मेदारियों को निभाने की क्षमता बरकरार रख सकता है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "When public duty meets medical privacy"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Article 317(3)(c), governing Public Service Commission members, permits removal for unfitness arising from ‘infirmity of mind or body’.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Article 317(3)(c), governing Public Service Commission members, permits removal for unfitness arising from ‘infirmity of mind or body’." (Hinglish Arth: लोक सेवा आयोग के सदस्यों को नियंत्रित करने वाला अनुच्छेद 317(3)(सी), 'मानसिक या शरीर की दुर्बलता' से उत्पन्न होने वाली अयोग्यता के लिए हटाने की अनुमति देता है।)

articles.title: Stage being set for Khelo India in Telangana from December 11 to 22
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy for utilising the event for building sports infra and identifying talent, appoints district in-charges for the sports event

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The stage is being set for the successful conduct of Khelo India in Telangana from December 11 to 22, the flagship national sports programme to strengthen sports culture at grassroots. Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy is firm on utilising the event for building sports infrastructure, identify the talent and support high performance sports persons. The inaugural of the 12-day event is likely to be held at L.B. Stadium and the valedictory at Gachibowli Stadium in Hyderabad. Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy at a review meeting on Khelo India, in Hyderabad on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT Officials were directed to make arrangements in such a manner that sportsperson spirit reflects throughout the city. The police and Municipal Administration department were directed to work in close coordination to ensure that there is no scope for any complaints from the participants or the visitors to the event. The Chief Minister on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) directed the officials concerned to nominate in-charges for every activity and entrust them with the responsibility of overseeing the successful conduct of the prestigious event. Ministers would be nominated as in-charges at the district level for the event, while Sports Minister Vakiti Srihari was directed to work in coordination with his Cabinet colleagues D. Sridhar Babu and Ponnam Prabhakar to supervise the arrangements from time to time. Minister Jupally Krishna Rao was entrusted the responsibilities of Mahbubnagar district, in Warangal for Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy, Karimnagar for Adluri Lakshman Kumar and Khammam for Tummala Nageswara Rao. The Government’s advisor P. Sduarshan Reddy would look after Nizamabad district. The Ministers were directed to take adequate care in making necessary arrangements for providing food and accommodation for sportspersons as well as the invitees. There should not be any compromise in the quality of works pertaining to renovation of stadiums and other works, Mr. Revanth Reddy said warning that he would not tolerate any lapses.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Steps would be taken to promote sports and necessary infrastructure in the State and effort would be made to identify the latent talent lying at the grass root level so that they could be imparted training by reputed coaches to excel in their field of sports.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Stage being set for Khelo India in Telangana from December 11 to 22

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 04:10:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy for utilising the event for building sports infra and identifying talent, appoints district in-charges for the sports event

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The stage is being set for the successful conduct of Khelo India in Telangana from December 11 to 22, the flagship national sports programme to strengthen sports culture at grassroots. Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy is firm on utilising the event for building sports infrastructure, identify the talent and support high performance sports persons. The inaugural of the 12-day event is likely to be held at L.B. Stadium and the valedictory at Gachibowli Stadium in Hyderabad. Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy at a review meeting on Khelo India, in Hyderabad on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT Officials were directed to make arrangements in such a manner that sportsperson spirit reflects throughout the city. The police and Municipal Administration department were directed to work in close coordination to ensure that there is no scope for any complaints from the participants or the visitors to the event. The Chief Minister on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) directed the officials concerned to nominate in-charges for every activity and entrust them with the responsibility of overseeing the successful conduct of the prestigious event. Ministers would be nominated as in-charges at the district level for the event, while Sports Minister Vakiti Srihari was directed to work in coordination with his Cabinet colleagues D. Sridhar Babu and Ponnam Prabhakar to supervise the arrangements from time to time. Minister Jupally Krishna Rao was entrusted the responsibilities of Mahbubnagar district, in Warangal for Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy, Karimnagar for Adluri Lakshman Kumar and Khammam for Tummala Nageswara Rao. The Government’s advisor P. Sduarshan Reddy would look after Nizamabad district. The Ministers were directed to take adequate care in making necessary arrangements for providing food and accommodation for sportspersons as well as the invitees. There should not be any compromise in the quality of works pertaining to renovation of stadiums and other works, Mr. Revanth Reddy said warning that he would not tolerate any lapses.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Steps would be taken to promote sports and necessary infrastructure in the State and effort would be made to identify the latent talent lying at the grass root level so that they could be imparted training by reputed coaches to excel in their field of sports.

articles.title: Thirupparankundram row LIVE: Madurai District Collector says Devasthanam did not authorise lamp-lighting team
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Vishva Hindu Parishad (VHP) accused the TVK government in Tamil Nadu of defying the Supreme Court’s order on the traditional lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at ‘Deepathoon’ on Thiruparankundram hill near Madurai, saying its actions amount to an insult to the judiciary, the Constitution and Hindu religious sentiments. The RSS affiliate also warned that “anti-Hindu” politics and such a mindset are nearing extinction from the country’s political landscape and will soon disappear from Tamil Nadu as well. In a statement, VHP international president Alok Kumar said preventing a centuries-old religious tradition hurts the faith and sentiments of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan and reflects the state government’s “anti-Hindu obstinacy”. “Preventing a centuries-old religious tradition despite the Supreme Court’s order is a grave insult to the Indian Constitution and the judiciary. It is also a serious affront to the faith and beliefs of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan,” Mr. Kumar said. Tamil Nadu BJP chief Nainar Nagenthran said the “countdown has begun” for the TVK-led government and warned Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay of “legal consequences”, after the Karthigai Maha Deepam was not lit at the hilltop pillar in Thirupparankundram despite a Supreme Court order. Speaking to reporters, Mr. Nagenthran said the incident was not merely “anti-Hindu but also violated the Constitution”. Targeting Mr. Vijay directly, he questioned the CM’s maturity and impartiality. “My assessment is that the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister lacks the maturity, magnanimity or mindset required of a CM to view everyone equally. I think he is ruining himself by getting caught in the conspiracies of certain political parties,” he alleged. The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, on November 24, 2026, passed a ‘John Doe’ order in the Deepathoon case with regard to the lighting of the lamp at Thirupparankundram hill in Tamil Nadu’s Madurai for Karthigai Deepam. The High Court bench restrained anyone from violating the November 20 Supreme Court order which allowed the lighting of the lamp on the hillock as a “limited one-time arrangement” only.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A ‘John Doe’ order is an ex parte injuction ordered against unknown persons. Ex parte injunctions are injunctions that are granted even without hearing the other party. Issued against anonymous offenders, these are also called ‘Ashok Kumar’ orders in India and are equivalents of the placeholder ‘John Doe’ used in the U.S.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Thirupparankundram row LIVE: Madurai District Collector says Devasthanam did not authorise lamp-lighting team

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 04:20:14 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Vishva Hindu Parishad (VHP) accused the TVK government in Tamil Nadu of defying the Supreme Court’s order on the traditional lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at ‘Deepathoon’ on Thiruparankundram hill near Madurai, saying its actions amount to an insult to the judiciary, the Constitution and Hindu religious sentiments. The RSS affiliate also warned that “anti-Hindu” politics and such a mindset are nearing extinction from the country’s political landscape and will soon disappear from Tamil Nadu as well. In a statement, VHP international president Alok Kumar said preventing a centuries-old religious tradition hurts the faith and sentiments of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan and reflects the state government’s “anti-Hindu obstinacy”. “Preventing a centuries-old religious tradition despite the Supreme Court’s order is a grave insult to the Indian Constitution and the judiciary. It is also a serious affront to the faith and beliefs of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan,” Mr. Kumar said. Tamil Nadu BJP chief Nainar Nagenthran said the “countdown has begun” for the TVK-led government and warned Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay of “legal consequences”, after the Karthigai Maha Deepam was not lit at the hilltop pillar in Thirupparankundram despite a Supreme Court order. Speaking to reporters, Mr. Nagenthran said the incident was not merely “anti-Hindu but also violated the Constitution”. Targeting Mr. Vijay directly, he questioned the CM’s maturity and impartiality. “My assessment is that the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister lacks the maturity, magnanimity or mindset required of a CM to view everyone equally. I think he is ruining himself by getting caught in the conspiracies of certain political parties,” he alleged. The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, on November 24, 2026, passed a ‘John Doe’ order in the Deepathoon case with regard to the lighting of the lamp at Thirupparankundram hill in Tamil Nadu’s Madurai for Karthigai Deepam. The High Court bench restrained anyone from violating the November 20 Supreme Court order which allowed the lighting of the lamp on the hillock as a “limited one-time arrangement” only.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A ‘John Doe’ order is an ex parte injuction ordered against unknown persons. Ex parte injunctions are injunctions that are granted even without hearing the other party. Issued against anonymous offenders, these are also called ‘Ashok Kumar’ orders in India and are equivalents of the placeholder ‘John Doe’ used in the U.S.

Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
