articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Women’s Commission urges Telangana Governor to recommend special investigation into illegal oocyte racket

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 05:27:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Telangana State Women’s Commission urged Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla to recommend a special investigation to uncover the network behind the illegal oocyte (egg) collection racket — that was busted in Hyderabad a few weeks ago. A high-level committee to ensure a comprehensive and impartial investigation too was sought.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Commission’s Chairperson Nerella Sharada, along with its Member Uzma Shakeer, met the Governor at Lok Bhavan in the city on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) and apprised him of the racket involving alleged exploitation of poor and middle-class women. Malkajgiri Commissionerate Police in October last week said that they have busted an illegal human egg harvesting racket. The police arrested eight people, and 43 women from Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Maharashtra and other States were rescued from four premises in Hyderabad. The Chairperson apprised the Governor on the findings of the inquiry conducted by the Women’s Commission, information gathered from officials concerned, police investigation and legal developments. Ms. Sharada explained that women from different States were allegedly brought to Hyderabad on the pretext of employment and subsequently lured them into illegal retrieval of oocytes, exploiting their financial vulnerabilities. Considering the inter-State connection and wider ramifications of the racket, the Commission urged for the special investigation. Highlighting “loopholes and shortcomings” in the implementation of the Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) Act, it has urged the Governor to recommend necessary amendments to strengthen the legislation and ensure better protection of women’s rights, health and safety. The Governor responded positively to the representations made by the Commission and sought detailed information about the matter, as per a press note.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Commission has earlier issued notices to eight ART centres and egg banks over suspected irregularities . Around 10 days ago, the Police sought documents from 14 fertility centres, including consent forms, and electronic records pertaining to egg donation procedures to find the number of women who were approached, how frequently they underwent the procedure and whether required consent was obtained.

• 1. Core Context & Background: Telangana State Women’s Commission urged Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla to recommend a special investigation to uncover the network behind the illegal oocyte (egg) collection racket — that was busted in Hyderabad a few weeks ago. A high-level committee to ensure a comprehensive and impartial investigation too was sought.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Commission’s Chairperson Nerella Sharada, along with its Member Uzma Shakeer, met the Governor at Lok Bhavan in the city on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) and apprised him of the racket involving alleged exploitation of poor and middle-class women. Malkajgiri Commissionerate Police in October last week said that they have busted an illegal human egg harvesting racket. The police arrested eight people, and 43 women from Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Maharashtra and other States were rescued from four premises in Hyderabad. The Chairperson apprised the Governor on the findings of the inquiry conducted by the Women’s Commission, information gathered from officials concerned, police investigation and legal developments. Ms. Sharada explained that women from different States were allegedly brought to Hyderabad on the pretext of employment and subsequently lured them into illegal retrieval of oocytes, exploiting their financial vulnerabilities. Considering the inter-State connection and wider ramifications of the racket, the Commission urged for the special investigation. Highlighting “loopholes and shortcomings” in the implementation of the Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) Act, it has urged the Governor to recommend necessary amendments to strengthen the legislation and ensure better protection of women’s rights, health and safety. The Governor responded positively to the representations made by the Commission and sought detailed information about the matter, as per a press note.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Commission has earlier issued notices to eight ART centres and egg banks over suspected irregularities . Around 10 days ago, the Police sought documents from 14 fertility centres, including consent forms, and electronic records pertaining to egg donation procedures to find the number of women who were approached, how frequently they underwent the procedure and whether required consent was obtained.

articles.title: Cabinet approves ₹11,000-crore scheme to boost CIE manufacturing ecosystem in India
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Indian CIE industry is the world’s third-largest, with a market size of ₹97,000 crore in FY 2024-25, yet about 45% of it depends on imports, says Minister

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Union Cabinet on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) approved a ₹11,000-crore scheme to boost the country's Construction and Infrastructure Equipment (CIE) manufacturing ecosystem. Addressing the media after the Cabinet meeting, Information and Broadcasting Minister (I&B) Ashwini Vaishnaw said the scheme will run for eight years, starting in FY2026-27, and aims to build indigenous capacity in advanced CIE and position India as a key player in the global market. The Indian CIE industry is the world's third-largest, with a market size of ₹97,000 crore in FY 2024-25, yet about 45% of it depends on imports, the Minister said. The scheme includes a two-year gestation period (FY2026-27 to FY2027-28) to set up manufacturing facilities, followed by a five-year incentive disbursement period (FY2028-29 to FY2032-33) and a final year (FY2033-34) to settle incentives for incremental sales made in FY2032-33. According to an official statement, driven by accelerated growth in infrastructure (roads and ports) and housing, the industry is projected to increase more than double, reaching a market size of around ₹2,28,100 crore by FY2029-30. The scheme covers seven categories of equipment that are fully or largely imported, including tunnel boring machines, off-highway trucks, excavators, cranes, loaders, piling rigs, and drilling machines. The scheme also provides for establishing a State-of-the-art, dedicated CIE testing facility in the country. Last month, China announced new export controls on key machinery , including tunnel boring machines, in a move that could adversely impact India's infrastructure development. According to the statement, the scheme, to be implemented by the Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI), aims to incentivise domestic manufacturing of CIE and its components and to establish a dedicated CIE testing facility in the country, thereby enhancing self-reliance and positioning India as a key player in the Global CIE market. The scheme has two components: a sales-linked incentive and a grant for a CIE testing facility. Under the sales-linked incentive, incentives will be provided on the incremental sales value of eligible CIE equipment and components to approved applicants across two categories — eligible OEMs and Component Manufacturers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Graded Incentive rates range from 13% to 8% of incremental sales value over five years. Under the grant for a CIE testing facility — a grant of up to ₹375 crore, like Viability Gap Funding — will be given for setting up a dedicated CIE testing facility.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Cabinet approves ₹11,000-crore scheme to boost CIE manufacturing ecosystem in India

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 05:25:53 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Indian CIE industry is the world’s third-largest, with a market size of ₹97,000 crore in FY 2024-25, yet about 45% of it depends on imports, says Minister

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Union Cabinet on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) approved a ₹11,000-crore scheme to boost the country's Construction and Infrastructure Equipment (CIE) manufacturing ecosystem. Addressing the media after the Cabinet meeting, Information and Broadcasting Minister (I&B) Ashwini Vaishnaw said the scheme will run for eight years, starting in FY2026-27, and aims to build indigenous capacity in advanced CIE and position India as a key player in the global market. The Indian CIE industry is the world's third-largest, with a market size of ₹97,000 crore in FY 2024-25, yet about 45% of it depends on imports, the Minister said. The scheme includes a two-year gestation period (FY2026-27 to FY2027-28) to set up manufacturing facilities, followed by a five-year incentive disbursement period (FY2028-29 to FY2032-33) and a final year (FY2033-34) to settle incentives for incremental sales made in FY2032-33. According to an official statement, driven by accelerated growth in infrastructure (roads and ports) and housing, the industry is projected to increase more than double, reaching a market size of around ₹2,28,100 crore by FY2029-30. The scheme covers seven categories of equipment that are fully or largely imported, including tunnel boring machines, off-highway trucks, excavators, cranes, loaders, piling rigs, and drilling machines. The scheme also provides for establishing a State-of-the-art, dedicated CIE testing facility in the country. Last month, China announced new export controls on key machinery , including tunnel boring machines, in a move that could adversely impact India's infrastructure development. According to the statement, the scheme, to be implemented by the Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI), aims to incentivise domestic manufacturing of CIE and its components and to establish a dedicated CIE testing facility in the country, thereby enhancing self-reliance and positioning India as a key player in the Global CIE market. The scheme has two components: a sales-linked incentive and a grant for a CIE testing facility. Under the sales-linked incentive, incentives will be provided on the incremental sales value of eligible CIE equipment and components to approved applicants across two categories — eligible OEMs and Component Manufacturers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Graded Incentive rates range from 13% to 8% of incremental sales value over five years. Under the grant for a CIE testing facility — a grant of up to ₹375 crore, like Viability Gap Funding — will be given for setting up a dedicated CIE testing facility.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Indigenous (Adjective)
स्वदेशी — अपने ही देश (भारत) के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों द्वारा देश में विकसित किया गया।
✓ Syn: Domestic, Home-grown, Native  |  ✖ Ant: Imported, Foreign, Exotic
Construction (Noun)
निर्माण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Construction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Disbursement (Adjective)
अदायगी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Disbursement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Cabinet approves ₹11,000-crore scheme to boost CIE manufacturing ecosystem in India", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

D. The author contends that 'Cabinet approves ₹11,000-crore scheme to boos' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: TIFR-Hyd, Virupaksha Organics join hands for advanced materials research
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The collaboration may pave the way for commercialisation of promising technologies

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research-Hyderabad (TIFRH) and Hyderabad-based Virupaksha Organics Limited on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on research, technology development and technical evaluation in the field of advanced materials. The agreement aims to combine TIFRH’s expertise in fundamental scientific research with Virupaksha Organics’ industrial capabilities in process development and manufacturing. The collaboration is expected to help bridge the gap between laboratory research and industrial applications, paving the way for commercialisation of promising technologies. Under the MoU, the two organisations will jointly explore opportunities in research and development, process optimisation, product development, material characterisation, testing and technical evaluation. The initial focus areas include conducting and semiconducting materials for optoelectronic applications, development of two-dimensional (2D) materials, and quantum materials and optics. (From Left to right) Harish Krishnamoorthy, Pabitra K Nayak, T N Narayanan, Srinidhi Iyengar, M Krishnamurthy, Chandra Mouliswar Reddy, Smarajit Karmakar and Vijay K P | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The agreement serves as a non-exclusive umbrella framework, with specific projects to be taken up through separate agreements that will define the scope of work, timelines and deliverables. The partnership will also facilitate knowledge exchange and capacity building between researchers and industry professionals, said a press release.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 TIFR-Hyd, Virupaksha Organics join hands for advanced materials research

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 05:21:01 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The collaboration may pave the way for commercialisation of promising technologies

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research-Hyderabad (TIFRH) and Hyderabad-based Virupaksha Organics Limited on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on research, technology development and technical evaluation in the field of advanced materials. The agreement aims to combine TIFRH’s expertise in fundamental scientific research with Virupaksha Organics’ industrial capabilities in process development and manufacturing. The collaboration is expected to help bridge the gap between laboratory research and industrial applications, paving the way for commercialisation of promising technologies. Under the MoU, the two organisations will jointly explore opportunities in research and development, process optimisation, product development, material characterisation, testing and technical evaluation. The initial focus areas include conducting and semiconducting materials for optoelectronic applications, development of two-dimensional (2D) materials, and quantum materials and optics. (From Left to right) Harish Krishnamoorthy, Pabitra K Nayak, T N Narayanan, Srinidhi Iyengar, M Krishnamurthy, Chandra Mouliswar Reddy, Smarajit Karmakar and Vijay K P | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The agreement serves as a non-exclusive umbrella framework, with specific projects to be taken up through separate agreements that will define the scope of work, timelines and deliverables. The partnership will also facilitate knowledge exchange and capacity building between researchers and industry professionals, said a press release.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Commercialisation (Noun)
व्यावसायीकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Commercialisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Characterisation (Noun)
निस्र्पण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Characterisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Optoelectronic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Optoelectronic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "TIFR-Hyd, Virupaksha Organics join hands for advanced materials research", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The collaboration may pave the way for commercialisation of promising technologies.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'TIFR-Hyd, Virupaksha Organics join hands for adv' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'TIFR-Hyd, Virupaksha Organics join hands for ' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'TIFR-Hyd, Virupaksha Organics join hands for ' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The collaboration may pave the way for commercialisation of promising technologies." (Hinglish Arth: यह सहयोग आशाजनक प्रौद्योगिकियों के व्यावसायीकरण का मार्ग प्रशस्त कर सकता है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "TIFR-Hyd, Virupaksha Organics join hands for advanced materials research"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The partnership will also facilitate knowledge exchange and capacity building between researchers and industry professionals, said a press release.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The partnership will also facilitate knowledge exchange and capacity building between researchers and industry professionals, said a press release." (Hinglish Arth: एक प्रेस विज्ञप्ति में कहा गया है कि साझेदारी शोधकर्ताओं और उद्योग पेशेवरों के बीच ज्ञान के आदान-प्रदान और क्षमता निर्माण की सुविधा भी प्रदान करेगी।)

articles.title: 78 MoUs signed at second edition of VETTRI Tamil Nadu Investment and Conversion Conclave
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The MoUs involve investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Tamil Nadu government on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) signed 78 memoranda of understanding (MoUs) involving investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors and districts of the State. The MoUs were exchanged in the presence of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, Industries Minister S. Keerthana and Deepak Jacob, Managing Director and CEO of Guidance at the second edition of the VETTRI Tamil Nadu Investment and Conversion Conclave held in Chennai. The Chief Minister laid the foundation stone for 15 projects involving investments worth ₹7,925 crore, which are expected to generate 19,965 jobs. He also inaugurated six projects involving investments to the tune of ₹1,430 crore, creating employment opportunities for 1,710 people. Mr. Vijay handed over appointment letters to 18 candidates selected for various positions for companies including UPS, Autoliv, Stylcove, Mahindra & Mahindra, and Omron. With this, the total number of MoUs signed by the TVK government has risen to 190, involving investments worth over ₹1.73 lakh crore within 200 days of assuming office. The conversion rate is 74.1% (the MoUs signed on August 13, 2026). Industries Minister S. Keerthana said: “There has been considerable discussion about which State is attracting the most investment. Tamil Nadu welcomes competition. But for us, investment must translate into productive employment, better incomes and opportunities for our people. We are not chasing jobless growth.” She went on to add, “Our real competition is not another State. It is the world’s leading manufacturing economies.” The Minister also said that two out of every five women working in India’s factories are employed in Tamil Nadu. “That is why we launched the ‘Vetri Magalir Thozhilmunaivor Membattu Thittam’, which offers loans of up to ₹5 crore to women entrepreneurs. We have received thousands of applications, and 19 women entrepreneurs have already been sanctioned loans totalling ₹13.26 crore,” she said. On Global Capability Centres (GCCs), the Minister said the government would work with the Greater Chennai Corporation to strengthen social infrastructure. S. Vijayakumar, Additional Chief Secretary to the Government for the Industries, Investment Promotion and Commerce Department said that Tamil Nadu Single Window Portal 3.0 is under development and is expected to be ready by January 2027. The New Industrial Policy is also being prepared and is expected to be ready by January 2027, he added. Mr. Vijayakumar also said that the Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission has approved that industries may self execute their HT/EHT power connections by procuring the equipment, accessories and installations on their own. The Energy Department will share the specifications for self execution. Our Budget Estimates for the incentives to the industries for this current year is ₹2000 crore. We have distributed this amount in 200 days and have requested the government of Tamil Nadu for another ₹1600 crore,” he pointed out. Royal Enfield is set to establish an electric motorcycle manufacturing facility with an investment of ₹1,000 crore, creating 500 jobs. The company also unveiled its C6 model at the conclave.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sweden-based PMC Hydraulics is shifting a part of its manufacturing operations from Bengaluru to Tamil Nadu and will establish its first manufacturing facility in Krishnagiri, with an investment to the tune of ₹300 crore. The project is expected to generate 300 jobs.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q1 • Central Inference & Passage Core
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "78 MoUs signed at second edition of VETTRI Tamil Nadu Investment and Conversion Conclave", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
options: The MoUs involve investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors.
Contrary to the passage, the issue of '78 MoUs signed at second edition of VETTRI Tamil' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to '78 MoUs signed at second edition of VETTRI Ta' should be permanently discontinued.
The author contends that '78 MoUs signed at second edition of VETTRI Ta' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The MoUs involve investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The MoUs involve investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors." (Hinglish Arth: एमओयू में ₹58,214 करोड़ का निवेश शामिल है, जिसमें विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में 65,786 नौकरियां पैदा करने की क्षमता है।)

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.badge: Analytical Q2 • Key Evidence, Policy & Way Forward
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "78 MoUs signed at second edition of VETTRI Tamil Nadu Investment and Conversion Conclave"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
The project is expected to generate 300 jobs.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: The project is expected to generate 300 jobs.
ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.hinglishExplanation: Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The project is expected to generate 300 jobs." (Hinglish Arth: इस परियोजना से 300 नौकरियाँ पैदा होने की उम्मीद है।)

hinglishTracks.en: The MoUs involve investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — एमओयू में ₹58,214 करोड़ का निवेश शामिल है, जिसमें विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में 65,786 नौकरियां पैदा करने की क्षमता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Tamil Nadu government on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) signed 78 memoranda of understanding (MoUs) involving investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors and districts of the State.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — तमिलनाडु सरकार ने बुधवार (नवंबर 25, 2026) को राज्य के विभिन्न क्षेत्रों और जिलों में 65,786 नौकरियां पैदा करने की क्षमता के साथ ₹58,214 करोड़ के निवेश से जुड़े 78 समझौता ज्ञापन (एमओयू) पर हस्ताक्षर किए।।

hinglishTracks.en: The MoUs were exchanged in the presence of Chief Minister C.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — मुख्यमंत्री सी की उपस्थिति में एमओयू का आदान-प्रदान किया गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Joseph Vijay, Industries Minister S.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — जोसेफ विजय, उद्योग मंत्री एस.।

hinglishTracks.en: Keerthana and Deepak Jacob, Managing Director and CEO of Guidance at the second edition of the VETTRI Tamil Nadu Investment and Conversion Conclave held in Chennai.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — चेन्नई में आयोजित VETTRI तमिलनाडु निवेश और रूपांतरण कॉन्क्लेव के दूसरे संस्करण में कीर्तन और गाइडेंस के प्रबंध निदेशक और सीईओ दीपक जैकब।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Chief Minister laid the foundation stone for 15 projects involving investments worth ₹7,925 crore, which are expected to generate 19,965 jobs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मुख्यमंत्री ने 7,925 करोड़ रुपये के निवेश वाली 15 परियोजनाओं की आधारशिला रखी, जिनसे 19,965 नौकरियां पैदा होने की उम्मीद है।।

hinglishTracks.en: He also inaugurated six projects involving investments to the tune of ₹1,430 crore, creating employment opportunities for 1,710 people.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने ₹1,430 करोड़ के निवेश वाली छह परियोजनाओं का भी उद्घाटन किया, जिससे 1,710 लोगों के लिए रोजगार के अवसर पैदा हुए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Vijay handed over appointment letters to 18 candidates selected for various positions for companies including UPS, Autoliv, Stylcove, Mahindra & Mahindra, and Omron.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — विजय ने यूपीएस, ऑटोलिव, स्टाइलकोव, महिंद्रा एंड महिंद्रा और ओमरोन सहित कंपनियों के विभिन्न पदों के लिए चुने गए 18 उम्मीदवारों को नियुक्ति पत्र सौंपे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Appointment' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: नियुक्ति — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Appointment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: With this, the total number of MoUs signed by the TVK government has risen to 190, involving investments worth over ₹1.73 lakh crore within 200 days of assuming office.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसके साथ, टीवीके सरकार द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित एमओयू की कुल संख्या बढ़कर 190 हो गई है, जिसमें कार्यभार संभालने के 200 दिनों के भीतर ₹1.73 लाख करोड़ से अधिक का निवेश शामिल है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The conversion rate is 74.1% (the MoUs signed on August 13, 2026).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — रूपांतरण दर 74.1% है (13 अगस्त, 2026 को हस्ताक्षरित समझौता ज्ञापन)।।

hinglishTracks.en: Industries Minister S.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उद्योग मंत्री एस.।

hinglishTracks.en: Keerthana said: “There has been considerable discussion about which State is attracting the most investment.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कीर्तन ने कहा: “इस बात पर काफी चर्चा हुई है कि कौन सा राज्य सबसे अधिक निवेश आकर्षित कर रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Tamil Nadu welcomes competition.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — तमिलनाडु प्रतिस्पर्धा का स्वागत करता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Competition' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रतियोगिता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Competition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: But for us, investment must translate into productive employment, better incomes and opportunities for our people.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन हमारे लिए, निवेश को हमारे लोगों के लिए उत्पादक रोजगार, बेहतर आय और अवसरों में तब्दील होना चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: We are not chasing jobless growth.”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — हम रोजगारविहीन विकास का पीछा नहीं कर रहे हैं।”।

hinglishTracks.en: She went on to add, “Our real competition is not another State.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उन्होंने आगे कहा, “हमारी असली प्रतिस्पर्धा कोई दूसरा राज्य नहीं है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Competition' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रतियोगिता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Competition' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: It is the world’s leading manufacturing economies.” The Minister also said that two out of every five women working in India’s factories are employed in Tamil Nadu.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यह दुनिया की अग्रणी विनिर्माण अर्थव्यवस्था है।" मंत्री ने यह भी कहा कि भारत के कारखानों में काम करने वाली हर पांच में से दो महिलाएं तमिलनाडु में कार्यरत हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: “That is why we launched the ‘Vetri Magalir Thozhilmunaivor Membattu Thittam’, which offers loans of up to ₹5 crore to women entrepreneurs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “यही कारण है कि हमने 'वेट्री मगलिर थोझिलमुनैवोर मेम्बट्टू थिट्टम' लॉन्च किया, जो महिला उद्यमियों को ₹5 करोड़ तक का ऋण प्रदान करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: We have received thousands of applications, and 19 women entrepreneurs have already been sanctioned loans totalling ₹13.26 crore,” she said.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हमें हजारों आवेदन प्राप्त हुए हैं, और 19 महिला उद्यमियों को पहले ही कुल ₹13.26 करोड़ का ऋण स्वीकृत किया जा चुका है,'' उन्होंने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: On Global Capability Centres (GCCs), the Minister said the government would work with the Greater Chennai Corporation to strengthen social infrastructure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — वैश्विक क्षमता केंद्रों (जीसीसी) पर मंत्री ने कहा कि सरकार सामाजिक बुनियादी ढांचे को मजबूत करने के लिए ग्रेटर चेन्नई कॉर्पोरेशन के साथ काम करेगी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Corporation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: निगम — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Corporation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Vijayakumar, Additional Chief Secretary to the Government for the Industries, Investment Promotion and Commerce Department said that Tamil Nadu Single Window Portal 3.0 is under development and is expected to be ready by January 2027.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उद्योग, निवेश संवर्धन और वाणिज्य विभाग के अतिरिक्त मुख्य सचिव विजयकुमार ने कहा कि तमिलनाडु सिंगल विंडो पोर्टल 3.0 विकासाधीन है और जनवरी 2027 तक तैयार होने की उम्मीद है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Development' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: विकास — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Development' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The New Industrial Policy is also being prepared and is expected to be ready by January 2027, he added.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — उन्होंने कहा कि नई औद्योगिक नीति भी तैयार की जा रही है और जनवरी 2027 तक तैयार होने की उम्मीद है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Vijayakumar also said that the Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission has approved that industries may self execute their HT/EHT power connections by procuring the equipment, accessories and installations on their own.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — विजयकुमार ने यह भी कहा कि तमिलनाडु निवेश संवर्धन आयोग ने मंजूरी दे दी है कि उद्योग उपकरण, सहायक उपकरण और इंस्टॉलेशन स्वयं खरीदकर अपने एचटी/ईएचटी बिजली कनेक्शन स्वयं निष्पादित कर सकते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Energy Department will share the specifications for self execution.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — ऊर्जा विभाग स्व-निष्पादन के लिए विशिष्टताओं को साझा करेगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Our Budget Estimates for the incentives to the industries for this current year is ₹2000 crore.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — इस चालू वर्ष के लिए उद्योगों को प्रोत्साहन के लिए हमारा बजट अनुमान ₹2000 करोड़ है।।

hinglishTracks.en: We have distributed this amount in 200 days and have requested the government of Tamil Nadu for another ₹1600 crore,” he pointed out.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हमने यह राशि 200 दिनों में वितरित कर दी है और तमिलनाडु सरकार से अतिरिक्त ₹1600 करोड़ के लिए अनुरोध किया है,'' उन्होंने बताया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Royal Enfield is set to establish an electric motorcycle manufacturing facility with an investment of ₹1,000 crore, creating 500 jobs.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — रॉयल एनफील्ड ₹1,000 करोड़ के निवेश के साथ एक इलेक्ट्रिक मोटरसाइकिल विनिर्माण सुविधा स्थापित करने के लिए तैयार है, जिससे 500 नौकरियां पैदा होंगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The company also unveiled its C6 model at the conclave.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 78 MoUs signed at second edition of VETTRI Tamil Nadu Investment and Conversion Conclave

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 05:16:49 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The MoUs involve investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Tamil Nadu government on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) signed 78 memoranda of understanding (MoUs) involving investments worth ₹58,214 crore, with the potential to generate 65,786 jobs across various sectors and districts of the State. The MoUs were exchanged in the presence of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, Industries Minister S. Keerthana and Deepak Jacob, Managing Director and CEO of Guidance at the second edition of the VETTRI Tamil Nadu Investment and Conversion Conclave held in Chennai. The Chief Minister laid the foundation stone for 15 projects involving investments worth ₹7,925 crore, which are expected to generate 19,965 jobs. He also inaugurated six projects involving investments to the tune of ₹1,430 crore, creating employment opportunities for 1,710 people. Mr. Vijay handed over appointment letters to 18 candidates selected for various positions for companies including UPS, Autoliv, Stylcove, Mahindra & Mahindra, and Omron. With this, the total number of MoUs signed by the TVK government has risen to 190, involving investments worth over ₹1.73 lakh crore within 200 days of assuming office. The conversion rate is 74.1% (the MoUs signed on August 13, 2026). Industries Minister S. Keerthana said: “There has been considerable discussion about which State is attracting the most investment. Tamil Nadu welcomes competition. But for us, investment must translate into productive employment, better incomes and opportunities for our people. We are not chasing jobless growth.” She went on to add, “Our real competition is not another State. It is the world’s leading manufacturing economies.” The Minister also said that two out of every five women working in India’s factories are employed in Tamil Nadu. “That is why we launched the ‘Vetri Magalir Thozhilmunaivor Membattu Thittam’, which offers loans of up to ₹5 crore to women entrepreneurs. We have received thousands of applications, and 19 women entrepreneurs have already been sanctioned loans totalling ₹13.26 crore,” she said. On Global Capability Centres (GCCs), the Minister said the government would work with the Greater Chennai Corporation to strengthen social infrastructure. S. Vijayakumar, Additional Chief Secretary to the Government for the Industries, Investment Promotion and Commerce Department said that Tamil Nadu Single Window Portal 3.0 is under development and is expected to be ready by January 2027. The New Industrial Policy is also being prepared and is expected to be ready by January 2027, he added. Mr. Vijayakumar also said that the Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission has approved that industries may self execute their HT/EHT power connections by procuring the equipment, accessories and installations on their own. The Energy Department will share the specifications for self execution. Our Budget Estimates for the incentives to the industries for this current year is ₹2000 crore. We have distributed this amount in 200 days and have requested the government of Tamil Nadu for another ₹1600 crore,” he pointed out. Royal Enfield is set to establish an electric motorcycle manufacturing facility with an investment of ₹1,000 crore, creating 500 jobs. The company also unveiled its C6 model at the conclave.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Sweden-based PMC Hydraulics is shifting a part of its manufacturing operations from Bengaluru to Tamil Nadu and will establish its first manufacturing facility in Krishnagiri, with an investment to the tune of ₹300 crore. The project is expected to generate 300 jobs.

articles.title: SC defers Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam’s interim bail pleas pending larger Bench ruling on UAPA bail curbs
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The two activists have challenged a September 30 ruling of the Delhi High Court rejecting their fresh bail pleas, contending that the case remains at the stage of framing of charges and that the trial is yet to commence

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) declined to entertain pleas for interim bail filed by former JNU scholar Umar Khalid and activist Sharjeel Imam , accused in the larger conspiracy case linked to the 2020 Delhi riots. The court indicated that any consideration of interim relief would have to await an authoritative ruling by a larger Bench of three judges on whether prolonged incarceration and delay in trial can override the stringent bail curbs under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 (UAPA). At the outset of the hearing, senior advocates Kapil Sibal and Siddharth Dave, appearing for Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam, respectively, pressed for interim bail pending adjudication of the larger Bench reference, pointing out that both had been in custody for over six years. A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana, however, declined the request. “We will not hear it today… We will have to constitute a larger Bench in light of the observations made in the order dated May 22, 2026 passed in Tasleem Ahmed v. State of NCT of Delhi,” the Bench said. In its January 5 verdict, a Division Bench headed by Justice Aravind Kumar had granted bail to five other accused in the case but denied relief to Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam on the ground that the roles attributed to them stood on a “qualitatively different footing”. It, however, permitted them to renew their bail pleas after a year or upon completion of the examination of protected witnesses, whichever was earlier. Mr. Sibal drew the court’s attention to the subsequent May 22 order of the Justice Kumar-headed Bench, which had granted interim bail to Tasleem Ahmed and Abdul Khalid Saifi, two other accused in the conspiracy case, while referring the question of bail under the UAPA to a larger Bench. He urged the court to extend similar interim relief to the two activists. The reference, the Division Bench had said, was necessary to ensure “parity, consistency and institutional fidelity” in the application of binding precedents by coordinate Benches. “Only the main matter on the legal issue is under reference. Let the issue of interim come up for hearing,” Mr. Sibal submitted, requesting an early hearing. The CJI, however, pointed to conflicting judicial interpretations of the court’s 2021 ruling in Union of India v. K.A. Najeeb. In Najeeb, the court had held that the stringent bail embargo under Section 43D(5) of the UAPA could “melt down” where prolonged incarceration and delay in trial infringed an accused’s fundamental rights. The provision precludes the grant of bail where there are reasonable grounds to believe that the accusations against a person are prima facie true.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “In the light of the conflict of observations, I have to apply my mind… One Bench says Najeeb means this, another Bench says it does not mean… We are aware of everything. We have done our homework and have gone through the January 5 judgment,” the CJI remarked.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 SC defers Umar Khalid, Sharjeel Imam’s interim bail pleas pending larger Bench ruling on UAPA bail curbs

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 05:11:59 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The two activists have challenged a September 30 ruling of the Delhi High Court rejecting their fresh bail pleas, contending that the case remains at the stage of framing of charges and that the trial is yet to commence

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) declined to entertain pleas for interim bail filed by former JNU scholar Umar Khalid and activist Sharjeel Imam , accused in the larger conspiracy case linked to the 2020 Delhi riots. The court indicated that any consideration of interim relief would have to await an authoritative ruling by a larger Bench of three judges on whether prolonged incarceration and delay in trial can override the stringent bail curbs under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 (UAPA). At the outset of the hearing, senior advocates Kapil Sibal and Siddharth Dave, appearing for Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam, respectively, pressed for interim bail pending adjudication of the larger Bench reference, pointing out that both had been in custody for over six years. A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana, however, declined the request. “We will not hear it today… We will have to constitute a larger Bench in light of the observations made in the order dated May 22, 2026 passed in Tasleem Ahmed v. State of NCT of Delhi,” the Bench said. In its January 5 verdict, a Division Bench headed by Justice Aravind Kumar had granted bail to five other accused in the case but denied relief to Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam on the ground that the roles attributed to them stood on a “qualitatively different footing”. It, however, permitted them to renew their bail pleas after a year or upon completion of the examination of protected witnesses, whichever was earlier. Mr. Sibal drew the court’s attention to the subsequent May 22 order of the Justice Kumar-headed Bench, which had granted interim bail to Tasleem Ahmed and Abdul Khalid Saifi, two other accused in the conspiracy case, while referring the question of bail under the UAPA to a larger Bench. He urged the court to extend similar interim relief to the two activists. The reference, the Division Bench had said, was necessary to ensure “parity, consistency and institutional fidelity” in the application of binding precedents by coordinate Benches. “Only the main matter on the legal issue is under reference. Let the issue of interim come up for hearing,” Mr. Sibal submitted, requesting an early hearing. The CJI, however, pointed to conflicting judicial interpretations of the court’s 2021 ruling in Union of India v. K.A. Najeeb. In Najeeb, the court had held that the stringent bail embargo under Section 43D(5) of the UAPA could “melt down” where prolonged incarceration and delay in trial infringed an accused’s fundamental rights. The provision precludes the grant of bail where there are reasonable grounds to believe that the accusations against a person are prima facie true.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “In the light of the conflict of observations, I have to apply my mind… One Bench says Najeeb means this, another Bench says it does not mean… We are aware of everything. We have done our homework and have gone through the January 5 judgment,” the CJI remarked.

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Consideration (Noun)
सोच-विचार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consideration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Authoritative (Adjective)
आधिकारिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Authoritative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

The court indicated that any consideration of interim relief would have to await an authoritative ruling by a larger Bench of three judges on whether prolonged incarceration and delay in trial can override the stringent bail curbs under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 (UAPA). At the outset of the hearing, senior advocates Kapil Sibal and Siddharth Dave, appearing for Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam, respectively, pressed for interim bail pending adjudication of the larger Bench reference, pointing out that both had been in custody for over six years. A Bench comprising Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana, however, declined the request. “We will not hear it today… We will have to constitute a larger Bench in light of the observations made in the order dated May 22, 2026 passed in Tasleem Ahmed v. State of NCT of Delhi,” the Bench said. In its January 5 verdict, a Division Bench headed by Justice Aravind Kumar had granted bail to five other accused in the case but denied relief to Mr. Khalid and Mr. Imam on the ground that the roles attributed to them stood on a “qualitatively different footing”. It, however, permitted them to renew their bail pleas after a year or upon completion of the examination of protected witnesses, whichever was earlier. Mr. Sibal drew the court’s attention to the subsequent May 22 order of the Justice Kumar-headed Bench, which had granted interim bail to Tasleem Ahmed and Abdul Khalid Saifi, two other accused in the conspiracy case, while referring the question of bail under the UAPA to a larger Bench. He urged the court to extend similar interim relief to the two activists. The reference, the Division Bench had said, was necessary to ensure “parity, consistency and institutional fidelity” in the application of binding precedents by coordinate Benches. “Only the main matter on the legal issue is under reference. Let the issue of interim come up for hearing,” Mr. Sibal submitted, requesting an early hearing. The CJI, however, pointed to conflicting judicial interpretations of the court’s 2021 ruling in Union of India v. K.A. Najeeb. In Najeeb, the court had held that the stringent bail embargo under Section 43D(5) of the UAPA could “melt down” where prolonged incarceration and delay in trial infringed an accused’s fundamental rights. The provision precludes the grant of bail where there are reasonable grounds to believe that the accusations against a person are prima facie true.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “In the light of the conflict of observations, I have to apply my mind… One Bench says Najeeb means this, another Bench says it does not mean… We are aware of everything. We have done our homework and have gone through the January 5 judgment,” the CJI remarked.

articles.title: UK police charge two men over a break-in at Prince William and Princess Catherine’s country home
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom house on the Sandringham estate, was a wedding present to the couple from the late Queen Elizabeth II

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Two men have been charged with burglary at the country home of Prince William and Princess Catherine, police said on Wednesday (November 25, 2026). The Norfolk Police force says Mirgen Doku, 34, and Arilen Ndoci, 32, were charged with entering a dwelling with intent to steal and trespassing on a protected site. They are due in court later on Wednesday. Police officers were called on Monday evening to reported “suspicious activity” at an address on the royal family's rural Sandringham estate in eastern England. After a search involving police dogs, drones and a helicopter, two men were arrested on suspicion of burglary and trespassing. William and Kate’s Kensington Palace office declined to comment on security matters. Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom house on the Sandringham estate, was a wedding present to the couple from the late Queen Elizabeth II. William and Kate use the secluded red brick Georgian mansion about 110 miles (171 kilometres) north of London as a country residence on weekends. The couple and their three children spend most of their time at Forest Lodge in Windsor, west of London, which they have described as their “forever home.” Intruders have breached royal properties several times over the years. In October 2024, burglars broke into the Windsor Castle estate west of London and stole a pickup truck and a quad bike from a farm building. Charles and Queen Camilla weren’t at Windsor Castle at the time, but it was reported that William and Kate were in their nearby house. Three years earlier, a man armed with a crossbow was detained on the castle grounds. Jaswant Singh Chail was later sentenced to nine years in prison after admitting he had been encouraged by a chatbot to kill Elizabeth.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 1982, intruder Michael Fagan managed to sneak into the queen’s private chambers while she was in bed. The queen spent 10 minutes chatting with the burglar before raising the alarm when he asked for a cigarette.

articles.title: Meet the little stint: The tiny Siberian traveller visiting India’s wetlands
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Little Stint travels thousands of kilometres between its Arctic breeding grounds and Indian wetlands. But as shrinking mudflats and changing landscapes threaten its feeding and resting habitats, this tiny shorebird tells an important story about conserving wetlands

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The little stint, a 25-gram shorebird, comes in lakhs from the Arctic to the shores of India, particularly to Point Calimere. “It’s an unforgettable sight,” says S Sivakumar, who has been involved in monitoring shorebirds in the Gulf of Mannar for over a decade. The birds remain through the winter months and depart between March and April, sometimes later in May. “In the 1980s, the little stint could be seen in several lakhs at any point of time. Even now, the numbers are still over a lakh as the Point Calimere Wetland Complex covers over 300 kilometres across coastal Tamil Nadu ,” says Sivakumar, assistant director at the Bombay Natural History Society’s Bird Migration Study Centre at Point Calimere, adding that such long-term observations help scientists understand how bird populations and their habitats are changing. The birds remain through the winter months and depart between March and April, sometimes later in May | Photo Credit: S Sivakumar The tiny bird’s annual migration journey, a feat of endurance, involves multiple stopovers across different landscapes, each of which must provide sufficient food and safe resting grounds. As shrinking mudflats and changing landscapes threaten its feeding and resting habitats, this tiny shorebird tells an important story about conserving wetlands. Ashvin Viswanathan, scientist at Bird Count India , places the little stints as the most visible representatives of a special group of shorebirds that breed in the Arctic. “ This group is declining rapidly due to climate change and loss of habitat. Little stints too are declining in India according to SoIB,” he says, referring to the State of India’s Birds assessment. Their widespread presence, he adds, indicates the health of wetland ecosystems in India as well as conditions in the Arctic. The fact that the little stint is still a fairly common bird does not mean that it is beyond risk. It’s numbers and distribution can help draw attention to changes taking place across the habitats it depends on. The numbers are still over a lakh at Point Calimere wetlands | Photo Credit: S Sivakumar The bird’s preparation for migration is as fascinating as the journey itself. “Before setting off, they enter a phase of intense feeding called hyperphagia. They feed voraciously to build up fat reserves that act as fuel during its journey. This can add 50 to 75 percent to the bird’s body weight. There are also physiological changes, some organs shrink in size as the bird prepares for the demands of sustained flight,” explains Sivakumar adding that India is an important destination along the Central Asian Flyway that connects the bird with wintering habitats further South. The birds can be found along several coastal wetlands, including Point Calimere, Pulicat, parts of Puducherry and Kanyakumari, the Sundarbans, and the mudflats of Gujarat and Maharashtra. Across Tamil Nadu, the species is familiar to birders. “You can spot them at wetlands such as Kurichi and Ukkadam in Coimbatore,” says birder K Selvaganesh adding that the flock plays an important part of the food chain as prey for raptors, including the Western marsh marrier and the brahminy kite. Goa-based Rakesh Dhareshwar, a wildlife photographer says Goa and the wider west coast are reliable places to find them each season. “This year, I was delighted to see them inland too, at Bhigwan in Maharashtra, during a mid-Novemeber trip. However, shorebirds worldwide are in decline. Loss of coastal and inland wetlands, reclamation of mudflats, and pollution threaten stopover and wintering sites these birds depend on. The good news is that we can fix this. Protecting wetlands, salt pans and estuaries, and sharing spaces thoughtfully with people can make a real difference.” Shorebirds worldwide are in decline | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In his new book, Little Stint: A Migrant’s Tale (Neythal Pathipakam), author Byju H explores the bird’s remarkable journey through a blend of science and unconventional storytelling allowing the bird to narrate its own life, beginning with emerging from an egg in the Arctic tundra. “I wanted readers to travel with the bird,” he says adding that the book also highlights the fact that the bird’s ability to navigate vast distances depends on the availability of suitable wetlands along its migratory route.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Meet the little stint: The tiny Siberian traveller visiting India’s wetlands

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 04:46:39 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Little Stint travels thousands of kilometres between its Arctic breeding grounds and Indian wetlands. But as shrinking mudflats and changing landscapes threaten its feeding and resting habitats, this tiny shorebird tells an important story about conserving wetlands

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The little stint, a 25-gram shorebird, comes in lakhs from the Arctic to the shores of India, particularly to Point Calimere. “It’s an unforgettable sight,” says S Sivakumar, who has been involved in monitoring shorebirds in the Gulf of Mannar for over a decade. The birds remain through the winter months and depart between March and April, sometimes later in May. “In the 1980s, the little stint could be seen in several lakhs at any point of time. Even now, the numbers are still over a lakh as the Point Calimere Wetland Complex covers over 300 kilometres across coastal Tamil Nadu ,” says Sivakumar, assistant director at the Bombay Natural History Society’s Bird Migration Study Centre at Point Calimere, adding that such long-term observations help scientists understand how bird populations and their habitats are changing. The birds remain through the winter months and depart between March and April, sometimes later in May | Photo Credit: S Sivakumar The tiny bird’s annual migration journey, a feat of endurance, involves multiple stopovers across different landscapes, each of which must provide sufficient food and safe resting grounds. As shrinking mudflats and changing landscapes threaten its feeding and resting habitats, this tiny shorebird tells an important story about conserving wetlands. Ashvin Viswanathan, scientist at Bird Count India , places the little stints as the most visible representatives of a special group of shorebirds that breed in the Arctic. “ This group is declining rapidly due to climate change and loss of habitat. Little stints too are declining in India according to SoIB,” he says, referring to the State of India’s Birds assessment. Their widespread presence, he adds, indicates the health of wetland ecosystems in India as well as conditions in the Arctic. The fact that the little stint is still a fairly common bird does not mean that it is beyond risk. It’s numbers and distribution can help draw attention to changes taking place across the habitats it depends on. The numbers are still over a lakh at Point Calimere wetlands | Photo Credit: S Sivakumar The bird’s preparation for migration is as fascinating as the journey itself. “Before setting off, they enter a phase of intense feeding called hyperphagia. They feed voraciously to build up fat reserves that act as fuel during its journey. This can add 50 to 75 percent to the bird’s body weight. There are also physiological changes, some organs shrink in size as the bird prepares for the demands of sustained flight,” explains Sivakumar adding that India is an important destination along the Central Asian Flyway that connects the bird with wintering habitats further South. The birds can be found along several coastal wetlands, including Point Calimere, Pulicat, parts of Puducherry and Kanyakumari, the Sundarbans, and the mudflats of Gujarat and Maharashtra. Across Tamil Nadu, the species is familiar to birders. “You can spot them at wetlands such as Kurichi and Ukkadam in Coimbatore,” says birder K Selvaganesh adding that the flock plays an important part of the food chain as prey for raptors, including the Western marsh marrier and the brahminy kite. Goa-based Rakesh Dhareshwar, a wildlife photographer says Goa and the wider west coast are reliable places to find them each season. “This year, I was delighted to see them inland too, at Bhigwan in Maharashtra, during a mid-Novemeber trip. However, shorebirds worldwide are in decline. Loss of coastal and inland wetlands, reclamation of mudflats, and pollution threaten stopover and wintering sites these birds depend on. The good news is that we can fix this. Protecting wetlands, salt pans and estuaries, and sharing spaces thoughtfully with people can make a real difference.” Shorebirds worldwide are in decline | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In his new book, Little Stint: A Migrant’s Tale (Neythal Pathipakam), author Byju H explores the bird’s remarkable journey through a blend of science and unconventional storytelling allowing the bird to narrate its own life, beginning with emerging from an egg in the Arctic tundra. “I wanted readers to travel with the bird,” he says adding that the book also highlights the fact that the bird’s ability to navigate vast distances depends on the availability of suitable wetlands along its migratory route.

Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Unconventional (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Unconventional' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Physiological' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Distribution (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Distribution' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

A. The Little Stint travels thousands of kilometres between its Arctic breeding grounds and Indian wetlands.

D. The author contends that 'Meet the little stint: The tiny Siberian trav' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Little Stint travels thousands of kilometres between its Arctic breeding grounds and Indian wetlands."
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Meet the little stint: The tiny Siberian traveller visiting India’s wetlands"?

B. “I wanted readers to travel with the bird,” he says adding that the book also highlights the fact that the bird’s ability to navigate vast distances...

D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu’s water dispute with Karnataka: Palaniswami, Dhinakaran criticise TVK government
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Taking a swipe at Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, AIADMK chief Edappadi K. Palaniswami said the Karnataka government’s move reflected its perception that the Tamil Nadu administration was weak.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) strongly criticised the Congress government in Karnataka for reportedly moving the Supreme Court seeking a stay on several irrigation projects that will impact Tamil Nadu, including the ambitious Cauvery-Vaigai-Gundar river-linking project. Mr. Palaniswami accused the Congress of consistently acting against Tamil Nadu’s interests and questioned whether the TVK government, which is aligned with the Congress, would take a firm stand to protect the State’s water rights. He recalled that the Cauvery-Gundar river-linking project was formulated during his tenure as Chief Minister under the AIADMK government. Describing it as one of south India’s largest river-linking initiatives, he said its completion would significantly improve water availability for agriculture and help address water scarcity in several regions. Mr. Palaniswami also alleged that Karnataka had sought restrictions on several other Tamil Nadu irrigation projects. Taking a swipe at Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay , Mr. Palaniswami said the Karnataka government’s move reflected its perception that the Tamil Nadu administration was weak. He also criticised the government for not convening an all-party meeting despite his demand. He urged for initiating all possible legal measures to safeguard Tamil Nadu’s water resources. Meanwhile, AMMK general secretary T.T.V. Dhinakaran urged the Tamil Nadu government to legally challenge Karnataka’s move seeking a ban on several irrigation projects being implemented across the State along the Cauvery. Citing a report published in The Hindu in this regard, Mr. Dhinakaran said Karnataka has approached the Supreme Court seeking to stall projects, including the Cauvery-Vaigai-Gundar river-linking project and the Sarabanga lift irrigation scheme. Accusing the TVK government of failing to protect Tamil Nadu’s water rights, Mr. Dhinakaran sought transparency on the funds allocated and work completed under the river-linking project.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam / Amma Makkal Munnetra Kazhagam / Karnataka / Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #7 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Tamil Nadu’s water dispute with Karnataka: Palaniswami, Dhinakaran criticise TVK government

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 07:24:39 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Taking a swipe at Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, AIADMK chief Edappadi K. Palaniswami said the Karnataka government’s move reflected its perception that the Tamil Nadu administration was weak.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) strongly criticised the Congress government in Karnataka for reportedly moving the Supreme Court seeking a stay on several irrigation projects that will impact Tamil Nadu, including the ambitious Cauvery-Vaigai-Gundar river-linking project. Mr. Palaniswami accused the Congress of consistently acting against Tamil Nadu’s interests and questioned whether the TVK government, which is aligned with the Congress, would take a firm stand to protect the State’s water rights. He recalled that the Cauvery-Gundar river-linking project was formulated during his tenure as Chief Minister under the AIADMK government. Describing it as one of south India’s largest river-linking initiatives, he said its completion would significantly improve water availability for agriculture and help address water scarcity in several regions. Mr. Palaniswami also alleged that Karnataka had sought restrictions on several other Tamil Nadu irrigation projects. Taking a swipe at Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay , Mr. Palaniswami said the Karnataka government’s move reflected its perception that the Tamil Nadu administration was weak. He also criticised the government for not convening an all-party meeting despite his demand. He urged for initiating all possible legal measures to safeguard Tamil Nadu’s water resources. Meanwhile, AMMK general secretary T.T.V. Dhinakaran urged the Tamil Nadu government to legally challenge Karnataka’s move seeking a ban on several irrigation projects being implemented across the State along the Cauvery. Citing a report published in The Hindu in this regard, Mr. Dhinakaran said Karnataka has approached the Supreme Court seeking to stall projects, including the Cauvery-Vaigai-Gundar river-linking project and the Sarabanga lift irrigation scheme. Accusing the TVK government of failing to protect Tamil Nadu’s water rights, Mr. Dhinakaran sought transparency on the funds allocated and work completed under the river-linking project.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Tamil Nadu / All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam / Amma Makkal Munnetra Kazhagam / Karnataka / Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam

• 1. Core Context & Background: Taking a swipe at Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, AIADMK chief Edappadi K. Palaniswami said the Karnataka government’s move reflected its perception that the Tamil Nadu administration was weak.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) strongly criticised the Congress government in Karnataka for reportedly moving the Supreme Court seeking a stay on several irrigation projects that will impact Tamil Nadu, including the ambitious Cauvery-Vaigai-Gundar river-linking project. Mr. Palaniswami accused the Congress of consistently acting against Tamil Nadu’s interests and questioned whether the TVK government, which is aligned with the Congress, would take a firm stand to protect the State’s water rights. He recalled that the Cauvery-Gundar river-linking project was formulated during his tenure as Chief Minister under the AIADMK government. Describing it as one of south India’s largest river-linking initiatives, he said its completion would significantly improve water availability for agriculture and help address water scarcity in several regions. Mr. Palaniswami also alleged that Karnataka had sought restrictions on several other Tamil Nadu irrigation projects. Taking a swipe at Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay , Mr. Palaniswami said the Karnataka government’s move reflected its perception that the Tamil Nadu administration was weak. He also criticised the government for not convening an all-party meeting despite his demand. He urged for initiating all possible legal measures to safeguard Tamil Nadu’s water resources. Meanwhile, AMMK general secretary T.T.V. Dhinakaran urged the Tamil Nadu government to legally challenge Karnataka’s move seeking a ban on several irrigation projects being implemented across the State along the Cauvery. Citing a report published in The Hindu in this regard, Mr. Dhinakaran said Karnataka has approached the Supreme Court seeking to stall projects, including the Cauvery-Vaigai-Gundar river-linking project and the Sarabanga lift irrigation scheme. Accusing the TVK government of failing to protect Tamil Nadu’s water rights, Mr. Dhinakaran sought transparency on the funds allocated and work completed under the river-linking project.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A section of advocates on Wednesday (November 25) staged a protest outside the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, condemning the Tamil Nadu government and police for failing to light the Karthigai Deepam at the ‘Deepathoon’ atop Thirupparankundram hill despite a Supreme Court order permitting one-time lighting of the lamp on the stone pillar. Raising slogans against the state administration and police, the protesting lawyers accused the government of showing disrespect to the apex court and the Constitution. The demonstrators also questioned the authorities over the non-implementation of the court’s directive and protested the action taken against Hindu Munnani functionaries. The Tamil Nadu government on Wednesday (November 25) apologised to the Supreme Court over the non-lighting of the ceremonial lamp at the disputed Deepathoon (pillar) on the Thirupparankundram hill and blamed the Arulmigu Subramaniaswamy temple authorities for it, as contempt proceedings were sought against the State. The Supreme Court, while refusing to initiate suo motu contempt proceedings, said it will hear such a plea if filed. A bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and Vipul M Pancholi said the registry will verify the filing of applications for permission to light the lamp, including contempt petitions, and the court will see if they can be listed on Thursday (November 26) or Friday (November 27). The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) targeted the Tamil Nadu government over what it alleged was a defiance of the Supreme Court’s order on the Karthigai Deepam festival. BJP accuses INDIA alliance and Tamil Nadu government of contempt and anti-Hindu bias over Karthigai Deepam ruling and SC order. The Vishva Hindu Parishad (VHP) accused the TVK government in Tamil Nadu of defying the Supreme Court’s order on the traditional lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at ‘Deepathoon’ on Thiruparankundram hill near Madurai, saying its actions amount to an insult to the judiciary, the Constitution and Hindu religious sentiments. The RSS affiliate also warned that “anti-Hindu” politics and such a mindset are nearing extinction from the country’s political landscape and will soon disappear from Tamil Nadu as well. In a statement, VHP international president Alok Kumar said preventing a centuries-old religious tradition hurts the faith and sentiments of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan and reflects the state government’s “anti-Hindu obstinacy”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Preventing a centuries-old religious tradition despite the Supreme Court’s order is a grave insult to the Indian Constitution and the judiciary. It is also a serious affront to the faith and beliefs of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan,” Mr. Kumar said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (25 NOV)

📰 Thirupparankundram row updates: Supreme Court to examine if wilful disobedience occurred, as State and Hindu parties spar

📌 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 07:25:15 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Devotees barred from Tirupparankundram hill for the second consecutive day and heavy security deployed

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A section of advocates on Wednesday (November 25) staged a protest outside the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court, condemning the Tamil Nadu government and police for failing to light the Karthigai Deepam at the ‘Deepathoon’ atop Thirupparankundram hill despite a Supreme Court order permitting one-time lighting of the lamp on the stone pillar. Raising slogans against the state administration and police, the protesting lawyers accused the government of showing disrespect to the apex court and the Constitution. The demonstrators also questioned the authorities over the non-implementation of the court’s directive and protested the action taken against Hindu Munnani functionaries. The Tamil Nadu government on Wednesday (November 25) apologised to the Supreme Court over the non-lighting of the ceremonial lamp at the disputed Deepathoon (pillar) on the Thirupparankundram hill and blamed the Arulmigu Subramaniaswamy temple authorities for it, as contempt proceedings were sought against the State. The Supreme Court, while refusing to initiate suo motu contempt proceedings, said it will hear such a plea if filed. A bench of Justices Aravind Kumar and Vipul M Pancholi said the registry will verify the filing of applications for permission to light the lamp, including contempt petitions, and the court will see if they can be listed on Thursday (November 26) or Friday (November 27). The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) targeted the Tamil Nadu government over what it alleged was a defiance of the Supreme Court’s order on the Karthigai Deepam festival. BJP accuses INDIA alliance and Tamil Nadu government of contempt and anti-Hindu bias over Karthigai Deepam ruling and SC order. The Vishva Hindu Parishad (VHP) accused the TVK government in Tamil Nadu of defying the Supreme Court’s order on the traditional lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at ‘Deepathoon’ on Thiruparankundram hill near Madurai, saying its actions amount to an insult to the judiciary, the Constitution and Hindu religious sentiments. The RSS affiliate also warned that “anti-Hindu” politics and such a mindset are nearing extinction from the country’s political landscape and will soon disappear from Tamil Nadu as well. In a statement, VHP international president Alok Kumar said preventing a centuries-old religious tradition hurts the faith and sentiments of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan and reflects the state government’s “anti-Hindu obstinacy”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “Preventing a centuries-old religious tradition despite the Supreme Court’s order is a grave insult to the Indian Constitution and the judiciary. It is also a serious affront to the faith and beliefs of crores of devotees of Lord Murugan,” Mr. Kumar said.
