🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-kind deal on satellite systems

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 09:27:58 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Bellatrix Aerospace to supply in-space propulsion systems for GalaxEye’s 30 satellites

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Indian space companies GalaxEye and Bellatrix Aerospace on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) signed a multi-year contract in which Bellatrix Aerospace will supply in-space propulsion systems for the next 30 satellites GalaxEye is building. This made the deal the “largest business-to-business order” one Indian private space company has placed with another since the space sector opened to private players in 2020, a press release noted. While private companies have participated in India’s space sector since inception, it has usually been as suppliers to the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). The GalaxEye-Bellatrix deal was unveiled at the 5th India International Space Conclave, organised by the Indian Space Association (ISpA). The financial details of the contract were not disclosed. GalaxEye is building the world’s first OptoSAR satellite constellation. OptoSAR is a proprietary imaging technology that allows customers to see any place on Earth through clouds, smoke, and darkness. Bellatrix builds the thrusters that steer and position satellites once they reach orbit, with hardware already flight-tested on ISRO missions. “OptoSAR satellites are demanding customers. They need precise, repeatable orbits across a whole constellation, not a single demonstration. Our thrusters have already fired in orbit on ISRO missions, and we have built the production lines to deliver that same performance at constellation scale,” Rohan M. Ganapathy, co-founder and CEO of Bellatrix Aerospace, said in a statement. Bellatrix makes electric and green propulsion systems for satellites and orbital transfer vehicles. Mission Drishti, launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on May 3, 2026, became the world’s first OptoSAR satellite in orbit. It validated GalaxEye’s spacecraft deployment, attitude control, onboard computing and in-house mission operations before contact was lost after a geomagnetic storm, the company stated. In September, the Department of Science and Technology’s Technology Development Board committed ₹63.84 crore from the Government of India’s Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund for GalaxEye’s next multi-sensor satellite, which targets imagery sharper than 0.5 metres. Sourcing propulsion from a partner in the same city gives GalaxEye closer engineering control and shorter lead times as it builds that satellite. “Drishti taught us that every critical system on a satellite has to be one we can see, test and improve up close,” Suyash Singh, co-founder and CEO of GalaxEye, said in a statement. ISRO chairman V. Narayanan said that private industry was now indispensable to India’s space ecosystem. “Today, we are extremely happy that 440 start-up companies are working in the space area. Whenever a launch vehicle lifts off or we place a satellite, 70-80% of the budget is pumped into the Indian industry. Without the support of Indian industry, we would not have reached the present level.”

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Other officials, however, pointed out while India was putting in place a system to increase capacity, it had to work towards increasing demand for products from the private space ecosystem. “The first phase of India’s space reforms opened the sector and created an institutional framework for private participation. Now India has to work on generating heavy demand. I have less concern about capacity being created; I see a bigger need for demand to be created. The second is to have enough money coming into the sector, and number three, to have procedures at all levels. Space is not a sector that is going to give you a payback in six months or nine months. Perseverance is required, and the government must continue to have policy stability,” said Pawan Goenka, chairman, InSpace, India’s single-window regulatory and promotional body for the private space sector.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
International (Adjective)
अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Constellation (Noun)
तारामंडल — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Constellation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Demonstration (Adjective / Verb)
प्रदर्शन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Demonstration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-kind deal on satellite systems", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Bellatrix Aerospace to supply in-space propulsion systems for GalaxEye’s 30 satellites.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-kind ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-ki' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-ki' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Bellatrix Aerospace to supply in-space propulsion systems for GalaxEye’s 30 satellites." (Hinglish Arth: बेलाट्रिक्स एयरोस्पेस गैलेक्सआई के 30 उपग्रहों के लिए अंतरिक्ष में प्रणोदन प्रणाली की आपूर्ति करेगा)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Indian space companies sign largest-of-its-kind deal on satellite systems"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Perseverance is required, and the government must continue to have policy stability,” said Pawan Goenka, chairman, InSpace, India’s single-window...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Perseverance is required, and the government must continue to have policy stability,” said Pawan Goenka, chairman, InSpace, India’s single-window..." (Hinglish Arth: दृढ़ता की आवश्यकता है, और सरकार को नीतिगत स्थिरता जारी रखनी चाहिए, ”निजी अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्र के लिए भारत की एकल-खिड़की नियामक और प्रचार संस्था, इनस्पेस के अध्यक्ष, पवन गोयनका ने कहा।)

articles.title: How parents can help children develop a taste for healthy foods early in life
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Early exposure to varied, healthy foods influences children’s food preferences and eating habits; parents can encourage healthy eating through responsive feeding, age-appropriate portions, positive reinforcement, and by modelling healthy food choices themselves

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Birch L, Savage JS, Ventura A, ‘Influences on the Development of Children’s Eating Behaviours: From Infancy to Adolescence’, Canadian Journal of Dietetic Practice and Research, Vol. 68, Issue No. 1, 2007. Tucker P, Irwin JD, He M, Bouck LM, Pollett G, ‘Preschoolers’ Dietary Behaviours: Parents’ Perspectives’, Canadian Journal of Dietetic Practice and Research, Vol. 67, Issue No. 2, Summer 2006. De Cosmi V, Scaglioni S, Agostoni C, ‘Early Taste Experiences and Later Food Choices’, Nutrients, Vol. 9, Issue No. 2, February 4, 2017. Anater AS, Catellier DJ, Levine BA, Krotki KP, Jacquier EF, Eldridge AL, Bronstein KE, Harnack LJ, Lorenzana Peasley JM, Lutes AC, ‘The Feeding Infants and Toddlers Study (FITS) 2016: Study Design and Methods’, The Journal of Nutrition, Vol. 148, Issue No. 9S, September 1, 2018.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: F or most parents, particularly in the early stages as their child grows up, making sure the child eats healthy food becomes the toughest labour of Hercules. At times, when trying to make the child eat vegetables or diversify the range of foods she or he consumes, it seems as if cleaning the Augean stables could be child’s play.

articles.title: Karnataka plans State-wide blood donation drive on November 25
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The State Health Department has planned a State-wide voluntary blood donation drive on November 25, with a target of collecting 10,000 units of blood.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The State-level programme, organised by the Karnataka State Blood Transfusion Council (KSBTC), will be inaugurated at the Koramangala Indoor Stadium in Bengaluru at 11 a.m. The department has set a target of mobilising 5,000 to 7,000 blood donors for the initiative, according to a press release. The drive, themed ‘One Drop of Humanity - Donate Blood, Save Lives’, is aimed at strengthening the voluntary blood donation movement, ensure the availability of safe blood and blood components, and reduce dependence on replacement donations. As part of the initiative, blood donation camps will be organised across the State in coordination with district health authorities, district AIDS prevention and control units, blood banks, medical colleges, hospitals and voluntary organisations. Awareness programmes will be conducted through educational institutions, workplaces and community organisations to encourage voluntary blood donation. The programme will focus on identifying and registering voluntary donors, ensuring safe blood collection and storage, and maintaining donor records through the e-RaktKosh portal, the release said. The department has also planned to involve educational institutions, the National Service Scheme, National Cadet Corps, NGOs, youth groups, resident welfare associations and corporate organisations in mobilising donors and creating awareness about voluntary blood donation.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Standard operating procedures for blood collection, donor screening and counselling will be followed at the camps, the release added.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The District Sports Authority, Visakhapatnam, conducted district-level selection trials in six para-sports disciplines for boys and girls with disabilities aged above 13 years as on November 23 and 24, with 56 athletes participating.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trials were organised under the aegis of the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP), in association with the Department for Welfare of differently-abled, transgender persons and senior citizens and the Para Sports Association, Visakhapatnam. The initiative was organised in connection with the International Day of Persons with Disabilities, observed every year on December 3. articles.title: Infant denied birth certificate in West Bengal after father’s name deleted in SIR
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: There have been several instances in Bengal in the last few months in which the residents were denied basic facilities or access to a government scheme after their names were deleted in the SIR

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A two-and-a-half-month-old infant in West Bengal ’s Cooch Behar has been denied a birth certificate after her father’s name was found deleted from the electoral rolls during the special intensive revision (SIR ) exercise. On September 9, Amina Khatun, a resident of Cooch Behar’s Khatamari village, delivered a baby girl at Dinhata Sub-Divisional Hospital. Following the birth, Ms. Khatun and her husband, Abdul Habib, approached the hospital and the concerned Panchayat office to obtain their daughter’s birth certificate. However, they were reportedly asked to arrange residential verification from the Panchayat Pradhan or MLA. Amina Khatun, the mother of the infant. Photo: Special arrangement. When Mr. Habib approached the MLA of the Dinhata constituency, Ajoy Roy, for such verification, the MLA’s office refused the request. Mr. Habib was told that the certificate could not be issued because his name had been deleted from the electoral roll during the SIR process. “An official from the MLA office said that I am a Bangladeshi national and therefore I would need to get myself first registered through the National Register of Citizens. Why would I do that? I have been living in India since my birth. My house in Khatamari was built by my grandfather. I have shown them all the documents, but they still refused,” said Mr. Habib. A similar request was also refused by the Block Development Officer (BDO) of Sahebganj on the same grounds, he said. Mr. Habib is not the only one in his family whose name was deleted during the SIR. Three of his sisters’ names were also deleted. The Election Commission of India (ECI) called them for a hearing, citing a ‘logical discrepancy’ that six other persons also claimed his father as their own. However, the names of Mr. Habib’s parents, wife Ms. Khatun, and elder sister were included in the voter’s list. He has now appealed before a tribunal to include his name in the voter’s list but the application is awaiting a decision. The Association for Protection of Civil Rights (APCR) has strongly objected to the alleged administrative obstruction to issuing the infant’s birth certificate. “Birth registration is a statutory obligation, and every child has the right to immediate registration and legal identity under Article 7 of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC). The child’s right to legal identity must not be linked to the electoral status of her parents. An administrative dispute concerning SIR cannot become a barrier to a newborn child’s fundamental rights,” said the APCR in an official statement, demanding that the government immediately provide her with a birth certificate. There have been several instances in Bengal in the last few months in which residents were denied basic facilities or access to a government scheme after their names were deleted in the SIR. 🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Infant denied birth certificate in West Bengal after father’s name deleted in SIR

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 11:02:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: There have been several instances in Bengal in the last few months in which the residents were denied basic facilities or access to a government scheme after their names were deleted in the SIR

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A two-and-a-half-month-old infant in West Bengal ’s Cooch Behar has been denied a birth certificate after her father’s name was found deleted from the electoral rolls during the special intensive revision (SIR ) exercise. On September 9, Amina Khatun, a resident of Cooch Behar’s Khatamari village, delivered a baby girl at Dinhata Sub-Divisional Hospital. Following the birth, Ms. Khatun and her husband, Abdul Habib, approached the hospital and the concerned Panchayat office to obtain their daughter’s birth certificate. However, they were reportedly asked to arrange residential verification from the Panchayat Pradhan or MLA. Amina Khatun, the mother of the infant. Photo: Special arrangement. When Mr. Habib approached the MLA of the Dinhata constituency, Ajoy Roy, for such verification, the MLA’s office refused the request. Mr. Habib was told that the certificate could not be issued because his name had been deleted from the electoral roll during the SIR process. “An official from the MLA office said that I am a Bangladeshi national and therefore I would need to get myself first registered through the National Register of Citizens. Why would I do that? I have been living in India since my birth. My house in Khatamari was built by my grandfather. I have shown them all the documents, but they still refused,” said Mr. Habib. A similar request was also refused by the Block Development Officer (BDO) of Sahebganj on the same grounds, he said. Mr. Habib is not the only one in his family whose name was deleted during the SIR. Three of his sisters’ names were also deleted. The Election Commission of India (ECI) called them for a hearing, citing a ‘logical discrepancy’ that six other persons also claimed his father as their own. However, the names of Mr. Habib’s parents, wife Ms. Khatun, and elder sister were included in the voter’s list. He has now appealed before a tribunal to include his name in the voter’s list but the application is awaiting a decision. The Association for Protection of Civil Rights (APCR) has strongly objected to the alleged administrative obstruction to issuing the infant’s birth certificate. “Birth registration is a statutory obligation, and every child has the right to immediate registration and legal identity under Article 7 of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC). The child’s right to legal identity must not be linked to the electoral status of her parents. An administrative dispute concerning SIR cannot become a barrier to a newborn child’s fundamental rights,” said the APCR in an official statement, demanding that the government immediately provide her with a birth certificate. There have been several instances in Bengal in the last few months in which residents were denied basic facilities or access to a government scheme after their names were deleted in the SIR. The SIR held before the Assembly polls in West Bengal saw the removal of 91 lakh names from the electoral rolls of the State.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Earlier in June, Umme Salma, a resident of Cooch Behar district, had to approach the Calcutta High Court after a local fair price shop dealer told her that her entitlement was likely to be discontinued unless she could show proof of an appeal concerning her electoral status after her name was deleted under SIR. The court had directed that the West Bengal government should not take any coercive steps against the petitioner with regard to her monthly ration entitlement without its permission.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Permissibility (Noun)
कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।
✓ Syn: Admissibility, Legality, Allowance  |  ✖ Ant: Prohibition, Ban, Illegality
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Administrative (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Administrative' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Verification (Noun)
सत्यापन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Verification' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Infant denied birth certificate in West Bengal after father’s name deleted in SIR", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The court had directed that the West Bengal government should not take any coercive steps against the petitioner with regard to her monthly ration..." articles.title: Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India. “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits. We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P. Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG. ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise? | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026 The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr. Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues. “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward. We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held. I would say that EPG is in the past. We are not looking backward,” said Mr. Misri in response to a question. He described the EPG report as “not relevant”. Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process. “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr. Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05. The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers. “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi. The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof. Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first. “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr. Lama. The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli in February 2016. The visit of Mr. Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal. During the time of its existence, a part of the Institute of Defence Studies and Analyses (IDSA) in Delhi served as the secretariat for the EPG. The then Director General of the IDSA Jayant Prasad was also part of the EPG.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Incidentally, officials who are currently playing key roles in India-Nepal relations were also involved in the EPG process. Former members recounted that the newly appointed Indian ambassador to Nepal Sudhakar Dalela was the Joint Secretary (North) in the Ministry of External Affairs and was part of the EPG process during 2016-18. That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.question: Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties"?
options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.

ultraAnalyticalQuestions2.answerText: That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.

Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu." (Hinglish Arth: इसके अलावा, भारत में नए नेपाली राजदूत निश्चल नाथ पांडे भी काठमांडू में ईपीजी प्रक्रिया का हिस्सा थे।)

hinglishTracks.en: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उनकी यह प्रतिक्रिया विदेश सचिव विक्रम मिस्री द्वारा भारत-नेपाल प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति समूह की रिपोर्ट को ''प्रासंगिक नहीं'' बताए जाने के एक दिन बाद आई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — विदेश सचिव विक्रम मिस्री द्वारा भारत-नेपाल प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति समूह (ईपीजी) की रिपोर्ट को "प्रासंगिक नहीं" बताने के एक दिन बाद, यह तर्क देते हुए कि भारत नेपाल के साथ सीमा मुद्दों के संबंध में "आगे की ओर देखने वाला" दृष्टिकोण अपनाएगा, ईपीजी के एक पूर्व सदस्य ने कहा है कि रिपोर्ट भारत और नेपाल दोनों के लिए "अत्यधिक सकारात्मक" थी और यह "अजीब" था कि समूह को भारत सरकार को रिपोर्ट पेश करने का मौका नहीं मिला।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — “ईपीजी रिपोर्ट व्यापक शोध और क्षेत्र के दौरे के बाद तैयार की गई थी।।

hinglishTracks.en: We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — हमने विशाखापत्तनम और नेपाल के लिए रुचि रखने वाले अन्य बंदरगाहों का दौरा किया और रिपोर्ट संकलित करने से पहले कई हितधारकों से बात की और रिपोर्ट में दिलचस्प सिफारिशें हैं जो भारत और नेपाल के लिए बहुत उपयोगी हो सकती हैं और यह दिल्ली-काठमांडू संबंधों के लिए बेहद सकारात्मक थी, ”महेंद्र पी ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लामा, जवाहरलाल नेहरू विश्वविद्यालय के पूर्व प्रोफेसर, जिन्होंने ईपीजी के सदस्य के रूप में कार्य किया।।

hinglishTracks.en: ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यह भी देखें भारत-नेपाल संबंध: मोदी-बालेन साझेदारी क्या वादा करती है?।

hinglishTracks.en: | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — | तह के ऊपर | 23 नवंबर, 2026।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ईपीजी सोमवार (नवंबर 23, 2026) को फिर से सुर्खियों में आया जब श्री.।

hinglishTracks.en: Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मिस्री ने नेपाली प्रधान मंत्री बालेंद्र शाह की यात्रा के बाद आयोजित एक संवाददाता सम्मेलन में घोषणा की कि नई दिल्ली सीमा मुद्दों पर "दूरंदेशी" दृष्टिकोण अपनाएगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “नेताओं ने विदेश सचिवों को कार्य को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए आज हुई समग्र दूरदर्शी चर्चाओं के एक भाग के रूप में एक दिशा दी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हम दूरदर्शी तरीके से ऐसा करेंगे, विज़न दस्तावेज़ से, निर्देशों से और वास्तव में जिस भावना से चर्चा हुई थी उससे प्रेरणा लेते हुए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Inspiration' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inspiration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse और Antonyms हैं: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable।

hinglishTracks.en: I would say that EPG is in the past.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — मैं कहूंगा कि ईपीजी अतीत में है।।

hinglishTracks.en: We are not looking backward,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — हम पीछे मुड़कर नहीं देख रहे हैं,'' श्री ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Misri in response to a question.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — मिस्री ने एक सवाल के जवाब में कहा.।

hinglishTracks.en: He described the EPG report as “not relevant”.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — उन्होंने ईपीजी रिपोर्ट को "प्रासंगिक नहीं" बताया।।

hinglishTracks.en: Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — पूर्व नेपाली राजदूत और नेपाली पक्ष में ईपीजी के समन्वयक भेक बहादुर थापा ने ईपीजी रिपोर्ट को द्विपक्षीय परामर्श प्रक्रिया के लिए एक कदम आगे बताया।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — “यह एकतरफा दस्तावेज़ नहीं था, यह नई दिल्ली और काठमांडू द्वारा नियुक्त विशेषज्ञों के बीच द्विपक्षीय परामर्श के माध्यम से बनाया गया दस्तावेज़ था,” श्री ने कहा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Bilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत। इसके Synonyms हैं: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual और Antonyms हैं: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way।

hinglishTracks.en: Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — थापा, जो 2004-05 के दौरान नेपाल के विदेश मंत्री भी रह चुके हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — कालापानी विवाद और 1950 की भारत-नेपाल मैत्री संधि सहित भारत-नेपाल संबंधों के व्यापक स्पेक्ट्रम से संबंधित ईपीजी रिपोर्ट 2018 में पूरी हो गई थी, लेकिन यह सीलबंद कवर के तहत रही।।

hinglishTracks.en: “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — “यह अजीब है कि रिपोर्ट यहां दिल्ली में लॉन्च नहीं की जा सकी।।

hinglishTracks.en: The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नेपाली पक्ष ने कहा कि ईपीजी रिपोर्ट का अनावरण सबसे पहले भारतीय प्रधान मंत्री द्वारा किया जाना चाहिए और उसी दिन हमें नेपाली प्रधान मंत्री द्वारा रिपोर्ट के अनावरण के लिए काठमांडू लौटना था, "प्रोफेसर ने कहा।।

hinglishTracks.en: Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लामा ने सूचित करते हुए कहा कि उनसे गलती हुई क्योंकि काठमांडू भी पहले रिपोर्ट का अनावरण कर सकता था।।

hinglishTracks.en: “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — श्री ने कहा, "हमारी सिफारिशें अब काठमांडू में अन्य हितधारकों तक पहुंच सकती हैं और मुझे नहीं लगता कि यह कोई सकारात्मक बात है।"।

hinglishTracks.en: The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी और पूर्व नेपाली प्रधान मंत्री के.पी. के बीच प्रतिनिधिमंडल स्तर की वार्ता के दौरान बनी सहमति के अनुसार ईपीजी को संस्थागत बनाया गया था।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Institutional' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ। इसके Synonyms हैं: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional और Antonyms हैं: Individual, Informal, Unorganized।

hinglishTracks.en: Sharma Oli in February 2016.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — फरवरी 2016 में शर्मा ओली।।

hinglishTracks.en: The visit of Mr.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 11:01:38 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of the India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group (EPG) “not relevant”, arguing that India will take a “forward looking” approach regarding boundary issues with Nepal, a former member of the EPG has said the report was “highly positive” for both India and Nepal and that it was “odd” that the group did not get a chance to present the report to the Government of India. “The EPG report was produced after extensive research and field visits. We visited Visakhapatnam and other ports that are of interest to Nepal and spoke with many stakeholders before compiling the report and there are interesting recommendations in the report that could be of great use for India and Nepal and it was highly positive for Delhi-Kathmandu relations,” said Mahendra P. Lama, former professor of Jawaharlal Nehru University, who served as a member of the EPG. ALSO WATCH India-Nepal ties: What does Modi-Balen partnership promise? | Above the Fold | Nov 23, 2026 The EPG returned to the spotlight on Monday (November 23, 2026) when Mr. Misri announced in a press conference held after the visit of Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah that New Delhi would adopt a “forward-looking” approach to the border issues. “The leaders have given a direction as part of the overall very forward-looking discussions that have been held today for the foreign secretaries to take the task forward. We will do so in a forward-looking manner, taking inspiration from the vision document and from the directions and indeed the spirit in which the discussions were held. I would say that EPG is in the past. We are not looking backward,” said Mr. Misri in response to a question. He described the EPG report as “not relevant”. Former Nepali ambassador and coordinator of the EPG on the Nepali side, Bhek Bahadur Thapa, described the EPG report as a step forward for the bilateral consultation process. “It was not a unilateral document, it was a document created through bilateral consultation among experts appointed by New Delhi and Kathmandu,” said Mr. Thapa, who has also served as Foreign Minister of Nepal during 2004-05. The EPG report dealing with a broad spectrum of India-Nepal relations, including the Kalapani dispute and the 1950 India-Nepal Friendship Treaty was completed in 2018 but it remained under sealed covers. “It is odd that the report could not be launched here in Delhi. The Nepali side said the EPG report should be unveiled first by the Indian Prime Minister and on the same day we were supposed to return to Kathmandu for the report’s unveiling by the Nepali Prime Minister, “ said Prof. Lama, informing that they made a mistake as Kathmandu could have also unveiled the report first. “Our recommendations now can be accessed by other stakeholders in Kathmandu and I don’t think that is a positive thing,” said Mr. Lama. The EPG was institutionalised according to an understanding that was reached during the delegation-level talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and former Nepali Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli in February 2016. The visit of Mr. Oli took place against the backdrop of months-long blockade on Nepal-India border that Kathmandu said was imposed by India but India blamed the Madhesi agitators of Nepal for imposing the blockade that hindered flow of essential items such as cooking gas into Nepal. During the time of its existence, a part of the Institute of Defence Studies and Analyses (IDSA) in Delhi served as the secretariat for the EPG. The then Director General of the IDSA Jayant Prasad was also part of the EPG.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Incidentally, officials who are currently playing key roles in India-Nepal relations were also involved in the EPG process. Former members recounted that the newly appointed Indian ambassador to Nepal Sudhakar Dalela was the Joint Secretary (North) in the Ministry of External Affairs and was part of the EPG process during 2016-18. That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Consultation (Noun)
परामर्श — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consultation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Inspiration (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inspiration' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

A. Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positi' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'Former members say EPG report was ‘highly pos' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Their reaction comes a day after Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri termed the report of India-Nepal Eminent Persons Group “not relevant”." (Hinglish Arth: उनकी यह प्रतिक्रिया विदेश सचिव विक्रम मिस्री द्वारा भारत-नेपाल प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति समूह की रिपोर्ट को ''प्रासंगिक नहीं'' बताए जाने के एक दिन बाद आई है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Former members say EPG report was ‘highly positive’ for India-Nepal ties"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "That apart, the new Nepali ambassador to India Nischal Nath Pandey also was part of the EPG process in Kathmandu." (Hinglish Arth: इसके अलावा, भारत में नए नेपाली राजदूत निश्चल नाथ पांडे भी काठमांडू में ईपीजी प्रक्रिया का हिस्सा थे।)

articles.title: APEPDCL warns consumers of fake electricity bill messages
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Electricity consumers should beware of fraudulent SMS and WhatsApp messages threatening disconnection over alleged unpaid bills, B. Simhachalam Naidu, Superintending Engineer, APEPDCL Visakhapatnam Circle, warned on Tuesday.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: He said that cybercriminals were sending messages from unknown numbers claiming that the electricity supply would be disconnected after 8 p.m. the same day unless pending bills were paid immediately. Consumers should not click the links, call the numbers or make payments mentioned in such messages, he said. Sharing one-time passwords (OTPs), bank account details or other personal information could expose them to fraud. Consumers should verify bills and payment details only through official channels.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For queries or complaints, they may call the toll-free number 1912 or contact APEPDCL through WhatsApp at 9493681912.

📰 APEPDCL warns consumers of fake electricity bill messages

1. Core Context & Background: Electricity consumers should beware of fraudulent SMS and WhatsApp messages threatening disconnection over alleged unpaid bills, B. Simhachalam Naidu, Superintending Engineer, APEPDCL Visakhapatnam Circle, warned on Tuesday.

2. Sharing one-time passwords (OTPs), bank account details or other personal information could expose them to fraud. Consumers should verify bills and payment details only through official channels.

articles.title: Iran rules out talks with U.S. until its seven conditions are met
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Iran reiterated Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that it would not hold talks with the United States to end the conflict, saying that seven conditions must be met first, though it didn't specify the conditions. Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection. Meanwhile, at least nine Palestinians were killed in several Israeli strikes in Gaza, local officials said. Iran's chief negotiator and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that Tehran wouldn't negotiate with the U.S. "until Iran's seven conditions are met,” according to Iranian state television. Iranian authorities haven't publicly stated what those conditions are. But Iranian state media have said they include the lifting of sanctions, the ending of the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports and the release of seized Iranian assets. He also warned that Iran would “shift the geographical scope of the conflict should the enemy make a mistake.” The naval arm of Iran's Revolutionary Guard said the three oil tankers struck the naval mines because they were “in violation of regulations” regarding passage through the Strait of Hormuz. The Guard's navy said in a post on Telegram Monday (November 23, 2026) that the strait “is not a place to test unauthorised routes or to disregard maritime warnings.” It said the tankers were “engulfed in flames” after hitting the mines despite being under U.S. aerial escort.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: At least nine people were killed in four Israeli strikes Monday night (November 23, 2026) and Tuesday morning (November 24, 2026), officials in Gaza said. Among those killed was a senior security official in the Hamas-run government's Interior Ministry.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 Iran rules out talks with U.S. until its seven conditions are met

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 11:06:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Iran reiterated Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that it would not hold talks with the United States to end the conflict, saying that seven conditions must be met first, though it didn't specify the conditions. Iran also said three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire despite U.S. aerial protection. Meanwhile, at least nine Palestinians were killed in several Israeli strikes in Gaza, local officials said. Iran's chief negotiator and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that Tehran wouldn't negotiate with the U.S. "until Iran's seven conditions are met,” according to Iranian state television. Iranian authorities haven't publicly stated what those conditions are. But Iranian state media have said they include the lifting of sanctions, the ending of the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports and the release of seized Iranian assets. He also warned that Iran would “shift the geographical scope of the conflict should the enemy make a mistake.” The naval arm of Iran's Revolutionary Guard said the three oil tankers struck the naval mines because they were “in violation of regulations” regarding passage through the Strait of Hormuz. The Guard's navy said in a post on Telegram Monday (November 23, 2026) that the strait “is not a place to test unauthorised routes or to disregard maritime warnings.” It said the tankers were “engulfed in flames” after hitting the mines despite being under U.S. aerial escort.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: At least nine people were killed in four Israeli strikes Monday night (November 23, 2026) and Tuesday morning (November 24, 2026), officials in Gaza said. Among those killed was a senior security official in the Hamas-run government's Interior Ministry.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A Russian nighttime attack on Zaporizhzhia in southern Ukraine has killed two civilians and wounded 48 others including four children

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Russian nighttime attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia killed two civilians and wounded 48 others, including four children, officials said Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as authorities in Ukraine and Libya debated the legitimacy of an unprecedented Ukrainian strike on a Russian warship docked in Benghazi. The Zaporizhzhia glide bomb attack destroyed a private house and partially destroyed a five-story apartment building, according to Mykhailo Semikin, the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration. The youngest wounded child was less than a year old, he said, adding that the others were ages 4, 6 and 16. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that the Ukrainian military is sending reinforcements to the Zaporizhzhia region, which lies on the roughly 1,250-kilometer (almost 800-mile) front line snaking through eastern and southern Ukraine. Russia and Ukraine have escalated their aerial strikes in recent months even as they engage in U.S.-mediated talks to end the war that began with Moscow’s full-scale invasion of its neighbor nearly five years ago. Mr. Zelenskyy noted in a speech that Ukraine needs 115 billion euros ($126 billion) in aid from foreign countries next year to keep up the fight. Funding of 90 billion euros ($98.7 billion) is already assured, he said, but Ukraine needs to find another 25 billion euros ($27.4 billion). The United Nations says the war has killed close to 18,000 Ukrainian civilians and wounded more than 57,000 others since the all-out war broke out on Feb. 24, 2022. Hundreds of thousands of soldiers from both sides are believed to have died on the battlefield. Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship in Libya Russia says four killed in major Ukraine drone barrage More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the war, according to an estimate by independent Russian news outlets Meduza and Mediazona, which have been tracking Russian military losses for several years.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They said that they received a huge dataset earlier this month that was hacked from Russia’s state statistics agency Rosstat by Belarusian activist group Cyber Partisans and a Ukrainian hacker group, Silent Crow. They added projected deaths not yet recorded by Russian authorities.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #23 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 A Russian strike on Ukraine kills two, wounds 48 as Kyiv explains its attack in Libya

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 10:44:46 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A Russian nighttime attack on Zaporizhzhia in southern Ukraine has killed two civilians and wounded 48 others including four children

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A Russian nighttime attack on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia killed two civilians and wounded 48 others, including four children, officials said Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as authorities in Ukraine and Libya debated the legitimacy of an unprecedented Ukrainian strike on a Russian warship docked in Benghazi. The Zaporizhzhia glide bomb attack destroyed a private house and partially destroyed a five-story apartment building, according to Mykhailo Semikin, the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration. The youngest wounded child was less than a year old, he said, adding that the others were ages 4, 6 and 16. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that the Ukrainian military is sending reinforcements to the Zaporizhzhia region, which lies on the roughly 1,250-kilometer (almost 800-mile) front line snaking through eastern and southern Ukraine. Russia and Ukraine have escalated their aerial strikes in recent months even as they engage in U.S.-mediated talks to end the war that began with Moscow’s full-scale invasion of its neighbor nearly five years ago. Mr. Zelenskyy noted in a speech that Ukraine needs 115 billion euros ($126 billion) in aid from foreign countries next year to keep up the fight. Funding of 90 billion euros ($98.7 billion) is already assured, he said, but Ukraine needs to find another 25 billion euros ($27.4 billion). The United Nations says the war has killed close to 18,000 Ukrainian civilians and wounded more than 57,000 others since the all-out war broke out on Feb. 24, 2022. Hundreds of thousands of soldiers from both sides are believed to have died on the battlefield. Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship in Libya Russia says four killed in major Ukraine drone barrage More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the war, according to an estimate by independent Russian news outlets Meduza and Mediazona, which have been tracking Russian military losses for several years.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: They said that they received a huge dataset earlier this month that was hacked from Russia’s state statistics agency Rosstat by Belarusian activist group Cyber Partisans and a Ukrainian hacker group, Silent Crow. They added projected deaths not yet recorded by Russian authorities.

articles.title: Yemen officials say strike on buses, trucks kills 26
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An airstrike on trucks and buses killed 26 people in Yemen's southwest, local officials told AFP on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as the Houthis and government forces traded blame for the attack. Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks. Two officials said coalition warplanes struck Houthi vehicles on Monday (November 23, 2026) in Lahj province, where the group has advanced in recent weeks towards Aden, the government's interim capital. The aircraft "targeted two vehicles belonging to the Houthis at the moment when a truck and a bus were passing by, in an area considered a front line", one of the officials said, adding 12 Houthi fighters and 14 civilians were killed. The second official confirmed the death toll. Witnesses reported seeing charred bodies at the scene. The Houthis' military spokesman blamed the Saudi air force for the strike, saying it would not go "unanswered". But government forces said the Houthis carried out the attack. The pro-Iran group targeted "civilian vehicles bearing no military markings, on a road that is a vital artery for the population", government forces spokesman Majed al-Nazli said. Separate strikes on Monday (November 23, 2026) killed 17 people and destroyed several buildings in the coastal province of Hodeida, the Houthis' telecommunications ministry said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Yemen, embroiled in more than a decade of civil war, was sucked into the wider U.S.-Iran conflict in July when a truce between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government unravelled.

📰 Yemen officials say strike on buses, trucks kills 26

🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An airstrike on trucks and buses killed 26 people in Yemen's southwest, local officials told AFP on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), as the Houthis and government forces traded blame for the attack. Yemen, one of the world's poorest countries, has become the most active front in the West Asia war, with the Iran-backed Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition exchanging frequent attacks. Two officials said coalition warplanes struck Houthi vehicles on Monday (November 23, 2026) in Lahj province, where the group has advanced in recent weeks towards Aden, the government's interim capital. The aircraft "targeted two vehicles belonging to the Houthis at the moment when a truck and a bus were passing by, in an area considered a front line", one of the officials said, adding 12 Houthi fighters and 14 civilians were killed. The second official confirmed the death toll. Witnesses reported seeing charred bodies at the scene. The Houthis' military spokesman blamed the Saudi air force for the strike, saying it would not go "unanswered". But government forces said the Houthis carried out the attack. The pro-Iran group targeted "civilian vehicles bearing no military markings, on a road that is a vital artery for the population", government forces spokesman Majed al-Nazli said. Separate strikes on Monday (November 23, 2026) killed 17 people and destroyed several buildings in the coastal province of Hodeida, the Houthis' telecommunications ministry said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Yemen, embroiled in more than a decade of civil war, was sucked into the wider U.S.-Iran conflict in July when a truce between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government unravelled.

articles.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill seven including senior security official
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ‌Israeli military and the Shin ‌Bet domestic ​security service said in ⁠a joint statement they ‌had struck a senior Hamas member, without identifying ‌him, adding ​that further details would ⁠be provided later

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) killed seven people including Hamas’s director of internal security, Palestinian officials and Israel said, despite a ceasefire in place since last year. Israel’s military said it “eliminated the terrorist Naim Muhammad Ashour Abu Nahal”, adding that he had been appointed to his post only two months ago but had been part of Hamas for a long time. “His elimination constitutes a blow to the apparatus’s management capabilities,” it said in a joint statement with Israel’s Shin Bet security agency. Israel’s caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Israel Katz congratulated security forces, saying “no terrorist will escape the long arm” of their country. Mahmoud Bassal, spokesman for Gaza’s civil defence agency, which operates under Hamas authority, told AFP that several other people were in critical condition following the strike in Gaza City that killed Abu Nahal. The attack comes with talks underway in Israel to form a new government after October legislative elections produced no clear winner. Centrist Gadi Eisenkot is seeking to form a coalition to end Mr. Netanyahu’s long tenure. But Mr. Netanyahu, who has staked his reputation on ensuring security for Israel after the Hamas attack of October 7, 2023, remains in charge of military operations while negotiations continue. Mr. Bassal said earlier on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) that three people, including a 17-year-old, had been killed in a separate Israeli airstrike near Gaza City.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Three more were also killed in a third strike on a police station in the Al-Mawasi area in southern Gaza, he added.

articles.title: U.S. blacklists Megaspeed chip firm linked to Nvidia scandal
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The ​United States on Monday (November 24, 2026) added Singapore-based chip firm Megaspeed, which is closely tied to ‌an espionage investigation involving Nvidia, to its trade blacklist. The addition ​of the company follows revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen ⁠Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and Megaspeed's controlling shareholder who is reportedly alleged to be a spy for Beijing. The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs. U.S. companies ‌cannot ship goods, software and technology to companies on the ‌entity ⁠list without a license, which is likely to be denied. ⁠Firms on the list can find it harder to get access to U.S.-origin spare parts, software updates or licenses for intellectual property. Megaspeed did not immediately return a request ​for comment. The New York Times ‌reported last month that U.S. authorities had concluded Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset who passed information to Beijing while developing a close relationship with the Nvidia CEO. Reuters could not independently verify ‌the intelligence allegation. China has said the spy accusations are "groundless." Alice ​Huang led Singapore-based Megaspeed, historically a large Nvidia chip customer, people familiar with the matter have said. US authorities ⁠have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 over possible violations of export controls related to alleged shipments of Nvidia AI chips to China, the U.S. ‌Justice and Commerce departments said this week. Megaspeed has said Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducted "lawful business." Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia lists Megaspeed as an official cloud partner in its directory. Megaspeed ‌attracted public attention in October 2025, when the New York Times reported it ​was under U.S. investigation over whether it was helping Chinese customers obtain advanced Nvidia chips subject to Washington's export controls.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (24 NOV)

📰 U.S. blacklists Megaspeed chip firm linked to Nvidia scandal

📌 Published: 24 Nov 2026, 10:14:57 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The ​United States on Monday (November 24, 2026) added Singapore-based chip firm Megaspeed, which is closely tied to ‌an espionage investigation involving Nvidia, to its trade blacklist. The addition ​of the company follows revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen ⁠Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and Megaspeed's controlling shareholder who is reportedly alleged to be a spy for Beijing. The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs. U.S. companies ‌cannot ship goods, software and technology to companies on the ‌entity ⁠list without a license, which is likely to be denied. ⁠Firms on the list can find it harder to get access to U.S.-origin spare parts, software updates or licenses for intellectual property. Megaspeed did not immediately return a request ​for comment. The New York Times ‌reported last month that U.S. authorities had concluded Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset who passed information to Beijing while developing a close relationship with the Nvidia CEO. Reuters could not independently verify ‌the intelligence allegation. China has said the spy accusations are "groundless." Alice ​Huang led Singapore-based Megaspeed, historically a large Nvidia chip customer, people familiar with the matter have said. US authorities ⁠have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 over possible violations of export controls related to alleged shipments of Nvidia AI chips to China, the U.S. ‌Justice and Commerce departments said this week. Megaspeed has said Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducted "lawful business." Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia lists Megaspeed as an official cloud partner in its directory. Megaspeed ‌attracted public attention in October 2025, when the New York Times reported it ​was under U.S. investigation over whether it was helping Chinese customers obtain advanced Nvidia chips subject to Washington's export controls.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The ​United States on Monday (November 24, 2026) added Singapore-based chip firm Megaspeed, which is closely tied to ‌an espionage investigation involving Nvidia, to its trade blacklist. The addition ​of the company follows revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen ⁠Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman and Megaspeed's controlling shareholder who is reportedly alleged to be a spy for Beijing. The move coincided ‌with Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia after his resignation two weeks ago over revelations of extramarital affairs. U.S. companies ‌cannot ship goods, software and technology to companies on the ‌entity ⁠list without a license, which is likely to be denied. ⁠Firms on the list can find it harder to get access to U.S.-origin spare parts, software updates or licenses for intellectual property. Megaspeed did not immediately return a request ​for comment. The New York Times ‌reported last month that U.S. authorities had concluded Alice Huang was a Chinese intelligence asset who passed information to Beijing while developing a close relationship with the Nvidia CEO. Reuters could not independently verify ‌the intelligence allegation. China has said the spy accusations are "groundless." Alice ​Huang led Singapore-based Megaspeed, historically a large Nvidia chip customer, people familiar with the matter have said. US authorities ⁠have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 over possible violations of export controls related to alleged shipments of Nvidia AI chips to China, the U.S. ‌Justice and Commerce departments said this week. Megaspeed has said Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducted "lawful business." Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a November 8 statement following the reports of his relationship with Alice Huang, without referring to her by name.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Nvidia lists Megaspeed as an official cloud partner in its directory. Megaspeed ‌attracted public attention in October 2025, when the New York Times reported it ​was under U.S. investigation over whether it was helping Chinese customers obtain advanced Nvidia chips subject to Washington's export controls.

hinglishTracks.en: The breakdown in the Antalya summit has deepened the crisis of confidence in climate diplomacy, making transparency and accountability in the negotiating process more urgent than ever.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — अंताल्या शिखर सम्मेलन के टूटने से जलवायु कूटनीति में विश्वास का संकट गहरा गया है, जिससे बातचीत प्रक्रिया में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही पहले से कहीं अधिक जरूरी हो गई है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंताल्या, तुर्किये में संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु शिखर सम्मेलन की विफलता, इसके केंद्रीय राजनीतिक बयान पर सहमत होने में, जीवाश्म ईंधन और जलवायु कार्रवाई के अन्य प्रमुख प्रश्नों पर अपने मतभेदों को पाटने में असमर्थ देशों ने, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु सहयोग की नाजुकता को उजागर किया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'International' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: अंतरराष्ट्रीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'International' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इसे इस बात की भी जांच तेज करनी चाहिए कि जलवायु वार्ताओं तक किसे पहुंच मिलती है, वे किसके हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और कौन से सुरक्षा उपाय निर्णयों को जनता के प्रति जवाबदेह बनाए रखते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — तुर्किये शिखर सम्मेलन एक व्यापक बयान पर सहमति के बिना समाप्त हो गया।।

hinglishTracks.en: UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — संयुक्त राष्ट्र के जलवायु प्रमुख साइमन स्टिल ने कहा कि वह कई लोगों की "गहरी निराशा" को साझा करते हैं कि सम्मेलन एक ऐसे बयान पर आम सहमति तक पहुंचने में असमर्थ था जो आम तौर पर सभी देशों को नीति संकेत भेजता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Disappointment' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: निराशा — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Disappointment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हालाँकि कुछ अलग-अलग बातचीत के निर्णयों पर सहमति बनी।।

hinglishTracks.en: Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — फिर भी, राजनीतिक सहमति का अभाव एक गंभीर झटका था।।

hinglishTracks.en: The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — ब्रेकडाउन से यह नहीं पता चलता कि जीवाश्म ईंधन की पैरवी गतिरोध का कारण बनी।।

hinglishTracks.en: But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन यह प्रक्रिया की विश्वसनीयता के बारे में एक अलग प्रश्न को और अधिक जरूरी बना देता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक मंच जो सरकारों से वैश्विक जनहित में निर्णय लेने के लिए कहता है, उसे इस बारे में पारदर्शी होना चाहिए कि उन निर्णयों को कौन आकार देना चाहता है, वे किन हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और संघर्षों का प्रबंधन कैसे किया जाता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — हर साल होने वाली अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु वार्ता में अभी भी जीवाश्म ईंधन कंपनियों और राज्य के स्वामित्व वाले ऊर्जा व्यवसायों सहित शक्तिशाली वाणिज्यिक हितों से जुड़े हितों के टकराव की पहचान करने और प्रबंधित करने के लिए एक व्यापक, लागू करने योग्य प्रणाली का अभाव है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Enforcement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Implementation, Execution, Administration और Antonyms हैं: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver।

hinglishTracks.en: The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अंताल्या सम्मेलन ने रेखांकित किया है कि यह अंतर क्यों मायने रखता है।।

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The failure of the United Nations climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, to agree on its central political statement, with countries unable to bridge their differences over fossil fuels and other key questions of climate action, has exposed the fragility of international climate cooperation. It should also sharpen scrutiny of who gets access to climate negotiations, whose interests they represent and what safeguards keep decisions accountable to the public. The Türkiye summit ended without agreement on an overarching statement. UN climate chief Simon Stiell said he shared the “deep disappointment” of many that the conference was unable to reach consensus on a statement that typically sends a policy signal to all nations. Some separate negotiating decisions were reached though. Nevertheless, the absence of a political consensus was a serious setback. The breakdown does not show that fossil fuel lobbying caused the impasse. But it does make more urgent a separate question about the credibility of the process. A forum that asks governments to make decisions in the global public interest must be transparent about who is seeking to shape those decisions, what interests they represent and how conflicts are managed.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The international climate negotiations that take place every year still lack a comprehensive, enforceable system to identify and manage conflicts of interest involving powerful commercial interests, including fossil fuel companies and state-owned energy businesses. The Antalya conference has underlined why that gap matters.

The Chennai Grandmaster was in considerable time trouble on multiple occasions, but managed to solve his problems and found proper answers to the questions posed to him on the board by the confident Sindarov. The match has only begun, and there is plenty of chess left. It is a long match of 14 games, played in the classical time control, and the man who reaches 7.5 points will be the champion. The well-contested opening game would have given Gukesh, and his team comprising his coach and ‘seconds’, enough confidence, after several disappointing performances since he became the youngest World champion in history , at 18, by defeating China’s Ding Liren in Singapore two years ago. That match too had gone down the wire, with Gukesh winning the last of the 14 games, thanks to a terrible mistake towards the end by his rival. Sindarov is just six months older than Gukesh, making the Geneva match the youngest in the 140-year-old history of the World championship: both players are 20. It is remarkable that Gukesh has already seen the highs and lows of life at such a young age. For his opponent, the last one year has been better than a dream: from World No. 26 he has risen to No. 4. Chess is getting younger. The next World championship could also very well have two young contenders. Grandmasters are usually said to peak when they are around 30 and chess is one game that even older players have continued to excel in. Viswanathan Anand was 48 when he won the World rapid chess championship . The match between Gukesh and Sindarov has attracted considerable interest from across the sporting world. After the 1972 match between Boris Spassky and Bobby Fischer — the defining moment of world chess — the World championship has earned a reputation as one of the planet’s most important sporting events.
